jobs.title: Senior Content Marketer, SEO
jobs.desc:
We're looking for a Senior Content Marketer: an exceptional writer with the editorial judgment to own content quality for the customers they serve.

This is a writing-first role. About 70% of your time will be spent researching and writing content yourself—work that calls for real research, original thinking, and craft.

On the SEO team, that writing is built to perform in search: blog posts, guides, and landing pages that satisfy search intent and still read like something a person wanted to write. Search itself is changing, and this role sits right in the middle of that change. Alongside traditional rankings, you'll help customer content get found and cited by AI search tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google's AI Overviews.

The rest of your time goes to making sure everything else your accounts publish is just as good as what you write. You'll manage the freelance writers who contribute to your accounts, keep the content calendar on track, review every piece before it reaches the customer, and ensure customer feedback is acted on and remembered.

You won't do any of this alone. Every account is served by a small team, and you'll work alongside teammates who own the overall strategy and the customer relationship. Your ownership is the content itself: writing much of it, and standing behind all of it.

What You'll Do

  • Write high-quality content designed to rank, weaving keyword research, search intent, and on-page best practices into genuinely good writing, grounded in a real understanding of each customer's product and audience

  • Review every piece your accounts deliver before it reaches the customer, whether you wrote it, a freelancer wrote it, or it started as an AI-assisted draft. (Note: we have separate Editors who edit pieces in production for feedback. Your role is the final review)

  • Refresh and optimize existing content to improve rankings, engagement, and visibility, in both traditional search and AI-powered discovery

  • Diagnose why a piece isn't performing, using tools like GA4, Google Search Console, and Ahrefs, and recommend clear, prioritized improvements

  • Help manage the freelance writers on your accounts, write briefs they can succeed with, and maintain customer brand guides and other assets for reference.

  • Act on customer feedback quickly and thoroughly, and keep track of it, so a customer never has to give the same note twice

  • Communicate directly with customers about deliverables, timelines, and revisions, and join customer calls as a trusted voice on the work

  • Help improve our AI-assisted content workflows by using them on real work and feeding back what you learn

  • Contribute to performance reporting, helping show customers what shipped, how it's performing, and what we're learning

  • Use AI tools thoughtfully, taking advantage of them where they genuinely help, and applying your own judgment and craft where they don't

  • Contribute to team knowledge-sharing and internal initiatives, lear

jobs.desc:
POSITION SUMMARY

Are you a creative graphic designer with a passion for digital content, social media, and travel? Join us at the American Society of Travel Advisors (ASTA), the leading voice for travel professionals worldwide. 

We are seeking a Digital Marketing Senior Coordinator with a strong graphic design background to support our marketing and communications team. This role is responsible for creating both digital and print graphics to support the organization's overall marketing initiatives, including email campaigns, presentation decks for a variety of stakeholder groups, digital advertising assets, and some short-form video content.

The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to turn ideas into compelling visual stories across multiple channels. 

This is an exciting opportunity to help shape the digital presence of a national trade association that advocates for the travel advisor community. 

This position reports to the Director, Marketing.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Graphic Design

  • Design creative assets supporting ASTA events, advocacy initiatives, educational programs, membership campaigns and consumer-facing initiatives. 

    • Create graphics, animations and multimedia assets for social media, email marketing, websites, presentations, advertising campaigns and member communications. 

    • Create and edit short-form video content for social media, events, promotional campaigns and member communications using tools such as Canva, Premiere Pro, CapCut or similar video editing tools. 

    • Maintain visual consistency and brand standards across ASTA marketing materials and campaigns. 

    • Manage multiple creative projects simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining high design standards. 

Social Media Management & Email Marketing

  • In partnership with the Director of Marketing, manage ASTA's social media accounts on Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and YouTube, with a focus on posting timely and quality content, increasing engagement and growing more followers.

    • Develop engaging, on-board content including copy, graphics and short-form video to support marketing, advocacy, and public relations initiatives.

    • Design and support email marketing campaigns from concept through deployment. 

    • Support integrated marketing campaigns across email, social media, web and digital advertising channels. 

Content Development & Website Support 

  • Write and publish articles, member features, and industry updates for ASTA.org. 

    • Support content management efforts to ensure accuracy and consistency. 

    • Support public relations efforts, media outreach and organizational communications. 

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree required in Graphic Design, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

    • Advanced proficiency in Canva is required; experience with Adobe Creative Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and Premiere Pro, is preferred. 

    • Demonstrated graphic design experience through professional, freelance, internship, volunteer or academic work. Portfolio submission is required and should showcase digital design work across multiple formats. 

    • Strong understanding of design principles including layout, typography, branding, visual storytelling, and functionality

jobs.title: Senior Paid Search Manager
jobs.desc:
**Senior Paid Search Manager (E-commerce) - Onsite Garland Location**

1000Bulbs.com is America's largest independent online lighting retailer, based in Garland, Texas. We have been in lighting for more than 30 years. We own the supply chain from production to distribution, and we also run our own delivery fleet across DFW.

Two very different customers buy from us through the same account. One is a home owner replacing an outdoor light for their home and checks out online in ten minutes. The other is a contractor, property manager, or facilities buyer working through a major commercial retrofit, and that five-to-six-digit deal usually closes over the phone with a rep after a 2-month quote. Same ad account, same budget, wildly different economics.

We are looking for a Senior PPC Manager to own that account end to end: structure, bidding, measurement, and results.

**Who This Is For**

Most people do not read the search terms report for fun. You filter it to match type = AI Max, pull it through the API, n-gram it on a Sunday because you had a hunch, and find the query pattern that has been quietly eating budget. You know when a seasonality adjustment is right, when a data exclusion is right, and when the honest answer is to leave both alone and let the account relearn. You bid on margin instead of revenue, and you have the supplemental feed to prove it. When attribution and the ERP disagree, you go find out why instead of writing "variance" on a slide. And when someone quietly changes what a conversion action counts as value, you know exactly what happens next: the targets are still calibrated to the old numbers, ROAS reads as broken, and spend pulls back for two weeks before anyone connects the two. You know because you have lived it.

**Role Overview**

● **Job Title:** Senior PPC Manager / Paid Search Manager (E-commerce)

● **Reports To:** VP of Marketing

● **Budget Oversight:** Full ownership of paid search spend across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads

● **Department:** Marketing

● **Location:** Garland, TX. This is an onsite, in-office position. Not hybrid, not remote.

**Key Responsibilities**

● **Budget Ownership:** Manage and allocate the paid search budget across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads to hit KPI targets. You set the targets, allocate the budget, and answer for the return.

● **Performance Max & Shopping:** Own PMax structure at scale: asset groups, listing groups, Final URL Expansion controls, and campaign consolidation. Know when PMax is the right tool and when Standard Shopping wins.

● **Conversion Tracking & Measurement:** Own the full conversion architecture, including GA4, GTM, offline conversion import, enhanced conversions, and consent mode. Diagnose signal problems and fix them. Reconcile platform-reported revenue against actual NetSuite revenue and explain the gap.

● **Offline & Phone Revenue:** Build the pipeline that passes real closed order value from our call tracking platform back into Google. A meaningful share of our revenue closes by phone, on orders that run well into five and six figures.

● **Feed Management:** Manage and troubleshoot large-scale product feeds through Google Merchant Center: product taxonomy, feed rules, custom labels, and disapproval resolution across thousands of SKUs.

● **B2B / B2C Segmentation:** Structure and bid separately for two very different buyers. Our typical online order and our commercial quotes differ by more than an order of magnitude. Build an account that treats them differently.

● **Automation & Scripts:** Use the Google Ads API, scripts, and bulk operations to manage an account too large to run through the interface.

● **Automation & Scripts:** Use the Google Ads MCP to constantly pull data into Claude and turn this into actionable insight.

● **Executive Reporting:** Deliver weekly and monthly performance reporting to the VP of Marketing that separates media performance from business-side effects. Leadership reads these reports and makes decisions

jobs.desc:
Chief Detective is looking for an ambitious and driven online marketer to help our clients—fast-growing startups and large retail companies—scale revenue and acquisition aggressively via paid social channels.

We're a top agency on Meta, specializing in ecommerce and working with direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands in apparel, beauty, lifestyle, and more. Representative clients include Jenni Kayne, Rag & Bone, Ursa Major, Buck Mason, Frank & Eileen, and TOMS shoes.

**Job Summary:**

We're seeking a driven and skilled Senior Paid Social Growth Manager to manage a portfolio of 3 to 5 Meta ad accounts. This role will be responsible for creating and optimizing media plans, developing creative strategies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive growth and meet client goals. This is a dynamic, fast-paced role with high growth potential, requiring adaptability and an entrepreneurial mindset to succeed.

**Responsibilities:**

* Campaign Strategy & Planning: Collaborate with Growth Partners, Directors and media buyers on other channels to translate client business objectives into actionable paid media strategies on Meta & Instagram.
* Media Buying & Optimization: Launch, manage, and optimize campaigns to meet and exceed KPI targets. Perform daily management of ad spend and pacing to ensure budget adherence.
* Creative Collaboration: Work closely with internal creative strategy partners to request and provide feedback on ad creatives and ensure alignment with performance goals and trends.
* Data Analysis & Reporting: Monitor, analyze, and interpret data across platforms (Meta Ads Manager, GA4, Shopify, Looker Studio, etc.) to evaluate campaign performance and impact. Generate performance reports and present critical insights and recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders.
* Platform & Trend Expertise: Stay informed of Meta's evolving platform features, updates, and trends. Document and share best practices with internal stakeholders and client teams.
* Client Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for clients on Meta ad performance, insights, and strategic recommendations on a regular basis, including developing reports and running update calls.

**Requirements:**

* 4+ years of experience with Meta & Instagram ads
* Proven track record of managing and optimizing large budgets across campaigns
* Able to drive creative strategy on Meta ad accounts, including developing creative and content pipelines, ad concepting, and briefing to quickly scale accounts
* Familiar with creative best practices on Meta, including image, video, and copy requirements
* Proficient in multi-channel attribution and tracking across paid media platforms, with expertise in configuring, diagnosing, and troubleshooting data and attribution issues
* Familiarity or experience with other paid channels (TikTok, Pinterest, Google) is a plus
* Experience managing accounts with monthly budgets of at least 100K+
* Experience working with DTC/e-commerce clients (i.e. purchase-optimized campaigns)

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Able to manage media, reporting, and communication across a portfolio of accounts simultaneously
* Strong data and analytical skills with experience generating performance reports and insights
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
* Critical thinker who enjoys solving complex problems and navigating ambiguity
* Able to operate effectively in high-stress situations

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Salary range: $115,000–$125,000
* A comprehensive benefits package that includes group medical, dental, and vision coverage; short and long-term disability; life insurance; 401(k) eligibility after one year of service with matching contributions; paid time off; sick leave; an Employee Assistance Program, and more

jobs.desc: Senior Growth Marketing Manager Job in US Senior Growth Marketing Manager ❮ back to last search BIOptimizers United States 150000-160000 per year Full time REMOTE Apply for this job About BiOptimizers BiOptimizers exist to help people go from baseline health to peak biological performance. We develop science-backed supplements and wellness tools that deliver measurable results. As a remote-first company, our globally distributed team focuses on clarity, autonomy, and operational excellence. Every role is designed to support the health and performance of both our customers and our organization. Role Overview We’re hiring a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to scale our direct-to-consumer (DTC) business by acquiring new customers — and specifically new subscribers — profitably, at or below our target customer acquisition cost (CAC). This is the core of the role: bring in high-quality subscribers at a CAC that works against their lifetime value, and then scale that engine without breaking the economics. This is a hands-on, in-the-platform operator role — not a strategy-only seat. You will build, launch, and optimize paid campaigns daily across Meta and Google, extend into video and TV as we scale, and own the full path from ad impression to subscribed customer — including the offers, the creative, and the landing pages that convert a first-time visitor into a recurring subscriber. You understand that new-customer CAC — not blended ROAS — is the number that matters, and that acquiring a subscriber is worth more than a one-time buyer because subscriber retention and LTV set how much you can profitably spend to acquire. You keep ad message, audience signal, offer, and landing page tightly aligned to drive subscription take-rate. This role reports into marketing leadership and contributes directly to BiOptimizers’ mission of biologically optimizing the health of humanity. Key Responsibilities New-subscriber acquisition at or below target CAC — you own the number, the spend, and the outcome. Daily, hands-on management of paid acquisition across Meta and Google, scaling profitable spend as fast as the CAC target allows. The acquisition offer and funnel — how first-order offers, subscribe-and-save mechanics, and checkout drive subscription take-rate, first-order margin, and payback. The creative and landing-page system that converts cold traffic into subscribers, in partnership with creative and front-end development. A repeatable creator-content testing pipeline that graduates winning organic concepts into paid ads. Expansion into upper-funnel video and TV (linear / CTV) as the account scales, measured for true incrementality. Required Qualifications 7+ years of hands-on, in-platform paid acquisition experience for a DTC or consumer brand — you have personally managed budgets and owned CAC and performance, not just briefed an agency. A proven track record of acquiring new customers profitably at a target CAC and scaling spend without blowing up the economics. Subscription / recurring-revenue acquisition experience is strongly preferred — you understand how subscriber retention and LTV set your allowable CAC and payback window, and how offers and checkout drive subscription take-rate. Deep, hands-on Meta Ads management: campaign structure, Advantage+ Shopping and broad targeting, creative testing, and budget scaling. You understand Meta’s Andromeda retrieval engine and how creative volume, signal quality (CAPI / server-side), and audience consolidation feed it to improve delivery and lower CAC. * A track record scaling leads/appointments/conversions on significant, complex budgets

We're looking for a Sr Manager, Growth Marketing to lead our growth engine. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you'll set and execute strategy for paid acquisition, CRM/lifecycle, and B2B funnel performance, working directly with the Head of Marketing and in close partnership with Sales and Product to drive qualified pipeline and revenue growth.

**Who is DOOR?**

DOOR (formerly Latch) is unlocking the next era of Building Intelligence. We combine premium hardware, intuitive software, and automated operations into one seamless platform—helping multifamily properties run more efficiently, grow revenue, and deliver smarter, more connected living experiences. From smart access and in-unit automation to building-wide controls, DOOR empowers owners, operators, and property teams to reduce overhead, protect asset value, and stand out in a competitive market.

We believe smarter buildings make life simpler. At DOOR, you’ll help shape a future where buildings anticipate needs, operate effortlessly, and quietly improve life for everyone inside.

* Own the lead generation funnel end-to-end, from top-of-funnel acquisition through MQL/SQL handoff and conversion, setting strategy and owning targets for pipeline volume and quality.

**What do you bring to DOOR?**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing or related field.

Our mission is to provide entrepreneurs with the working capital they need to elevate their businesses to new heights. Soleno is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development and commercialization of novel therapeutics for the treatment of rare diseases based in Redwood City, CA.

At Soleno, we are driven by the unique and multi-faceted needs of the PWS community. Like these individuals, resilience is part of who we are – it is in our chromosomes – and our team is made up of exceptional colleagues whose collective efforts are woven together to deliver meaningful outcomes, both professionally and for those living with PWS.

We value collaboration, integrity, and respect. These characteristics have allowed us to forge strong, authentic bonds with the caregivers, patients, health care professionals (HCPs) and community members we serve. We are proud to work alongside them every step of the way.

Our employees are our greatest asset, and we're expanding across functions during this pivotal time. We invite you to join us in making an impact—and making history.**We all share the most important goal of bringing solutions to the PWS community.**

The Sr. Manager, Marketing will lead the development and execution of HCP marketing strategies to support Soleno/Neurocrine’s growth objectives in rare endocrine diseases. This role focuses on engaging centers of excellence, specialists, high-volume endocrinologists, and key opinion leaders (KOLs) through insights-driven, brand-aligned initiatives.

Key responsibilities include developing disease state education and promotional materials, enabling the sales force, managing KOL relationships, and leading brand presence at major conferences and congresses. ### **BUILT ON FLAVOR. FUELED BY PEOPLE.**

What's it like to work at Kinder's? Well, there's a lot of snacking and geeking out over what we all cooked over the weekend. Beyond that, there's also plenty of hard work. Because we don't just like flavor, we're obsessed with it.

With over 100 products sold nationwide, we're now a top-five brand in multiple flavor categories at Costco, Walmart, Whole Foods, and more. We're not your typical CPG company. Privately held and founder-led, we like to think of ourselves as a pirate ship in a sea of cruise ships. Our crew is adventurous and fearless. We chart our own course and chase big ideas to make food unforgettable.

As we expand globally and approach $1 billion in revenue, we need more smart-and-scrappy, flavor-obsessed people to come aboard. If you're looking for a place where you can see the real impact of your work... **this is it!** Every day, you'll be part of a journey to add flavor to millions of meals and lives.

### **About the Role:**

The Senior Digital Experience Manager will lead the strategy and performance of Kinder's owned digital consumer experience, with responsibility for strategy, ecommerce, CRM/email, and content**.**

This role sits at the intersection of brand, consumer experience, content, and commerce. The Senior Digital Experience Manager will define how Kinder's shows up across its owned digital channels and build experiences that turn consumer interest into deeper engagement, purchase, and long-term brand relationships.

This role will oversee the Kinder's ecommerce business and partner closely with the team responsible for marketing technology, website capabilities, and digital merchandising. The Senior Digital Experience Manager will also lead Kinder's digital content strategy, including managing the team member responsible for culinary content.

The ideal candidate combines strong consumer instincts with commercial acumen. They understand how content, CRM, ecommerce, and digital experiences work together and are equally comfortable developing a strategy, analyzing performance, leading a team, and working cross-functionally to bring ideas to life.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

#### **Digital Consumer Experience**

* Define the vision and strategy for the Kinder's owned digital consumer experience, with Kinders.com serving as a central destination for product discovery, culinary inspiration, brand engagement, and commerce.

* Define business and consumer requirements for new website experiences and capabilities, partnering with the marketing technology and merchandising teams on implementation.
* Use consumer behavior, analytics, and testing to continuously improve the digital experience.
* Ensure Kinder's digital channels effectively support major campaigns, product launches, and seasonal moments.

#### **Ecommerce & Digital Commerce**

* Own the strategy and performance for the Kinder's direct-to-consumer ecommerce business.
* Develop the commercial strategy for DTC, including assortment priorities, promotions, bundles, and gifting.
* Partner closely with the team responsible for ecommerce technology, product catalog management, and site merchandising to execute against business priorities.
* Identify opportunities to improve conversion, average order value, repeat purchase, and customer lifetime value.
* Develop strategies that connect digital product discovery with purchase, whether through Kinders.com, retail partners, or other digital commerce channels.

* Establish ecommerce forecasts, KPIs, and reporting, and regularly communicate performance and opportunities to key stakeholders.

Job Title: MVA Lead Generation Senior Media Buyer

  

I want to hire you… and pay you a lot of money.

But this role isn't for most media buyers.

If you're a senior media buyer based in the U.S. who is already actively managing accounts spending **7 figures per month on Meta and/or Google**, keep reading.

Because if you're genuinely elite at media buying, obsessed with performance, and want to operate at a scale where small improvements can have massive impact, this could be the opportunity you're looking for.

  

We operate at serious scale.

You'll be working across **7-figure monthly advertising budgets**, multiple platforms, multiple states and markets, and a creative operation capable of producing and testing a massive volume of new ads.

We don't need someone to simply maintain what we've built.

**We want someone who can help us make it significantly better.**

**The Role**
------------

This is not a traditional media buyer role.

We don't need someone who waits for instructions, adjusts budgets, turns off bad ads, and calls it media buying.

And we definitely don't need someone who requires leadership to constantly tell them where the next opportunity is.

We're looking for someone who can take **real ownership over performance.**

Someone who can look across Meta, Google, states, campaigns, and hundreds of creatives and quickly determine:

* Where should we spend more?
* Where should we spend less?
* What's starting to work that we haven't fully capitalized on yet?
* Why is this state underperforming?
* What winning ads haven't we expanded yet?
* What creative are we missing?
* What should we test next?

Then actually execute.

You won't just optimize campaigns.

You'll help determine **where the next level of growth comes from.**

**What You'll Actually Own**
----------------------------

### **1. Performance & Scaling**

* You'll help manage and optimize high-spend campaigns across **Meta and Google**, including YouTube, Search, and Performance Max.
* You'll continuously look across platforms and states to identify:

* Scaling opportunities
* Budget reallocation opportunities
* Performance inefficiencies
* Underperforming markets
* Testing gaps
* New strategies worth implementing

We expect you to understand where our money is going, what it's producing, and where the next dollar should be spent.

You'll work with other media buyers and leadership on cross-platform and state-level budget strategy to hit our volume and profitability goals.

### **2. Creative Expansion**

At our scale, media buying and creative strategy cannot operate separately.

You'll know our best-performing ads.

You'll know our best-performing angles.

You'll know which concepts are starting to gain traction.

And you'll make sure we capitalize on them.

That means constantly thinking:

**“This is working here why aren't we running it here, here, and here?”**

**“This angle is crushing on Meta let's test it on YouTube.”**

**“This state-specific concept is working let's build it for every relevant market.”**

**“We're relying too heavily on UGC here let's expand our creative diversity.”**

**“This angle is starting to work creative team needs to build 10 more variations before everyone else catches it.”**

You'll bridge the gap between **performance data and the creative team.**

The creative team should always know what's working, what's starting to work, what's getting fatigued, and what we need more of.

### **3. Underperforming Markets**

When a state isn't producing enough volume, your job isn't simply to say:

*"Performance is bad."*

Your job is to figure out **why.**

Is it creative?

Campaign structure?

Budget allocation?

Lack of creative diversity?

A winning angle we haven't brought over from another market?

Platform mix?

Audience?

Offer?

Landing page?

Then build and execute a plan to improve it.

We want problem solvers, not reporters.

You'll help own the operational side of running ad

jobs.title: Global Senior Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
As a Global Senior Marketing Manager at Lexington Medical, you will shape how surgeons and hospitals see our AEON surgical stapling portfolio, from messaging and launches to the website. Working closely with the CEO and commercial leadership, you will turn marketing direction into campaigns, launch programs, and sales tools for a business that sells in over 40 countries.

**About Lexington Medical**

Lexington Medical is a growing medical device company designing, manufacturing, and commercializing surgical stapling technology. Our AEON Endoscopic Stapler is an FDA-cleared, minimally invasive surgical stapler, developed and manufactured at our headquarters in Bedford, Massachusetts. Our teams are intentionally small, which gives you broad ownership and ability to move quick. In this role, you'll have a meaningful impact on the organization and a close connection to the products and our customers.

**About the Role**

As a Global Senior Marketing Manager at Lexington Medical, you will support global marketing for the AEON portfolio day to day: how our products are positioned, what we say to surgeons and hospitals, how we launch, and how we show up online and in front of customers. You will bring customer and competitive insight into those conversations, then turn the direction into messaging, launch programs, digital campaigns, and the tools regional sales teams and distributors use every day.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and execute the global marketing plan, translating strategic direction into positioning, messaging frameworks, and market by market priorities across the U.S., Europe, and international markets.
* Develop and maintain AEON positioning and the core value story, and keep it consistent across sales materials, the website, digital channels, and trade shows.
* Gather voice of customer insight from surgeons, OR staff, and hospital value analysis stakeholders, and track competitor messaging, so leadership, sales, and R&D hear what the market is saying.
* Coordinate global product launches, building the launch plan and keeping regulatory, quality, supply chain, clinical training, and sales readiness on schedule in each market.
* Develop the global marketing toolkit (value story, clinical evidence summaries, launch kits, training content) that regional sales teams and distribution partners adapt locally.
* Own digital marketing through agencies, contractors, and freelancers, including the website, SEO and AI search visibility, LinkedIn, and digital campaigns: set priorities, manage scope and budget, and hold vendors to quality and deadlines.
* Plan Lexington's presence at surgical conferences and trade shows, and take on special marketing projects for the CEO and commercial leadership as priorities shift.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, life sciences, or a related field.
* 4 to 7 years of experience in marketing or product marketing; medical device or healthcare experience, an MBA, surgical or OR exposure, or experience marketing in international or distributor markets is a plus.
* Experience developing positioning and messaging and bringing it to market through a product launch, campaign, or rebrand, including coordinating the cross-functional work behind it.
* Experience managing digital marketing agencies or contractors (website, SEO, social, or paid campaigns), with enough hands-on knowledge to direct the work and judge its quality.
* Excellent writing and a strong eye for content; you can turn a technical product story into clear, compelling messaging for surgeons, hospital buyers, and sales teams.
* Reliable follow-through with senior stakeholders, including the confidence to chase commitments from sales leaders and executives without losing the relationship.
* You use AI tools daily to move faster on research, drafting, and analysis, you know when to trust the output and when not to, and you have built at least one AI-assisted tool or workflow that you or your team relies on.

Build the growth engine. Own the function. Accelerate your career.

**LOCATION** Remote (Chicago Pref’d) **REPORTS TO** CEO  
**BASE SALARY** $130,000 to $150,000 **TARGET BONUS** 20%

**The Opportunity**

Guidant Power is looking for a high-potential B2B marketer ready to take the next major step in their career. This is a hands-on leadership opportunity to build and own the marketing function of a rapidly growing, private equity backed services company.

We are looking for a builder. You will own Guidant's lead generation engine, HubSpot, campaigns, marketing metrics, budget, agencies, and the process for creating qualified pipeline one and two quarters ahead of sales requirements. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with sales and operating leadership.

Why This Role Is Different

* You will own the marketing function, not one channel or a narrow piece of the funnel.
* You will work directly with the CEO and senior leadership on growth priorities, investment decisions, and performance.
* You will participate in Shore Capital's marketing cohort, sharing best practices and learning alongside marketers across a top 1% private equity firm’s portfolio.
* You will gain direct experience with organic growth, M&A integration, cross-sell programs, and the operating discipline of a rapidly scaling services platform.
* You will be judged on measurable business results, and success can lead to broader responsibility as Guidant grows.

**What You Will Own**

* Build the lead flow model required to support bookings goals, including how many leads and qualified opportunities Guidant needs and how far in advance they must be created.
* Create and manage integrated campaigns across email, paid media, social, events, conferences and trade shows, webinars, outbound BDR programs, SEO, and targeted accounts.
* Own the marketing calendar, campaign priorities, annual marketing plan, and budget.
* Oversee HubSpot implementation and operate HubSpot as Guidant's top-of-funnel platform for campaigns, lead scoring, qualification, workflows, attribution, and reporting.
* Build dashboards that show pipeline generated by source, funnel conversion, cost per qualified opportunity, campaign ROI, and pipeline coverage one and two quarters forward.
* Use qualitative market research with customers, prospects, salespeople, and technical experts to improve positioning, content, offers, and campaigns.
* Manage agencies, contractors, paid media partners, content resources, data vendors, and other outside resources for quality, cost, timing, and results.
* Support Guidant's M&A strategy by helping integrate acquired companies into Guidant's marketing systems, processes, brand, and cross-sell programs.

**Who We Are Looking For**

You do not need to have already led an entire marketing function. This role may be particularly attractive to someone who is ready for broader ownership and accountability.

* 5 or more years of progressive B2B marketing experience, with a record of increasing responsibility and strong business results.
* Demonstrated success personally building and executing demand generation programs that create qualified opportunities and pipeline.
* Strong hands-on experience with HubSpot or a comparable marketing automation platform, with enough technical understanding to build workflows, reporting, and campaigns and manage outside implementation resources.
* A strong marketing foundation across segmentation, positioning, customer acquisition, qualitative market research, content, SEO, paid media, social, email, events, and account-based marketing.
* Comfort working with data, funnel metrics, attribution, campaign measurement, budgets, and reporting that connects marketing investment to pipeline and revenue.
* The judgment and communication skills to work effectively with sales, operations, technical experts, outside partners, and senior leadership.

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

* Ambitious builder: energized by creating something

jobs.title: Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
Berry Street is building on the convergence of AI, GLP-1s, and the consumerization of healthcare — while leveraging insurance to make life-changing metabolic care as accessible as possible for all. Our platform connects patients with 2,000+ clinicians and AI tools to treat obesity, diabetes/prediabetes, cardiovascular disease, kidney disease, maternal health, and dozens of other chronic and acute conditions, working with major health plans, health systems, and care management companies across all 50 states.

We launched in 2023, have served hundreds of thousands of patients, and are Series B — backed by investors like Khosla, Northzone, FJ Labs, and the founders of Revolut, Grow Therapy, and Spring Health.

About the Role

Lifecycle marketing is how we turn first-touch interest into lasting care outcomes. Every week, our email, SMS, and push programs reach hundreds of thousands of patients, guiding them from first interest to a booked visit, from booking to showing up, and from that first visit to coming back again and again. Everything that happens in between those steps is where lifecycle wins or loses. And no two journeys look the same: patients arrive through different channels and partnerships, and choose between offerings like nutrition therapy, GLP-1s, or both together. Our lifecycle program has to meet each of them with the right message at the right moment.

We’re looking for a senior lifecycle marketer to fully own this program: strategy, journey design, build, testing, and the engineering roadmap behind it. Lifecycle runs fully in-house in Customer.io, and you’ll partner with Growth, Product, Engineering, Data, and CX to ship, learn, and scale what works. Patient comms are the heart of the role; a smaller share goes to provider-facing comms with Provider Ops.

What You'll Do

* **Own the lifecycle strategy** for patients across the full journey: lead to booking, booking to attended visit, and first visit to long-term retention and win-back. Translate strategy into roadmaps and test plans for each audience, offering, and partnership.
* **Build and launch automated journeys** in Customer.io for every step in between, with the messages, branches, and fallbacks that move each patient forward based on their offering, how they found us, and where they are in their care.
* **Manage our ESP end-to-end** — including data schema, event and attribute mapping, segmentation, deliverability, UTM governance, and error handling.
* **Own the lifecycle engineering roadmap:** write the tickets, prioritize them with Product & Engineering, and ensure clean data ingestion into Customer.io, cohort tagging, and alignment with downstream analytics tools.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
The Team + The Role

Pendo's Product Marketing team translates what we build into why it matters. The team works at the intersection of product, revenue, and marketing, owning the narratives, positioning, and go-to-market motions that drive pipeline and commercial outcomes. It operates as a small, senior team with high ownership, low overhead, and a strong bias toward work that moves the business forward.

Pendo is looking for a Sr. Product Marketing Manager to play a key role in our growing Enterprise business. You will partner closely across Product, Sales, and Marketing to package and position Pendo's offerings as powerful solutions for Enterprise clients. This is an individual contributor role for a builder who can create, test, adapt, and make an immediate impact in a fast-moving, AI-native environment.

This is a remote role in the United States. We have offices in San Francisco, CA, Raleigh, NC, or New York, NY.

What this looks like day-to-day

  • Enterprise positioning: Own and maintain clear, concise, and impactful solutions messaging for the Enterprise market. Translate Pendo's product capabilities into value-driven narratives that resonate with Enterprise buyers.
  • Cross-functional partnership: Collaborate strategically with Product, PMM, Sales, and Marketing teams to package and position Pendo's offerings for Enterprise clients. Serve as a key conduit between Enterprise go-to-market teams and Product by bringing field feedback into product conversations.
  • Flexible execution: Move fluidly across adjacent work as priorities shift, including solutions marketing, growth-hacker-style experiments, and demand-gen support. Adapt quickly rather than staying in a single fixed lane.
  • AI-enabled GTM: Leverage AI tools and workflows, including building agents, to accelerate research, content creation, and go-to-market execution. Use AI as a practical multiplier for how you work and what you ship.
  • Market research: Conduct in-depth research to define, understand, and articulate the distinct needs and opportunities within the Enterprise landscape for Pendo. Use that insight to shape messaging, campaign direction, and sales conversations.
  • Sales partnership: Forge strong partnerships with the Enterprise Sales team to understand their requirements, challenges, and revenue opportunities. Participate in strategic Enterprise deals by providing product and solutions expertise.
  • Testing and iteration: Rapidly test, learn, and adapt messaging and campaigns in a fast-changing environment. Use feedback from the market, Sales, and Product to improve the work quickly.
  • Enterprise content: Develop compelling content and collateral for Enterprise audiences, including presentations, white papers, and case studies. Ensure materials are clear, persuasive, and aligned to the needs of Enterprise buyers.
  • Enterprise strategy support: Elevate and accelerate Pendo's overall Enterprise marketing strategy and execution. Contribute strategically to competitive intelligence, pricing considerations, and enablement programs tailored for the Enterprise market.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

Partnering with Business Development and Capture, this role builds visibility with agencies, primes, and teaming partners and converts it into qualified pipeline.

**Who We Are & What We Do…**

At STI Federal, we drive growth through strategic government contracting, fulfilling our mission to support the Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians. Our company reinvests 100% of its profits into tribal businesses or community programs, enhancing the well-being of over 52,000 tribal citizens. Our work empowers federal agencies and strengthens some of the nation’s most critical initiatives, while fostering opportunities for skilled professionals to make a meaningful impact.

**What You’ll Do…**

**Growth Strategy & Business Development Alignment**

* Partner with Business Development and Capture leadership to build and execute an annual growth marketing plan aligned to target agencies, priority pursuits, contract vehicles, and the recompete calendar.
* Translate the opportunity pipeline into account-based campaigns aimed at specific agency program offices, contracting activities, OSDBU offices, and large-prime teaming partners.
* Position STI Federal’s tribally owned status, socioeconomic designations, and differentiators in market-facing messaging that supports set-aside, direct-award, and teaming strategies where applicable.

* Measure and report event performance (meetings secured, qualified contacts, teaming conversations initiated, and opportunities influenced) to inform future event investment decisions.

**Booth, Exhibit & Collateral Operations**

* Own end-to-end exhibit execution: registration, booth space selection, exhibitor deadlines, shipping and drayage, electrical and internet orders, and on-site setup and teardown.
* Order, design, and maintain conference booth materials and inventory, including backdrops, banners, table throws, displays, signage, lead-capture tools, and branded promotional items, in alignment with brand standards.

* Ensure promotional items, hospitality, and event engagement with government personnel comply with federal ethics and gift rules.

**Capture & Proposal Marketing Support**

**Senior Social Media Manager**

**Blazy Susan | Marketing Department**

**About the Role**

Blazy Susan is looking for a highly creative, trend-obsessed, and results-driven **Senior Social Media Manager** to lead our social media strategy and take our content to the next level.

We're looking for someone who lives and breathes social media, knows what makes content go viral, and has the creative instincts and production skills to bring ideas to life.

This isn't a role for someone who just manages a content calendar. We want a **hands-on creative leader** who can conceptualize, shoot, edit, and publish engaging content while also managing our social media team, creator relationships, and ambassador programs.

The ideal candidate blends creative storytelling with strategic thinking. You know how to identify emerging trends, translate cultural moments into brand-relevant content, and build an engaged community. You're equally comfortable developing a long-term social strategy, directing a content shoot, and jumping in front of or behind the camera to capture something spontaneous.

You'll play a critical role in shaping Blazy Susan's digital presence, expanding our reach beyond our core audience, and building a social content engine that drives brand awareness, engagement, and measurable growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Content Creation & Creative Direction**

* Lead the ideation, production, and execution of engaging, original content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
* Personally shoot, edit, and produce high-quality short-form video, photography, and social-first content on a consistent basis.
* Develop creative concepts for Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts, product launches, brand collaborations, and ongoing social campaigns.
* Establish and maintain a reliable in-house content production process that consistently delivers fresh, engaging content.
* Identify emerging social trends, viral formats, audio, memes, and cultural conversations, quickly translating them into relevant content for the brand.
* Direct content shoots, including creative planning, shot lists, talent coordination, production, and editing.
* Collaborate with internal creative, marketing, and product teams to bring campaigns and launches to life.
* Capture behind-the-scenes content, team culture, events, product demonstrations, lifestyle content, and other spontaneous brand moments.
* Experiment with new formats, creative approaches, and storytelling techniques to identify opportunities for organic growth.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity while continuously pushing creative boundaries.

**Social Media Strategy & Growth**

* Own and execute the overarching organic social media strategy across all brand platforms.
* Develop platform-specific content strategies designed to maximize reach, engagement, follower growth, and brand awareness.
* Build and maintain editorial calendars that balance planned campaigns, evergreen content, and reactive trend-based opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to grow the brand's audience beyond its existing customer base through culture, entertainment, lifestyle, and strategic partnerships.
* Establish and manage KPIs for content performance, engagement, audience growth, and social-driven traffic.
* Regularly analyze performance metrics to identify winning content formats and optimize future creative.
* Monitor competitors, emerging brands, and evolving platform algorithms to keep Blazy Susan ahead of the curve.
* Navigate platform-specific content restrictions and community guidelines creatively, particularly within the cannabis accessories industry.
* Work closely with broader marketing leadership to align social initiatives with company goals and major brand campaigns.

**Creator, Influencer & Ambassador Programs**

* Lead the development, management, and expansion of Blazy Susan's influencer, creator, and brand ambassador programs.
* Identify and recruit creators

You'll set the brand's direction, run agency partners, steer packaging development, and build the launch activation and marketing plan. This is a build-it role: you'll be the senior marketer in the room, working side by side with operations, R&D, quality, sales, and finance at the client's Buffalo-area facility.

**Brand Strategy**

* Define and own brand positioning, architecture, target consumer, and value proposition, grounded in consumer, category, and competitive insight.
* Build the annual brand plan, KPIs, and marketing budget; track spend and report on ROI.
* Serve as the brand's guardian, ensuring every touchpoint is consistent with brand identity and standards.

**Agency Relationships**

* Lead creative, design, digital/social, PR, and research agencies: write briefs, run creative reviews, manage scopes, timelines, and budgets.
* Hold agencies accountable to on-strategy, on-time, on-budget delivery; recommend changes to the agency roster as needs evolve.

* Partner with Sales and Finance to set pricing, pack/price architecture, channel strategy, and go-to-market priorities.
* Build sell-in materials and selling stories for retail, distributor, and foodservice customers.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Operations Analyst
jobs.desc:
**Who are we?**

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

**About the role**

Smarsh is looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to build the data foundation that marketing and go-to-market (GTM) teams run on — and that our AI tools will increasingly depend on. AI assistants and agents can only answer revenue questions reliably when the data model beneath them is clean, governed, and well defined. This role owns that layer for marketing: from source-system connectors and Snowflake, through dbt models and a governed semantic layer, to the dashboards, analysis, and AI-driven insight that leadership uses to make decisions.

You'll set the measurement and data roadmap, not just execute against it. You'll partner with Marketing Operations, Demand Generation, Sales/Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and IT/Data Architecture, and you'll be a trusted analytical partner to marketing and GTM leadership on planning, pipeline, and growth strategy.

### **How will you contribute?**

**AI-ready data foundation**

* Design and build an AI-ready data foundation for marketing and GTM: governed dbt models and a semantic layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Omni) with consistent metric definitions that both people and AI tools can query.
* Prioritize foundation domains in partnership with RevOps and IT — starting with marketing performance and attribution, and connecting to pipeline, account hierarchy, and customer retention data.
* Build validation and testing frameworks (data tests, reconciliation checks, and accuracy evaluation of AI-generated answers) so AI assistants and agents return answers leadership can trust.
* Partner with Marketing Operations and IT to deploy and improve AI tools (e.g., Claude, BI-native AI agents) that answer recurring marketing and pipeline questions in a self-serve way.

**Data architecture & engineering**

* Own the marketing data architecture end to end: source-system connectors, ingestion into Snowflake, transformation logic, orchestration, and curated data models.
* Build and maintain reliable pipelines (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, Marketo Measure/Bizible, ABM, Google/LinkedIn/Bing Ads, sales engagement platforms) using ELT and orchestration tooling such as Fivetran and Airflow, with monitoring and documented SLAs.
* Model account hierarchies and lead-to-account matching so marketing engagement rolls up correctly to accounts, buying groups, and opportunities.

**Measurement, attribution & analytics**

* Own the design, governance, and evolution of marketing attribution (W-Shaped, Custom Model, and account-level influence), including documenting assumptions and limitations.
* Lead ABM measurement: account engagement scoring, buying-group coverage, intent-to-pipeline conversion, and target-account progression.
* Go beyond descriptive reporting — apply cohort analysis, funnel velocity, incrementality/test-and-control design, and forecasting to answer "what's working, and what should we do next?"
* Analyze campaign and channel performance (organic search, paid search, paid social/ABM, display, email, events, field) and deliver prioritized recommendations on budget and program mix.

**Strategy, reporting & stakeholder leadership**

* Partner with marketing and GTM leadership on annual planning, pipeline targets and coverage, growth strategy, and operating cadences, bringing the analysis that grounds those decisions.
* Build and own executive-grade dashboar

jobs.title: Senior Paid Social Manager
jobs.desc:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
*

jobs.title: Senior Copywriter (Direct Response)
jobs.desc:
We're looking for a direct response copywriter who can own messaging strategy across a client pod in our info/coaching marketing agency.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional pod alongside a strategist, media buyer, and PM - writing ad scripts, funnel copy, emails, webinars, and sales pages for clients spending $100k-$1M+ monthly on ads. You'll also be participating in creative strategy alongside your team - analyzing what's working, deciding what to iterate on, and bringing ideas backed by reasoning, not just executing what you're handed.

This is not an order-taker role. You won't be waiting for someone to hand you a brief and tell you exactly what to write. You'll be reviewing performance data, understanding why winners win, and coming to creative strategy calls with "here's what we should test and why" - not just "ready for my next assignment."

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* You come to creative strategy calls with prepared ideas and hypotheses - not just ready to receive direction
* You can explain *why* a winning ad works (awareness level, belief shift, lead type) - not just *that* it works
* Your first drafts are close to final - strategists aren't rewriting your copy, they're refining it
* You know what's winning and losing across your clients without being asked
* Iterations are based on insight (what belief shift is landing, what objection we're not handling) - not surface-level changes (let's try a different hook)
* The strategist trusts you to lead on messaging and creative concepts so they can focus on client relationships and offer strategy
* Your avatar docs and messaging foundations are useful references the whole team pulls from - not boxes you filled in to complete a task

**A Day In This Role**
----------------------

**Morning:** Check the creative tracker for your clients. What launched? What's testing? Any winners or losers from the last batch? Review any feedback or revision requests that came in overnight.

**Writing blocks:** The bulk of your day is writing - ad scripts, body copy, emails, funnel pages, or long-form projects like webinars or VSLs. You're working from briefs you helped shape, not briefs handed to you fully formed.

**Creative strategy calls:** Weekly with your pod. You come prepared with analysis: what's working, what's not, what we should iterate on, what net-new concepts are worth testing. You leave with a plan for what's needed and why.

**Throughout the day:**

* Fill out creative briefs with the strategic reasoning (idea, angle, awareness level, lead type, variation) - not just the copy itself
* Update the creative tracker with your batch details before submitting for review
* Collaborate with your strategist on messaging direction, offer positioning, and funnel improvements
* Coordinate with creative leads on video scripts and static direction

**End of day:** You can answer: What's the status of my active batches? What's winning/losing for each client? What's next and why?

**Experience & Requirements**
-----------------------------

* 3+ years of direct response copywriting experience; info/coaching space strongly preferred
* Deep understanding of awareness levels, belief shifts, and long-form persuasion structures (not just short-form social copy)
* Experience writing across formats: ad scripts, body copy, emails, sales pages, webinars/VSLs
* Ability to analyze creative performance and iterate intelligently - not just "try something different"
* Strong grasp of avatar psychology and offer positioning - you understand *why* messaging works, not just *what* to write
* Comfortable working within structured systems (creative trackers, naming conventions, brief templates)
* Can take loose direction ("we need to test a new angle for this audience segment") and return with developed concepts backed by reasoning

**What This Role Is Not**
-------------------------

**Not word-outputting.** Writing without understanding the strategy behind it - the offer

This role focuses on strategy execution, operational excellence, and cross-functional collaboration, translating business objectives into actionable marketing plans.

**1. Brand Strategy and Positioning**

Develop and execute a compelling brand strategy that communicates our brand's unique value proposition, positioning, and identity. Ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints and products.

**2. Product Launches and Campaigns**

Lead the planning and execution of product launches, seasonal campaigns, and marketing initiatives. Create captivating storytelling and engaging content to drive excitement and sales.

**3. Digital and E-commerce Marketing**

Oversee all digital marketing efforts, including website optimization, SEO/SEM, social media, email marketing, and influencer partnerships. Leverage digital channels to increase brand awareness and drive online sales.

Conduct market research and consumer insights analysis to understand customer preferences, industry trends, and competitive landscapes. Utilize findings to inform marketing strategies and product development.

**6. Team Leadership and Development**

**8. Public Relations and Media Relations**

**9. Data Analysis and Reporting**

**10. Go-To-Market Strategy Execution**

Partner closely with Sales, E-commerce, and Finance teams to align marketing initiatives with revenue targets, margin goals, and inventory strategies.

ColourPop is all about accessible, trend-driven beauty that moves at the speed of culture. Known for rapid launches, viral moments, and a passionate community, we create high-quality, cruelty-free products that bring what’s next in beauty to our fans first. As part of the Seed Beauty family, we redefine what it means to innovate fast — and have fun doing it.

This role is for the rare person who lives at the intersection of brand, growth, and creative. Part cultural tastemaker, part growth strategist. You spot trends before they have names. You build narratives that make people feel something — and then you back them up with the numbers that prove it worked. You're equally at home in a creative brief and a channel performance review, and you know that the best marketing is a hybrid of both.  
  
ColourPop is a bold, boundary-pushing beauty brand with one of the most devoted communities in the industry — and we've built that by being audacious enough to move first, and conviction-led enough to see it through. The Sr. Brand Marketing Manager is the person who keeps that edge sharp: translating brand obsession into go-to-market strategy, shaping stories that ignite our community across social, influencer, PR, paid, and retail, and driving accountability across every channel we touch. You're building something category-defying from the inside out. We need someone obsessed with beauty and the community around it, and hungry to push this brand further than it's ever been. If you're the kind of person who sees a whitespace before anyone else does and can't wait to fill it, this is your role.

* **Go-to-Market Leadership.** Lead and support end-to-end GTM strategy for key franchise and innovation launches — from positioning and campaign platform through retailer execution and post-launch performance reporting.

* **Infrastructure & Playbooks.** Build the launch frameworks that scale. If a process doesn't exist and it should, create it — no waiting, no hiding behind 'that's not my job.'
* **Multi-Hat Mentality.** You don't clock out at the edge of your role. When something needs to get done, you do it — and you're energized by the range, not depleted by it.
* **Senior Stakeholder Presence.** Run briefings that align cross-functional teams fast. Influence without authority. Move people, not just decks.

At Justworks, you'll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We're helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We're data-driven and never stop iterating. Our Values

------------------

Customer Lifecycle Marketing (CLM) is responsible for engaging and nurturing customers through their entire lifecycle and across the Justworks platform. The function plays a critical role in growing Justworks' business by helping to grow the number of customers on the platform, increasing their lifecycle value, and lengthening the amount of time they remain customers. CLM does this by designing and managing the flows and sequences that ensure customers receive the right message on the right channel for where they are in their journey.

OpenArt is a gen AI creative platform used by millions worldwide. We’re building the next generation of creative tools powered by cutting-edge AI, enabling anyone to create videos, images, visuals, characters, and stories with unprecedented speed and imagination.

At Neighbor, we're building the largest hyperlocal storage and parking marketplace in the world. We've raised over $75 million from top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz and the CEOs of DoorDash, StockX, and Uber. Our marketplace operates in all 50 states, and we're just getting started.

### **About the Role**

Neighbor is hiring a Head of Performance Marketing to own paid acquisition across our marketplace and scale revenue at efficient returns. This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll work directly with our VP of Marketing and lead a team of three paid performance leads (one each for item storage, vehicle, and supply) to execute, scale, and systematize paid growth.

You'll thrive here if you're a scrappy executor who's as comfortable running Meta campaigns as building forecasts, partnering with the Data team on attribution, and coaching your team. You'll own paid like your own P&L: setting budgets by channel and vertical, owning ROAS and revenue targets, and deciding where the next dollar goes as our budget continues to scale.

Because Neighbor is a two-sided marketplace with dozens of use cases, paid here is a constant flow of persona and theme tests rather than one evergreen campaign. On any given week, the team might be testing classic car storage creative on Meta, capturing high-intent parking searches in New York City on Google, and running home-organizer creator ads for self storage, all while preparing for seasonal peaks like RV and trailer storage. You'll also lead our push up-funnel into CTV and other offline channels, working with media partners and our Data team to measure what's incremental.

This is a high-ownership role at a company disrupting a $500B industry. If you think in numbers and systems and want to build the performance marketing engine for a marketplace that's just getting started, this role could be for you.

### **Key Areas of Accountability**

**Performance Marketing & Media Buying**

* Own paid acquisition performance end to end across renter and host demand, with direct accountability for ROAS and revenue growth
* Stay hands-on steering our accounts: architecture, audiences, bidding, budget pacing, and optimizations
* Set channel strategy across Meta, Google, and emerging paid platforms, scaling winners and cutting what isn't working quickly

**Creative Strategy & Funnel Optimization**

* Partner with our Creative team on a high-velocity testing pipeline, using performance data to define direct-response creative briefs and new personas and themes to test
* Partner with vertical product managers on landing page and conversion testing, while running your own paid-only tests
* Identify fatiguing ads and audiences early and keep a steady flow of fresh bets in market

**Offline & Upper-Funnel Expansion**

* Launch and scale CTV, remnant TV, direct mail, and other offline channels, working directly with media partners on planning and execution
* Build testing roadmaps for new channels and prove their impact through geo holdouts, on/off tests, and incrementality reads
* Partner with our Data team on media mix modeling and multi-touch attribution, and use the outputs to reallocate spend

**Budgeting & Forecasting**

* Own the paid P&L: set and manage budgets by channel and vertical in partnership with Finance
* Build performance forecasts, goals, and OKRs, and lead quarterly planning around seasonality so launches are ready before demand peaks
* Deliver clear performance reporting and budget recommendations to marketing and company leadership

**Team & Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Lead and coach three paid performance leads (item storage, vehicle, and supply), raising the bar on speed, rigor, and results
* Partner with Data on conversion tracking and dashboards so every paid channel is measured with confidence
* Partner with Lifecycle and Sales to turn host leads generated by paid into closed supply

jobs.desc:
**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced digital marketing professional to lead paid media strategy, product feed management, and conversion optimization across a portfolio of high-SKU ecommerce accounts. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Google Ads (Shopping and Performance Max), Google Merchant Center management, and technical SEO for large product catalogs.

**The Role**

You'll own paid media strategy and execution across a book of ecommerce accounts: Google Ads (Shopping, Performance Max, Search, PMax asset groups), Google Merchant Center health, accuracy and Store Quality score, feed quality, and the SEO/UX work that makes the traffic convert.

**What You'll Do**

**Paid media**

* Build, launch, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Performance Max, Shopping, Search, and remarketing for high-SKU parts and accessories catalogs
* Own budget pacing, bid strategy, and ROAS targets at both the account and program level, including OEM co-op and ad-credit ramp periods
* Diagnose performance shifts with discipline — separate auction and traffic-quality problems from feed, query-mix, creative, and post-click problems

**Merchant Center & feeds**

* Own GMC account health: policy violations, item-level diagnostics, and pre-emptive account monitoring and auditing
* Lead Misrepresentation suspension prevention and remediation — trust signals, contact and policy page consistency, domain and branding red flags, and appeal documentation
* Manage and optimize large product feeds (50k–500k+ SKUs): title and attribute structure, data quality, fitment data, category and product-type taxonomy, supplemental feeds, and feed rules
* Work across platform feed sources — RevolutionParts, Shopify, BigCommerce, Magento — and third-party feed/catalog tools

**SEO & UX**

* Drive technical and on-page SEO for large catalogs: indexation strategy, internal linking, structured data, and Core Web Vitals
* Identify and push UX and CRO improvements on storefronts — cart and checkout friction, mobile performance, and LCP priority
* Partner with the team to get fixes implemented, and QA them

**What We're Looking For**

**Required**

* 4+ years managing Google Ads / PPC for ecommerce (6+ for the Director level), with meaningful Shopping and Performance Max ownership
* Hands-on Google Merchant Center expertise — you've fixed disapprovals and dealt with account suspensions
* Direct experience with Misrepresentation suspensions: you know the common triggers, how to document a site for review, and how to write an appeal that gets accepted
* Proven work with large product feeds (5,000+ SKUs minimum), including feed rules, supplemental feeds, and attribute optimization at scale
* Working knowledge of at least one of Shopify, BigCommerce, or Magento — ideally more than one
* Strong analytics fluency: GA4, GTM, spreadsheet modeling, and the ability to build a defensible case from data
* A genuine self-starter who is organized enough to hold dozens of accounts and project deadlines

**Strongly preferred**

* Automotive, powersports, or aftermarket parts experience — OEM dealer parts ecommerce, fitment data, or catalog/ACES-PIES familiarity
* Technical SEO experience
* Experience with RevolutionParts, SimplePart, Turn 14, or comparable parts-industry platforms
* Comfort with light scripting or automation (Google Ads scripts, Apps Script, Python) to handle scale
* Multi-account or agency experience where you managed a portfolio, not a single brand
* Google Ads and GA4 certifications

**Why This Role**

* Real ownership — you set the strategy on your accounts
* Complex, technical work with catalogs and compliance problems most marketers never touch
* Direct exposure to OEM programs and national brands
* Clear growth path as the portfolio grows

**Benefits & our commitment to you**

* Competitive Compensation
* Startup work environment
* 100% Remote
* 401k with match
* Unlimited PTO — We prefer to track productivity, not days off

Square One is a growing real estate media company, and we're looking for an experienced marketer who wants to do more than manage campaigns, schedule social media posts, and report on analytics.

We're looking for someone who wants to **build**.

We've built a successful business helping real estate professionals market themselves and their properties through photography, video, social content, and other creative services. Today, we serve more than 1,000 customers annually across multiple markets.

Now we're ready for our next chapter.

We want someone who can take ownership of our existing marketing efforts, help us become a smarter and more effective marketing organization, and ultimately help us develop an entirely new business line.

This is a unique opportunity to join an established company with an existing customer base, resources, and infrastructure—and have the freedom to help create something new.

**The Opportunity**

This position has two major missions.

1. Own and Grow Square One's Marketing

You'll take the lead on marketing for Square One across our growing network of markets.

We already have marketing channels, campaigns, systems, and a team of virtual assistants helping execute our efforts. We need someone who can bring strategy, leadership, creativity, and accountability to the entire operation.

Your responsibilities will include:

Square One creates great marketing content for real estate professionals. But we've recognized a larger problem: many of our customers don't have the time, resources, or expertise to consistently put that content to work.

**Director, Performance Media**

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director, Performance Media leads BMG360’s pay-per-performance media business and owns its P&L. This is a commercial leadership role as much as a media role: the group buys media at risk, is paid on delivered performance, and makes or loses money on the accuracy of its forecasting and the discipline of its buying. Reporting to the SVP, Performance, this leader runs the Performance Media team which includes two Managers and several Senior Analysts/ Analysts across traditional lead generation channels with digital being secondary. They are accountable for profitable volume: hitting client call and lead thresholds while protecting the margin on every buy, and for scaling the group through cross-sell, new bundle activation, and the right new business. The defining requirement is comfort with media risk. When the payment return is a call payout or a performance guarantee, the agency carries the financial exposure. This role owns that exposure.

SVP, Performance

2 Managers, Performance Media; Senior Analysts and Analysts

* Manage resource allocation and capacity planning to support current accounts and anticipated growth.
* Recruit, build, and train the team required to deploy these strategies at scale.
* Develop the two Managers into leaders who can run their books independently, and build a bench beneath them.

Seeking Health is a nutritional supplement company built on education. We help people understand their health, then direct them to the solutions that fit. When people are well informed, they choose well, and they stay with us for life.

We have grown 20% year over year, with $50M in total revenue across multiple channels, by putting scientific integrity and customer education ahead of typical marketing tactics.

* **Embrace Sudden Change:** There is no innovation if you operate out of fear of the new or untested.
* **Collaborative Effort:** Together, we minimize our individual weaknesses and amplify each other's strengths.

Drive $5-8M incremental DTC revenue, improve ROI 20%+ across channels, establish us as the go-to educational authority in our space, build a world-class marketing team, and create a scalable foundation for continued growth.

  

**What You’ll Do**

**Education-First Campaigns:** Turn complex nutritional science into clear education that helps people understand their health and find the right solution. Lead content across YouTube, blogs, guides, email and social, working with Dr. Lynch and the content team. Oversee SEO, email automation and paid media, which exist to bring educated people to our content.

**DTC Growth Leadership:** Own the P&L and growth plan for our $17M DTC business. Build financial models for CAC, LTV, channel contribution and margin. Set and hold a clear ROAS and CAC bar for every channel. Partner directly with the CEO on growth initiatives.

We can and package drinks for brand partners across Michigan and own and grow our own house brands.
