**HEAD OF CONTENT / DIGITAL MARKETING** (Fractional, 1099 Contract, DMV Local Only)  
*Blue Goose Solutions | Oxon Hill, MD*

Blue Goose Solutions is a marketing, communications, and events firm for nonprofits and mission driven organizations. We help them get found by people who already care about their work, then turn that attention into trust and funding. Our founder runs content strategy himself today, and we are looking for a proven content person to take it over.

We are open to a freelancer, a fractional lead, or the owner of a small shop. What matters to us is that one named person does the work, **lives in the DMV (DC, Maryland, or Northern Virginia)**, and has a track record of getting views.

**What you'll own**  
- You set content strategy for our clients and run the monthly strategy session with each one.  
- You grow views and followers on client accounts and on Blue Goose's own channels, and you report the numbers to the founder each month.  
- You approve scripts, posts, and content plans before anything goes to a client or a videographer.  
- You lead Blue Goose's own marketing, including our LinkedIn, our newsletter, and the founder's personal brand content.  
- You hire and direct our Marketing Operations Coordinator, with the founder signing off on your pick. They handle scheduling, files, and client follow up.  
- You join us in person in the DC area for monthly content shoot days, client sessions, and events.

**What we're looking for**  
- You have grown accounts before and can show us the numbers before and after.  
- You know short form video well enough to explain why one video gets watched and another gets skipped.  
- You can lead a client call on your own and explain your thinking in plain language.  
- You already run your work like a business, with your own tools, your own schedule, and other clients if you want them.  
- You live in the DMV, since this role is local only and includes in person days a few times a month. Experience with nonprofits, advocacy groups, or associations also helps.  
- It is a real plus if you can shoot and edit video yourself, though we do not require it.

**How the engagement works**  
- We start with a 3 month trial, with view and follower targets we agree on in the first week.  
- We check progress together at 30, 60, and 90 days, and a strong trial becomes an ongoing monthly retainer.  
- We plan content in monthly batches, film on a monthly shoot day, and keep posts scheduled one to two weeks ahead. AI tools handle much of our first drafting and research, so your time goes to direction and quality.

**Pay**  
- This is a 1099 contract that pays a flat $3,500 to $4,500 a month, based on your track record.  
- Most people would size this scope at about 20 hours a week, and you set your own schedule outside of client calls and shoot days.  
- Local travel to in person days is part of the scope and is not reimbursed.

**To apply, send a short note on why this fits you, links to two or three accounts or videos you grew with the numbers, and your availability to info@bluegoose.co.**

**The role**
------------

We're in the midst of the most important buildout in U.S. history, with large growth across energy, transmission, commercial/industrial, housing, and conservation + carbon. Land is the bottleneck for all of these efforts. Aarden is a purpose-built solution to understand, invest in, and get deals done for land-dependent assets.

While only 16 months old, we are already working with the most important landowners and developers in the country, and it's time for the world to know about us. That's where you come in.

As Head of Product Marketing, your job is to show the market how Aarden thinks about land, in public, every week, and use that as a launching point to make Aarden the most influential and important voice in land markets. When a hyperscaler announces a campus, a county passes a moratorium, or a timber owner sells a million acres, you'll use Aarden to figure out what it means within the broader market context, what owners and developers should be doing in response, and what new opportunities it creates. Aarden is used to help clients make decisions like this every day, and your job is to elevate these capabilities to a much broader audience.

Over time, we want Aarden (and its leadership) to be who people turn to when they want to understand how America's land is changing, and we want that attention to turn into conversations with the landowners, developers, and investors who make the world move.

**About Aarden**
----------------

Aarden is the origination and investment partner for people building on and making decisions about American land, starting with the landowners and developers behind the energy & data center buildouts. For institutional timber and farmland owners, that means helping them see what their land could become and how to value it. For developers, it means finding willing owners with viable sites before sinking months of time and capital into a site that faces significant headwinds. For everyone, it means understanding the environmental and social impacts of these important decisions.

Under the hood, our platform combines parcel data, ownership resolution, zoning, community sentiment, and price signals with suitability models and defensible investment analysis.

We're a Seattle-based team, growing quickly and founded in 2025, with expansion plans into NYC in 2027. Four of the ten largest U.S. landowners are already clients, and our committed clients cover roughly 14 million acres of high value land. We have a wonderful cohort of investors as well. Our $4m pre-seed was announced last year but our subsequent fundraising efforts remain undisclosed; you would help us announce this.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* **Hunt for stories.** Read the news every day across data centers, energy, timber, farmland, and land policy, and comment on key events that change land markets (there are a lot of these!).
* **Use Aarden to find the answer.** Work with Aarden technology to figure out what each event means, lay out the options it creates for owners and developers, and back it up with historical and present-day patterns. Our data team will support you in this work.
* **Build Aarden's following on LinkedIn and X.** Publish several times a week across the company's and leadership's channels, and grow those audiences. You'll develop your own voice along the way, too.
* **Tell client stories.** Highlight our clients' efforts and help them grow their businesses with case studies that show how the smartest investors in the country partner with Aarden to drive results for their funds.
* **Turn attention into pipeline.** The stories we tell should help more organizations see the clear benefits of partnering with Aarden.
* **Speak to both sides of the market.** Write for timber and farmland owners who are weighing alternative uses, and for data center developers who are quite literally racing to secure sites. Help each learn about the benefits of working with the other.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Director
jobs.desc:
nicity is a health intervention company. We connect people with the products, the app, and the community that together can genuinely change their health — starting with our yerba maté formulated to support fasting and a fibre drink that slows carb absorption at mealtime, brought together in the Feel Great program. Our customers don't just buy a supplement; they start a program that reshapes how they eat, how they feel, and how they live. That means the experience we build — from the first page someone lands on, through checkout, into the app, and across every week after — is what determines whether a customer actually transforms their health or drifts away.  
  
About the Role  
We're hiring a Director of Growth to own the entire e-commerce funnel, acquisition *and* retention - from a customer's first visit through checkout, first-purchase activation, and long-term repeat revenue. You'll lead two initiatives (Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle) and be accountable for how they work as one system rather than two silos handing customers back and forth.  
  
This is a builder-operator role, not a strategy-deck role. We want someone with hundreds of reps running structured experiments, who reads a funnel like a P&L, and who has personally shipped the tests, not just approved someone else's roadmap. You'll set the growth strategy and then implement it.  
  
We are in the middle of redefining our tech stack, and you’ll collaborate directly with the Director of Product and Tech Leads to make sure your team has the tools it needs to succeed.  
  
What You'll Own

* The full funnel, as one number. Conversion, AOV, activation, repeat rate, and customer LTV — one connected model, not a web metric and an email metric that never meet. You'll know exactly where visitors drop off across the entire lifecycle and why.
* A high-velocity testing program. Build and run the experimentation engine across landing pages, product pages, checkout, onboarding, and lifecycle email/SMS. Prioritize by expected impact, ship weekly, and hold the team to a real read on what won and what didn't. Our traffic comes with high built-in intent rather than from paid ads — so tests have to be designed for the volume and audience we actually have.
* First-purchase acquisition. Maximize the yield of every visit: page experience, offer structure, and first-purchase conversion. Our customers arrive with intent already established, so the job is to convert that intent — not manufacture it.
* Retention and lifecycle. Oversee our email/SMS team, onboarding, activation into the Feel Great app, re-order, winback, and reactivation. Grow repeat revenue and LTV as deliberately as first-purchase conversion.
* The promo and launch calendar. Ship the site pages, offers, and lifecycle flows behind product launches and promotions, coordinating timelines across marketing and design.
* Instrumentation and truth. Own tracking and reporting so the whole company sees the same funnel weekly, and turn it into a visible, prioritized hypothesis backlog. Bring the qualitative "why" — reviews, support tickets, surveys, session replays — because we can't lean on paid-channel data for audience insight.
* The team. Manage, coach, and raise the bar for the employees on the team (currently 4 people across Web/CRO and Email/Lifecycle); hire to fill gaps; set the operating cadence (weekly test reviews, roadmap, reporting).

  

What We're Looking For

* 6+ years in growth, CRO, lifecycle, or e-commerce, with 2+ years leading people — ideally at a high-performing DTC or subscription brand.
* A serious testing track record: you can talk through dozens of specific experiments you designed, the hypotheses, and what you learned when they lost.
* Full-funnel range — you've owned or worked hands-on across *both* acquisition/CRO and retention/lifecycle, not just one side.
* Fluency in the numbers: you build your own analysis, size opportunities before you test them, and understand statistical significance well enough

jobs.title: Senior Director, Marketing Communications
jobs.desc:
Dive in and do the best work of your career at DigitalOcean. Journey alongside a strong community of top talent who are relentless in their drive to build the simplest scalable cloud. If you have a growth mindset, naturally like to think big and bold, and are energized by the fast-paced environment of a true industry disruptor, you'll find your place here. We value winning together—while learning, having fun, and making a profound difference for the dreamers and builders in the world.

We are looking for a master media strategist to unify, elevate, and lead our global narrative and storytelling. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will be a key player in transforming our cross-functional public relations, corporate communications, and analyst and influencer relations into a unified power engine that accelerates market awareness and adoption and inspires community trust.

**What You'll Do:**
-------------------

* Define and author the overarching global communication strategy in order to align long-term enterprise goals with a compelling public voice that elevates our corporate authority.
* Cultivate and leverage deep relationships with Tier-1 tech journalists and industry influencers in order to secure high-impact placements that increase our competitive share of voice.
* Develop proactive response frameworks and risk-mitigation models in order to safeguard corporate reputation and maintain public trust during critical business or industry events.
* Oversee the direction and performance of all corporate digital and social media channels in order to optimize multi-platform engagement with our global community.
* Establish advanced operational KPIs and attribution metrics across all communication vectors in order to measure and prove business impact, brand sentiment, and pipeline influence.
* Provide strategic counsel, bespoke media coaching, and tailored talking points to the C-suite in order to enhance the efficacy of executive thought leadership across public forums.
* Lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of communication specialists and content creators in order to cultivate internal talent, maximize operational velocity, and foster a world-class culture of accountability.

**What You'll Add to DigitalOcean:**
------------------------------------

* Experience with building and executing multi-channel global communications, PR, and social media strategies at scale within a high-growth SaaS, cloud infrastructure, or tech environment.
* A deep understanding of public relations methodologies, crisis management frameworks, and the shifting nuances of algorithmic digital channels.
* Experience with handling corporate visibility operations and acting as a trusted liaison to media entities, industry analysts, and executive stakeholders.
* The human element: Exceptional relational intelligence and diplomacy skills, enabling you to harmonize diverse cross-functional teams and build ironclad partnerships across organizational boundaries.
* A growth-mindset approach: A natural appetite for constructive feedback, a relentless drive to challenge stale brand paradigms, and a "leave it better than you found it" attitude.
* Fearlessness: Marketing has to create compelling stories from highly technical products and concepts, with new ones emerging almost every day. We must learn all the time, ask the basic questions, and be willing to fail in order to learn more.

**Compensation Range:**
-----------------------

* $230,000 - $280,000

jobs.title: Marketing Director
jobs.desc:
Job Title: Marketing Manager
  
Reports To: Director of Operations, Owners
  
Department: Corporate

Company Overview

4 Star Restaurant Group is a Chicago-based hospitality company operating full-service, from-scratch restaurants including The Smoke Daddy (Wicker and Wrigley), The Perch, Remington’s, Crosby’s Kitchen, Ella Elli, Frasca, and Tuco & Blondie. People are our focus, and guests are our priority. Our #1 goal is to provide an exceptional dining experience at a reasonable price. We are committed to genuine hospitality, exceptional food, and fostering an extraordinary work environment while upholding our core values every shift.

Position Summary

The Director of Marketing is responsible for the strategic leadership of all marketing, branding, guest engagement, and customer acquisition efforts across the organization. This role partners closely with ownership and operational leadership to develop and execute marketing initiatives that strengthen brand awareness, drive guest loyalty, increase restaurant traffic, and support long-term business growth.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic thinker and hands-on leader, capable of developing long-term marketing plans while remaining actively involved in key initiatives, campaigns, restaurant openings, and brand-building opportunities.

What You'll Own

* Marketing strategy and brand growth across all company concepts
* Guest acquisition, loyalty, retention, and engagement initiatives
* Digital marketing, CRM, email, loyalty, social media, and reputation management
* Annual marketing plans, promotional calendars, and revenue-driving campaigns
* Partnership with operations leaders to drive traffic and restaurant performance
* Marketing analytics, business insights, and performance reporting
* Brand standards and consistency across all guest touchpoints
* New restaurant openings, special events, and community partnerships
* Agency, vendor, and media partner relationships
* Marketing team leadership, development, and accountability
* Marketing budget management and return on investment

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field required.
* Minimum of five years of progressive marketing experience, including leadership responsibility.
* Hospitality, restaurant, retail, franchise, or consumer-facing brand experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated success developing and executing marketing strategies that drive measurable business results.
* Experience leading marketing teams, agency partners, and cross-functional initiatives.
* Strong understanding of loyalty platforms, CRM systems, email marketing, social media management, digital advertising, and marketing analytics.
* Experience presenting business recommendations and performance results to senior leadership and ownership groups.
* Strong financial acumen, including budget development and ROI analysis.
* Excellent communication, leadership, project management, and relationship-building skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, loyalty systems, and marketing technology tools.

Physical Requirements & Work Environment

* Ability to stand, walk, bend, reach, and lift up to 50 pounds throughout shifts.
* Comfortable working in loud, variable indoor/outdoor environments with potential allergen exposure.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions.

jobs.desc:
**Company at a Glance**

OpenX is focused on unleashing the full economic potential of digital media companies. We do this by making digital advertising markets and technologies that are designed to deliver optimal value to publishers and advertisers on every ad served across all screens.

At OpenX, we have built a team that is uniquely experienced in designing and operating high-scale ad marketplaces, and we are constantly on the lookout for thoughtful, creative executors who are as fascinated as we are about finding new ways to apply a blend of market design, technical innovation, operational excellence, and empathetic partner service to the frontiers of digital advertising.

**Director, Growth Marketing**

**Department:** Marketing

**Reports to:** Sr. Director, Corporate Marketing

**Location:** Remote

**About the Role**
------------------

As Director, Growth Marketing, you’ll own the engine behind OpenX’s growth: the channels that build pipeline, the data that measures it, the platforms that power it, and the team that runs it. That spans multichannel acquisition and AI search visibility, attribution and pipeline reporting to executive leadership, HubSpot and marketing ops, and the digital operations team behind openx.com.

You’re equally strategic and technical, with the credibility to drive influence across the organization, from aligning cross-functional partners on priorities to turning the numbers into a clear story for commercial and executive leadership.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

**Pipeline & Demand Generation**

* Build and scale a full-funnel demand gen strategy across paid, organic, ABM, and partner channels targeting publishers, demand partners, and agency/brand buyers. Partner closely with the Integrated Marketing team to align on messaging and plan development.
* Own pipeline targets by segment (e.g., enterprise publisher, mid-market, DSP/agency demand side) and report against them monthly
* Partner with SDR/BDR leadership on lead scoring, routing, and follow-up cadences

**AI Visibility & Search Growth**

* Run Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) / Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) programs: structured data and schema markup, content architecture that LLMs can parse and cite, and page-age/link-equity fixes on key landing pages
* Benchmark OpenX's share of voice against key category competitors across LLM outputs, and prioritize content fixes based on where OpenX under-indexes
* Partner with content and comms to make OpenX.com and resource pages "agent-legible" (clean markup, crawlable feeds, accurate structured facts about the product) and scale our video program.

**Marketing Analytics & Attribution**

* Design and maintain a revenue attribution model that credits marketing's role in deals — from first touch through closed-won — in a way commercial leadership trusts
* Own HubSpot, including its AI tools, as the marketing automation and lead lifecycle engine; partner with the team owning Salesforce and with Digital Ops on the broader stack (CRM, BI) for tracking and reporting
* Deliver recurring reporting on pipeline influence, cost per opportunity, and channel ROI to executive leadership

**Team Management**

* Lead and develop the digital operations and web development team: set priorities, run the operating cadence, and own performance management and growth plans for each team member
* Build a culture centered around collaboration, scalability, continuous improvement, and business impact
* Direct the growth marketing budget and shift spend across channels based on cost per opportunity and pipeline return

**What You Bring**

* 10+ years in growth marketing, ideally in adtech, SaaS, or another B2B environment
* Ownership-level fluency in HubSpot, incl

jobs.title: Director of Demand Generation
jobs.desc:
Description:

**Position Purpose**

Turn market demand into signed leases at every Lion community while building a marketing team and onsite partnerships where people, performance and purpose reinforce one another.

**Role Summary**

The Director of Demand Generation is responsible for creating demand to meet occupancy and reputation goals for Lion's communities. This role owns the strategy, budget and channels that bring in prospects and convert them into tours, applications, and signed leases.

Working with regional and onsite teams, the Director proactively anticipates where occupancy is soft, acts quickly and shows the return on every marketing dollar. This is a hands-on leadership role that both sets the plan and runs campaigns while building knowledge and fostering collaboration across teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategy and budget: Build and manage the annual demand generation plan and marketing budget. Allocate spend by community based on occupancy, lease expirations and lead-to-lease performance.
* Digital and paid media: Own paid search, paid social, internet listing services (ILS), retargeting, and display. Optimize cost per lease, not just cost per lead.
* Website and SEO: Drive traffic and conversion on community websites. Oversee local SEO/GEO/AEO, listings and online reputation.
* Lead management: Make sure every lead is captured, routed and followed up on quickly. Partner with leasing teams on CRM workflows, call tracking and response times.
* Recovery campaigns: Launch targeted plans for acquisitions and communities that fall below occupancy targets.
* Resident retention: Support renewal campaigns with property management to achieve desired retention.
* Reporting and attribution: Report weekly on traffic, leads, tours, applications, leases and spend by source and community. Turn the data into clear actions.
* Vendors and agencies: Select and manage agencies, ILS partners and marketing technology providers. Hold them to performance and contract terms.
* Brand consistency: Keep messaging, creative and pricing presentation consistent across all channels and communities.
* Team leadership: Hire, coach and develop marketing team members, with a development plan for every team member and a ready successor for key roles. Work with training to transfer knowledge to onsite teams related to lead nurturing and marketing strategy.
* Cross-functional partnership: Work with Operations, Investments/Acquisitions, Learning & Development and regional leaders so marketing standards, training and tools reach every community.

**Leadership Expectations**

Like every Lion leader, this role is responsible for three outcomes: business results, resident experience, and team member experience. Strong lead numbers alone won't earn a top rating if they come at the expense of the team or residents. The role also models Lion's people-centric standard: results, relationships, development, culture and future leadership.

**Core Competencies and What it Looks Like in This Role:**

* Inspire trust: Shares spend, results and misses openly with leadership and onsite teams
* Develop people: Coaches marketing staff and prepares them for advancement
* Drive accountability: Balances empathy with high standards for the team, agencies and vendors
* Lead through change: Guides teams through new channels, tools and market shifts
* Build collaborative relationships: Works across operations, training and regions instead of in a marketing silo
* Resident-centric decision making: Attracts residents who stay and protects asset value
* Inclusive leadership: Builds a team where everyone contributes and belongs
* Continuous improvement: Tests, measures and retires what doesn't work

**Reports to:** Chief Operating Officer

**Location:** Nashville Corporate Office, or Remote in specific markets (NC, TX, GA), with travel to communities as needed

At Lion Real Estate Group, we're focused on building a strong, collaborative te

jobs.title: Media & Marketing Director
jobs.desc:
Tractor Town is excited to be looking for a Media & Marketing Director to handle a wide variety of tasks. Must be creative, hard working, fast and have a great attitude. At any one time you're managing hundreds of listings you will have helped create and so being fast paced and efficient helps. For example if your keyboard speed isn't over 45 wpm please do not apply. The same with if you have to use your personal cell phone on the companies time (you will have a company cell phone for business related calls only). Need to have very good references and an excellent attendance history. Spelling and English skills need to be top notch.

Our Media & Marketing Director position will include at least 2/3rds of your day with marketing our inventory and listings online with a computer and cell phone along with taking pictures and video for media inventory postings. We also do some traditional advertising, marketing on occasion such as print, direct mail, outdoor,... but we are looking for better efficiency using display ads, PPC, AI, digital and social media. Recent graduates are also encouraged to apply if you have good experience in a lot of these areas.

Full time though hours can be flexed such as a 4 day 10 hour week. Or 40 to 45+ hours a week if you wish with overtime depending on pay. Flex time during the week and in exchange working on a Saturday is also fine but definitely not required. If you feel you're highly qualified for the position, live somewhat nearby and only can work 20 ish hours a week and some Saturdays we may consider you working under the guidance and supervision of the full time Media & Marketing Director mainly since we have an overabundance of inventory to market.

Tractor Town Equipment is located just 25/30/45 minutes south of Nashville / Franklin / Spring Hill and close to I-65 at Lewisburg, TN so it's a fast, easy commute in the morning (against traffic) and same coming from Huntsville. Pay $17 to $24/hour based on experience and hours per week. Compensation depends what you put into it as with most anything so depending on your work times, experience and productivity total pay can exceed $70,000 a year or be in the $35,000 range. It's wide open depending on the person and performance. Paid vacation and holidays. We have a dental and vision insurance plan and a supplemental health insurance plan through AFLAC but we do not currently have a company health insurance plan though an additional supplement may be available depending on the candidate and compensation.

Some agriculture, farm or equipment / vehicle marketing related experience would be helpful but not required. Especially if you have a high interest in the field and are a quick learner. Even more so experience with online marketing of inventory and social media is important. Another suitable title for the position at the end of the day is being our Inventory Marketing Specialist. Come join our growing 20 member team as we had another record year last year to go along with the several previous.

Tractor Town, Inc. has been in business for over 25 years since its start in 1998 and almost 9 years at its current location headquarters in Lewisburg. A good portion of our sales are online and all over the U.S. in addition to area, local and regional customers. Our Mission is to provide an outstanding customer and buyer experience focused on finding solutions for customers equipment and service needs. Along with treating customers and team members how they want to be treated. TractorTown.com Check out our great Google ratings and we are rated A+ at the BBB.

jobs.title: CRM Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
Description

CRM Marketing Manager

Reporting to: CMO
Location: Fully Remote
Markets: 12

About the Role

We are looking for a CRM Marketing Manager to own CXM’s customer lifecycle marketing across 12 markets. You will use customer data, segmentation, automation, and personalised communications to improve activation, first-time deposits, retention, reactivation, and customer lifetime value.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can build CRM journeys from the ground up, manage campaigns across multiple markets, and use performance data to continuously improve results.

Key Objectives

  • Build and launch at least 3 automated lifecycle journeys covering welcome/activation, retention, and reactivation within the first 6 months.
  • Improve the current 9% lead-to-FTD conversion rate through targeted CRM activation campaigns.
  • Support reducing churn to below 10% through structured retention and reactivation programmes.
  • Build and maintain localised CRM journeys across all 12 markets.
  • Maintain 99%+ deliverability and ensure all CRM activity meets applicable compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Lifecycle & CRM Strategy

  • Own customer journeys across onboarding, activation, conversion, retention, loyalty, VIP, churn prevention, and win-back.
  • Define triggers, audiences, journey logic, exclusions, frequency caps, and exit criteria.
  • Coordinate email and push communications to create a consistent customer experience.

Campaigns & Automation

  • Build, launch, and optimise automated CRM campaigns using platforms such as Mailgun, Braze, Klaviyo, or equivalent.
  • Create targeted campaigns based on customer behaviour, lifecycle stage, market, language, and product.
  • Manage promotional campaigns, newsletters, VIP communications, retention campaigns, and partner communications.
  • Develop and maintain reusable email templates and content blocks.

Segmentation & Personalisation

  • Build and maintain customer segments, consent lists, exclusions, and communication rules.
  • Configure personalised and dynamic content based on customer data.
  • Work with Product, Analytics, and IT to define and validate data and event requirements.
  • SQL knowledge is a strong advantage.

Localisation

  • Manage CRM communications across multiple languages and markets.
  • Coordinate translation, editing, and linguistic QA.
  • Ensure correct currencies, dates, links, variables, legal messaging, tone, and RTL requirements.
  • Maintain master journeys and localisation matrices across all markets.

Deliverability & Compliance

  • Monitor deliverability, bounces, spam complaints, suppression lists, and domain/IP reputation.
  • Maintain strong email hygiene and deliverability standards.
  • Run detailed pre-launch QA covering audiences, links, variables, tracking, content, sender details, and scheduling.
  • Ensure campaigns comply with consent, unsubscribe, data retention, and local regulatory requirements.

Analytics & Optimisation

  • Analyse CRM performance by market, language, segment, and customer lifecycle stage.
  • Measure conversion, retention, churn, revenue, and incremental uplift — not just opens and clicks.
  • Run A/B and holdout tests across offers, messaging, timing, frequency, channels, and journey structure.
  • Maintain a clear optimisation backlog and turn insights into measurable improvements.


Requirements
  • Proven experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, email marketing, or marketing auto

jobs.title: Advertising Operations Manager
jobs.desc:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Ad Operations and Sales Analytics support Discord's ads business, partnering with Sales, Product, Engineering, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality campaign executions, impactful data insights, and go-to-market strategy across our advertising products.

As an Ad Operations Manager, you will play a crucial part in scaling our Ads business. You'll improve the efficiency and scale of campaign execution while contributing to deep-dive analyses that drive business growth and inform go-to-market strategy. You'll provide valuable feedback to Product and Engineering teams, directly impacting Discord's advertising capabilities while removing friction from customers' experience with our platform.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Ensuring ad campaigns are implemented and launched on time and to specification — including campaign parameters such as dates, targeting, tracking, impression/reach goals, geographies, and budget — working closely with Account Executives and Account Managers to align setups with client objectives
  • Providing hands-on technical support to key customers and Ad Sales partners, and owning the processes and escalation path (in partnership with Engineering) for issues related to platform integration and use
  • Partnering with Account Managers and technical teams to optimize campaign outcomes and maximize client ROI, including troubleshooting and A/B testing of messaging, creative, and targeting
  • Synthesizing campaign performance insights for internal stakeholders and clients — performance, trends, ROI, and actionable recommendations
  • Building and scaling automations and tooling (including AI/LLM-based workflows) that reduce manual effort and increase leverage across the team
  • Serving as the operational engine for multiple revenue-driving functions across the Discord Business Organization

What you should have

  • 3–5+ years of experience in digital advertising, ad operations, or related roles
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., LLM-based workflows, scripting/automation) to drive measurable efficiency gains in a professional environment
  • Comfort working with data and light scripting — SQL required; Python or similar strongly preferred — to build or maintain internal tooling and reporting pipelines
  • Demonstrated knowledge of a broad variety of ad technologies, campaign operation methodologies, and ad tracking/measurement solutions
  • Experience partnering with Engineering and/or Product on technical escalations, platform integrations, or API-level troubleshooting
  • Successful track record working directly with clients — understanding needs and delivering value
  • Strong analytical proficiency: ability to query and interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions
  • Familiarity with market trends and KPIs such as viewability, brand safety, yield analysis, and audience extension
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in a fast-changing, cross-functional environment

Bonus Points

  • Experience designing or building internal automation/tooling (bots, pipelines, dashboards) that scaled a team's operations
  • Team player with a sense of humor, humility, curiosity, and empathy

This position is US-based and can be based in New York (remote) or San Francisco but if you live in the Bay Area, you’re welcome to work from our beautiful SF office.&n

jobs.title: Marketing Manager – Social Media (Instagram & TikTok)
jobs.desc:
We're XO Angels, a creator management agency. As a Growth Manager, you'll own the short-form strategy of 2-4 creators end to end: scripts, shot lists, feedback to creators and editors, and constant testing until the numbers move. Your only real goal: views that turn into real reach.

What you'll actually do

  • Analyse viral short-form content, understand why it worked, and adapt it for our creators.
  • Write scripts and shot lists that your creators then shoot. Give them precise feedback on what worked, what didn't, and what needs to change.
  • Direct editors and posters. You own the output, they execute it.
  • Analyse every post: why did this hit, why did that flop, what do we double down on this week.
  • Test bold ideas fast, kill what doesn't work, scale what does.

Who we're looking for
This is not a 9-to-5. When a Reel goes viral on a Sunday night, you're on it. When an account gets banned at 10pm on a weekday, you handle it. Weekends are normally off, but when there's an emergency you step in, no discussion. If that puts you off, this role isn't for you.

We want:

  • Obsession with short-form. You watch TikTok and Reels for hours voluntarily and can explain why a video works. You're not learning this, you already live it.
  • Ownership mindset. You treat your creators' accounts like your own business. No excuses, no "the editor didn't deliver", you make it happen.
  • Analytical eye. You can look at 20 videos and tell us what pattern connects the winners.
  • Fluent English. Non-negotiable.
  • Bonus, not required: experience growing IG or TikTok accounts, agency or marketing background. We care more about drive and taste than about your CV.

What you get

  • 3,000 USD base + performance bonuses. Realistic total 3,500-7,000 USD/month depending on results.
  • 100% remote. Work from wherever.
  • Direct impact. Small team, no bureaucracy. Your ideas ship this week, not next quarter.
  • Clear path up. If you really push, you can become Head of Marketing within 12-18 months and lead your own team.

How to apply
Click the link and fill out the short application. It tells you honestly what the role really involves, and screens you in or out, so neither you nor we waste any time.

jobs.title: Social Copywriter
jobs.desc:
Emergent builds autonomous coding agents that replace traditional software development by generating, testing, and deploying production applications directly from plain-language intent. Our systems run in production at global scale and are used to build millions of real applications.

Since our public launch, we've crossed $130M in Annualised Revenue and grown to over 10M users across 190+ countries , who have built 12M+ applications on Emergent. We're backed by Creaegis, Khosla Ventures, SoftBank, Lightspeed, Together, Y Combinator, Google, Claypond and Sentinel Global.

We're solving the hard part of AI-driven software creation: correctness, reliability, security, and scale in real production systems. The team is built by repeat founders, Olympiad medalists, IIT & IIM alumni, and leaders from Google, Amazon, and Dropbox.

We're hiring builders who want ownership, speed, and impact at global scale.

The Role:
About 70% of our users have never coded before. They are small business owners, solo founders, and operators who had an idea and no engineer to build it with. We are hiring a writer to run the words across our social channels. You will write the day-to-day content that goes out on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and LinkedIn: short-form video scripts, captions, on-screen text, threads, community posts, and replies from the brand account.

Most of our audience is in the US and Europe. You should be comfortable writing for those markets without needing anyone to explain the reference. This is a full-time role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Head of Brand and Marketing.

What You'll Do:

  • Write short-form video scripts and captions for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube on a daily cadence
  • Write posts and threads for X and LinkedIn
  • Spot trends, formats, and news moments early and turn them into content while they are still relevant, usually within 48 hours
  • Decide which trends are worth joining and which ones to leave alone
  • Build content ideas that people want to participate in, share, or argue with, rather than only consume
  • Run the brand account's replies and comment sections
  • Find real users who have built something with Emergent and turn their stories into content
  • Work with the design and video team so scripts are written for what can actually be produced
  • Track what worked, share it with the team, and change the approach when the numbers say so

What We're Looking For:

  • At least 5 years writing and managing content for Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, and LinkedIn
  • A body of work that performed, with the numbers to show it
  • Strong understanding of internet culture in the US and Europe
  • Ability to work fast and make calls without waiting for sign-off
  • Comfort writing differently for each platform

Benefits and Perks:

  1. Daily Meals: Lunch and Dinner provided
  2. Family Insurance: 5 Lakhs worth of coverage for you and your family
  3. Unlimited Paid Time Off: Take the time you need to recharge and come back refreshed
  4. Flexible Working Hours: Work arrangements that fit your life and commitments

SimpleTiger is seeking a strategic, data-driven Senior PPC Manager to lead paid media strategy and execution for our B2B SaaS clients. This role is ideal for a seasoned performance marketer with 5+ years of hands-on experience building, managing, and optimizing multi-channel paid advertising campaigns.

The Senior PPC Manager will own campaign performance across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram; translate client growth objectives into effective paid media strategies; and deliver clear, proactive communication and recommendations. You will work closely with our SEO, content, design, sales, and product teams to maximize qualified pipeline, customer acquisition, and return on ad spend for a portfolio of SaaS clients.

  • Develop and lead comprehensive paid media strategies tailored to each client’s growth stage, business model, target audience, sales cycle, and revenue goals.
  • Independently build, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with platform representatives to access platform support, strategic guidance, beta opportunities, and new features.

  • Provide mentorship, strategic guidance, and quality assurance support to junior team members as the PPC function grows.

jobs.title: Fractional Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**TENGOINTERNET**

**Local Fractional Marketing Manager**

Part-time contract (1099) • ~10–15 hours/week • Remote (must live within one hour of Austin TX) • $3,000–$5,000/month retainer

**About TengoInternet**
-----------------------

TengoInternet is an employee-owned company that has spent more than two decades designing, building, and managing outdoor WiFi networks for campgrounds, RV resorts, glamping destinations, and marinas. Our customers count on us to keep their guests connected and their operations running — and they stay with us because of trust, relationships, and results. Get Connected.

**Why this role exists**
------------------------

Our longtime marketing leader recently moved on, and rather than replace the role one-for-one, we redesigned the function. Strategy is set by our leadership team; automation and specialists handle the heavy systems work. What we need now is a reliable, hands-on marketing generalist to own the marketing execution across our prospect and customer lifecycle — nurturing leads, strengthening customer relationships, supporting expansion and referrals, and ensuring our industry presence translates into measurable business outcomes. This person will also keep our brand present and our busy trade show calendar running smoothly.

One thing to know: Tengo wins through relationships and credibility, not marketing volume. Most of our best customers come from referrals and industry events. Your job is to amplify that — keep us top-of-mind with customers and prospects, make every event count, and make sure no lead falls through the cracks.

**What you’ll own**
-------------------

**1. Prospect & Customer Nurturing**

* Own the ongoing marketing cadence for active prospects, dormant opportunities, customers, and strategic accounts.
* Ensure trade-show leads, closed/lost opportunities, early-stage construction projects, and other “not now” prospects enter appropriate nurture programs rather than disappearing from view.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success to identify and execute customer expansion campaigns around portfolio growth, network lifecycle/upgrade opportunities, new services, and other relevant Tengo capabilities.
* Build recurring customer communications that support retention, expansion, referrals, upgrades, and adoption of additional Tengo services.
* Identify customer wins that can become testimonials, referrals, case studies, reviews, or other trust-building assets.
* Work with our HubSpot specialist to translate lifecycle needs into automated workflows and sequences.

**2. Content & Thought Leadership: emails and blogs**

* Write and schedule recurring email campaigns in HubSpot: educational content for existing customers, nurture touches for prospects and dormant leads, and pre/post-event sends.
* Write and schedule our promotional emails and blog posts for posting through our ad partners
* Turn CEO-provided ideas, observations, meeting notes and industry insights into first drafts of CEO Connect and other thought-leadership communications, preserving the CEO's voice and point of view for his final review.
* Publish 1–2 blog posts per month aligned to our SEO/AEO roadmap (we have an audit and keyword direction — you execute against it).
* Turn wins into proof: case studies, testimonials, and review snippets we can reuse across channels.
* Work efficiently across channels by repurposing strong source content and using AI appropriately for drafting and production.

**3. Light social media and website maintenance**

* Keep Facebook and LinkedIn active (roughly 1–2 posts/week) by repurposing blog, email, and event content — consistency over volume.
* Promote our presence before, during, and after trade shows; celebrate customer milestones and company news.
* Responding to social comments and reviews on Google, etc
* Periodic content updates to our Wordpress website—You do not need to be a professional web designer.

**4. Lead attribution and funnel management**

About the Role

Bell Honey Company is looking for a **Digital Marketing & Website Specialist** to join our marketing team and work alongside our Marketing Specialist to strengthen our websites, SEO, online content, and digital sales.

You will work closely with our Marketing Specialist, who primarily handles the **visual and creative side of marketing**, including graphic design, photography, branding, social media, and marketing materials. This position will focus more heavily on the **website, SEO, digital content, analytics, and performance side.**

What You'll DoWebsite Management

* Identify and address basic website issues such as broken links, formatting problems, outdated content, and other functionality concerns.

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person's metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

**Working here**

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights' Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek's Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

**Opportunity**

Today, Twin Health does almost no proactive marketing to our active members. Once someone enrolls, nearly every communication they receive is either a product-triggered push notification or a message from their care team. That has taken us a long way — but it leaves an entire layer of engagement unbuilt.

We are hiring our first Active Member Marketing Manager to build that layer. You will own the strategy and the execution of every proactive, non-clinically led communication a Twin member receives: email, SMS, in-app and push campaigns, direct mail testing, member webinars, and additional channel exploration we have not yet tried. You will design how those communications layer into the care team relationship and the product notification ecosystem already in place.

This is a build role requiring both strategic vision as well as executional know how. Twin members, data, clinical outcomes, and Braze infrastructure is already in place. What does not exist is a deliberate lifecycle program. You will write the strategy, then ship it yourself. We are looking for someone who can point to campaigns they personally built and outcomes they personally moved.

**Responsibilities**

* Map the member journey to build sustained engagement, as well as winback for lapsed members, and define the communication strategy for each stage, including who we deliberately choose not to message.

Integration with the Care Team and Product Ecosystem

* Inventory the existing touchpoint landscape and maintain that map as the source of truth.
* Partner with Care Delivery and Clinical leadership to define the boundary between a marketing communication and a clinical one. Member marketing should make the care team more effective, not compete with it for attention.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist (Google Ads Experience a Plus)
jobs.desc:
**SEO-focused role. Google Ads experience is a plus.**

This is an SEO job first. We need someone who knows how to get established businesses found on Google, and increasingly in AI search tools, by people who are ready to buy. If you can also build and manage Google Ads campaigns, you'll be even more valuable here.

**About The Digital MC**

The Digital MC is a digital marketing and web agency based in Northern Kentucky. We work with established companies, usually doing $1M to $50M a year: contractors, remodelers, manufacturers, financial firms, government contractors and other businesses that have real customers and want a better way to get more of them.

We start with strategy and do the execution second. Before we write content or launch a campaign, we figure out who the customer is, how they search, what they need to see before they reach out, and whether the website is doing its job. Then we do the work. You won't be cranking out blog posts to hit a quota. Everything you do will have a clear reason behind it.

We're a small team, so your work will be seen and it will matter.

**What You'll Do**

SEO is about 75% or more of the job:

* Run technical SEO audits and fix what you find, including crawl issues, indexing, site speed, redirects, schema and internal linking
* Do keyword research and map it to what searchers want, so every page has a clear job
* Plan and optimize service pages, location pages and supporting content
* Write or edit on-page copy, title tags and meta descriptions that read like a person wrote them
* Manage and improve Google Business Profiles for local clients
* Help plan redirects and protect rankings when we launch new websites
* Keep up with how AI search (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) is changing what gets surfaced, and adjust our approach
* Track results in Search Console and GA4 and explain them in plain language for monthly client reports

PPC is the rest, and it grows as your skills do:

* Help build and manage Google Ads search campaigns, and Local Service Ads for eligible clients
* Review search terms, add negative keywords and help with budget and bid decisions
* Write ad copy and flag when a landing page is hurting results
* Help set up and check conversion tracking in Google Tag Manager

**What We're Looking For**

* 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, at an agency or in-house
* Comfortable working in WordPress (Shopify experience is a bonus)
* Solid working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4 and at least one SEO platform such as Semrush, Ahrefs or Screaming Frog
* A real understanding of local SEO and how Google Maps rankings work
* You write clearly. You can explain to a business owner why a ranking dropped without hiding behind jargon.
* You can manage your own time and stay on top of several clients without anyone looking over your shoulder
* You communicate well in writing and keep people updated without being asked
* You care about whether the work produced leads, not just whether rankings went up

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on Google Ads experience (Google Ads certification is a plus)
* Local Service Ads or Meta Ads experience
* Experience with Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking
* Basic HTML/CSS, enough to fix things without waiting on a developer
* Experience with home services, construction or B2B clients

**Why Work Here**

* Fully remote
* Direct access to the founder and a front-row seat to how agency strategy gets built
* A wide range of industries and problems to work on, so you won't get bored
* Room to grow into a larger search marketing role as the agency grows

Pay: $45,000.00 - $60,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Cincinnati, OH 45202

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About AiPrise**
=================

AiPrise is the global compliance platform for companies that operate across borders. We cover the full KYB lifecycle in a single API, with AI agents handling the case work that used to eat analyst hours. Customers include Meta, Bridge (a Stripe company), Airwallex, Fireblocks, and Nivoda. We're a YC company (S22), Series A backed by Headline, and growing fast.

**About this role**
===================

We're looking for a Performance Marketing Manager to own paid media at AiPrise, end to end.  
LinkedIn is our proven channel. Google runs brand search today. Meta, Reddit, TV, radio, and channels we haven't named yet are on the list to test. You'll run all of it: the platforms, the creative, the budgets, the tests, and the reporting.

Our audience is compliance leaders at fintech, payments, stablecoin, and marketplace companies. It's a small audience by paid media standards, which means precision beats volume, and every dollar gets judged on pipeline, not clicks.

This is a hands-on role with real authority. You set the approach: how much a test needs to be conclusive, when to stop it, and when to scale it. Then you report what happened, every week, in plain numbers. You report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Growth Marketing Manager, as well as sales, product marketing, content, and design.

**What you'll own**
===================

* Every paid platform: LinkedIn, Google, Meta, Reddit, and offline tests including TV and radio. Strategy, setup, targeting, budgets, bidding, and optimization, hands on keyboard.
* The test program. A budget, a hypothesis, and a verdict date for every test. Kill fast, scale what works, and put the decision in writing.
* Creative, from concept to live ad. You develop the angles, write the copy, brief design and video on the assets, and iterate on what the numbers say. Buyer language over marketing language.
* Weekly reporting: spend, leads, SQLs, pipeline, and cost per SQL by channel and by test. Honest, sourced, reproducible.
* Account-based campaigns: paid programs against named target accounts, coordinated with sales.
* Event campaigns: pre-event targeting and post-event retargeting across our conference calendar.
* What happens after the click: landing pages and forms that match the ad and convert, working with web and content.

**Who you are**
===============

* 4+ years running paid campaigns for B2B, with hands-on platform experience across at least three of LinkedIn, Google, Meta, and Reddit.
* You've managed monthly paid budgets between $20K and $100K and can show what they produced.
* You know the platforms cold: campaign structure, audiences, bidding, conversion tracking, and the settings most people leave on default.
* You can take a concept from a sentence to a live ad: the angle, the copy, the creative brief, the landing page ask, and the test design around it.
* You think in pipeline, not impressions. Comfortable in HubSpot or an equivalent CRM, spreadsheets, and attribution data, and you know when the numbers are lying.
* You set the approach. You've sized test budgets, called tests early when they were failing, and scaled winners without being told to.
* You use AI tools every day for creative development and analysis. This is a requirement, not a nice to have.
* You treat accuracy as non-negotiable. Every number you report is sourced and reproducible. This is a hard requirement, not a preference.
* You write clearly and work well remotely. Your weekly update should be readable by a founder in two minutes.
* High ownership, high autonomy, fast pace, and real care about the quality of what ships.

**Nice to have**
================

* Offline media experience: TV, radio, out-of-home, or podcast advertising, including how to measure it.
* Experience with account-based marketing programs.
* Experience marketing to compliance, risk, or fintech buyers.

jobs.title: Casino Marketing Executive
jobs.desc:
Atlas Gaming Group is seeking a casino marketing executive to lead enterprise-wide marketing, player development, customer loyalty, and revenue growth initiatives across its portfolio of gaming properties.

As the Casino Marketing Executive, you will be responsible for developing and executing strategic marketing initiatives that increase gaming revenue, strengthen customer loyalty, maximize promotional effectiveness, and drive profitable growth. This executive leadership role requires a deep understanding of casino player development, database marketing, customer analytics, and reinvestment strategy, combined with the ability to leverage the company's hotels, restaurants, fuel offerings, entertainment venues, and other amenities to create compelling customer experiences.

This leader will serve as a key member of the executive management team and play a critical role in shaping the company's growth strategy.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Develop and execute enterprise-wide marketing and player development strategies that drive gaming revenue and revenue growth.

Lead budgeting, forecasting, and strategic planning for all marketing and player development activities.

Lead customer acquisition, retention, loyalty, and VIP development initiatives across all properties.

Establish promotional and reinvestment strategies based on measurable financial returns and customer profitability.

Arrange, plan & execute player events & sponsorships

Analyze and optimize performance through key metrics including ROI, ROPI, theoretical win, customer lifetime value, visitation frequency, and player worth.

Oversee database marketing, CRM, loyalty programs, digital marketing, advertising, and special events.

Create integrated campaigns that leverage lodging, restaurants, fuel, entertainment, and other amenities to increase gaming visitation and guest spend.

Partner with property leaders to align marketing initiatives with operational and financial objectives.

Build, mentor, and develop high-performing marketing and player development teams.

Bachelor's degree in marketing, Business Administration, Hospitality, Gaming Management, or related field.

5+ years of progressive casino marketing and player development leadership experience.

Have familiarity with multiple casino operating systems.

Proven success driving gaming revenue growth through data-driven marketing strategies.

Extensive experience measuring promotional effectiveness and marketing ROI.

Strong knowledge of casino loyalty systems, player tracking platforms, CRM tools, and customer analytics.

Exceptional executive leadership, communication, and strategic planning skills.

Multi-property gaming experience is strongly preferred.

**The Ideal Candidate**

You understand that successful casino marketing is not about giveaways; it is about creating profitable customer behavior. You know how to identify a property's most valuable guests, develop loyalty through meaningful experiences, and measure the true return on every marketing dollar invested.

Most importantly, you can transform every hotel stay, restaurant visit, fuel purchase, and entertainment experience into an opportunity to grow gaming revenue and strengthen customer loyalty.

If you have the vision to lead growth, the analytical discipline to measure results, and the executive presence to influence a multi-property gaming organization, Atlas Gaming Group invites you to apply.

We're hiring our **founding marketing hire** — someone who can own the full marketing function end to end from day one and grow into a leadership role as the team scales. **Analyst, Paid Media**

**Job Overview**

As a Paid Media Analyst at Augurian, you’ll be hands-on every day—optimizing campaigns, analyzing performance data, managing budgets, and learning how to connect the numbers to client outcomes. You’ll work across PPC, display, and social platforms, building the foundational skills that every great paid media strategist needs.

We’re looking for someone who is curious, detail-oriented, and dependable. You don’t need to have all the answers yet, but you need to want to find them. You’ll get exposure to AI tools, consultative client work, and strategic thinking—and you’ll have a team around you that’s invested in helping you grow. You’ll support a diverse client mix—from B2B organizations with long sales cycles to multi-location businesses in healthcare, retail, higher education, and grocery—giving you broad exposure to different business models early in your career. If you have a passion for digital marketing and a drive to win for clients, this is your launchpad.

* Proactively optimize digital marketing campaigns by analyzing performance metrics.
* Contribute insights to improve targeting, messaging, and overall campaign effectiveness; collaborate on longer-term strategy.
* Implement and maintain paid media campaigns across PPC, display, social media, and other platforms.
* Manage budget allocation, bid strategies, and targeting to optimize campaign performance.

**AI Tools & Learning**

* Assist in the preparation of regular reports, providing key metrics and performance indicators.
* Collaborate with team members to enhance data visualization techniques for better comprehension.
* Communicate and interpret data visualizations clearly.

**Quality Assurance**

* Conduct quality assurance checks on data sets to identify and rectify discrepancies.
* Deliver high-quality work that follows the recommended Augurian process.

**Account Management**

* Communicate campaign strategies, performance updates, and recommendations clearly and professionally.
* Address client feedback and ensure satisfaction.
* Communicate strategic ideas to account leads to influence client strategy.
* Observe and learn from senior team members’ consultative client interactions to develop advisory skills.

**Documentation & Communication**

* Maintain detailed and organized documentation of relevant client and team information.
* Communicate findings and insights clearly to team members and stakeholders.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as a key team player in fostering a collaborative and results-driven work environment.

**Growth & Practice Development**

* Stay informed about industry best practices and emerging tools to enhance your capabilities.
* Actively participate in practice traditions and process development.
* Contribute ideas for how AI and new approaches can improve team processes and client outcomes.

**Organizational Culture**

* Understand and embody the agency’s core values, fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture.

jobs.title: Performance Media Manager
jobs.desc:
About Mendocino Farms
  
At Mendocino Farms, we do a lot more than just sell sandwiches and salads. We are a fast-casual restaurant brand on a mission to bring people together through fresh, culinary-driven food and unmatched hospitality. As we continue our aggressive growth trajectory across new and existing markets, we are seeking a dynamic, analytical, and hands-on leader to elevate our total rewards structure.
  
Our Core Values and Mantras
  

* Sell Happy: The foundational philosophy that goes beyond serving meals to actively uplifting and improving every guest's day.
* Food Should Make People Feel Good: A commitment to using high-quality, whole, and thoughtfully sourced ingredients that make eating well easy.
* Be Culinary Explorers: A passion for combining fresh ingredients and bold flavors in unexpected, gourmet ways.
* Turn the Ordinary into the Extraordinary: Treating every customer and team interaction as a chance to lift someone's spirits.
* Get Better Every Day (GBED): An internal mantra encouraging continuous learning, personal growth, and skill development.

**Job Title:** Performance Media Manager
  
**Reports To:** Vice President Growth Marketing
  
**FLSA Status:** Exempt
  
**Salary Range:** $85,000 - $115,000
  
**Location:** Dallas, TX
  
  
**Summary:**  
Mendocino Farms is looking for a Performance Media Manager to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of our full-funnel, digitally led media efforts. This role sits at the intersection of brand and performance—owning campaign planning, channel strategy, media investment, and measurement, while working closely with our agency partners to ensure every dollar works harder.
  
You’ll be responsible for turning business priorities into smart, data-driven media plans, driving performance across awareness, consideration, and conversion, and building a best-in-class media and analytics engine as we continue to scale nationally.
  
This is a hands-on, highly cross-functional role that partners closely with Brand, Digital, Insights, Finance, and Ops—and plays a critical role in how we grow demand, traffic, and loyalty for Mendocino Farms.
  
This is a senior individual contributor manager role requiring someone comfortable owning multiple campaigns, managing meaningful budgets, and leading performance across a complex, multi-channel media ecosystem.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
Full-Funnel Media Strategy & Planning
  

* Own the development of full-funnel media strategies across digital channels (paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, OLV/CTV, etc.), aligned to brand and business objectives.
* Translate business goals, campaign priorities, and seasonal moments into clear, effective media plans and investment strategies.
* Balance brand and performance objectives, ensuring the right mix of upper-, mid-, and lower-funnel tactics.
* Build channel and campaign strategies that support core business priorities including brand campaigns, menu launches, new store openings, third-party delivery, and catering growth.

Budget Management & Investment Stewardship
  

* Own day-to-day management of media budgets, ensuring dollars are allocated for maximum impact and aligned to business priorities.
* Actively manage sufficiency across channels and campaigns—adjusting investment levels, phasing, and mixes to ensure campaigns are properly funded to perform.
* Monitor pacing, performance, and ROI, and reallocate spend dynamically based on results, seasonality, and business needs.
* Partner with Finance and agency teams to support forecasting, scenario planning, and in-flight budget optimization.

Campaign Execution & Optimization
  

* Lead day-to-day performance management of campaigns in partnership with agency teams, ensuring strong pacing, optimization, and results.
* Set clear KPIs, learning agendas, and testing roadmaps to continuously improve performance.
* Partner with creative and brand teams to ensure media and messaging work together to drive impact.

Finalsite is the most valued partner for K–12 schools to build trust, strengthen community, and grow enrollment. Ranked among the best EdTech Companies in America, Finalsite supports more than 7,000 schools and districts worldwide with an integrated platform for websites, communications, mobile apps, enrollment, and marketing services.

Headquartered in Glastonbury, Connecticut, Finalsite is a global company with employees working remotely across nearly every U.S. state, as well as throughout Europe, South America, and Asia.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, connected, and empowered to grow. That’s why we invest in our employees through competitive benefits, professional development opportunities, and a collaborative culture built on partnership and purpose. Whether you’re looking to expand your skills, take on new challenges, or make a meaningful impact in education, Finalsite offers the opportunity to grow your career while helping schools thrive.

At Finalsite, every interaction matters — with our clients, with each other, and with the schools and families we serve. Join us and help shape stronger school communities around the world

##### **SUMMARY**

The Digital Marketing Services (DMS) Project Coordinator is responsible for managing client relationships and coordinating the successful delivery of Finalsite’s digital marketing services, including Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Pay-Per-Click Advertising (PPC), and Social Advertising.

* Serving as the primary point of contact for assigned clients, the DMS Project Coordinator ensures services are delivered effectively and on schedule, communicates campaign performance and recommendations, coordinates work across internal teams and external partners, and maintains strong client relationships throughout the engagement.
* This role combines client relationship management, project management, and a working knowledge of digital marketing to help schools achieve their marketing, enrollment, and communication goals.

##### **LOCATION**

100% Remote - Anywhere within the US

Client & Project Management

* Serve as the primary point of contact for an assigned portfolio of Digital Marketing Services clients.
* Manage the day-to-day client experience and successful delivery of SEO, PPC, and Social Advertising services.
* Coordinate project timelines, deliverables, responsibilities, and next steps across clients, internal teams, and external partners.
* Maintain regular communication with clients through Zoom, email, and other communication channels.
* Lead client meetings, establish clear objectives and agendas, document next steps, and ensure appropriate follow-through.
* Maintain awareness of client goals, enrollment cycles, campaigns, and organizational priorities to help ensure services remain aligned with client needs.
* Proactively identify project risks, client concerns, or delivery challenges and escalate appropriately to the DMS Team Lead.

Digital Marketing & Performance

We're searching for a **Content Writer & Editor** who can write, edit, optimize, and publish content across a variety of digital platforms. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating engaging content, ensuring accuracy and consistency through editing, and publishing content that helps clients improve their online visibility.

The Content Writer & Editor will be responsible for producing original content, editing and proofreading content for quality and brand consistency, optimizing content for search engines, and publishing content across multiple website platforms. They also will be responsible for editing content within Pulse, which is our internal content tool that adds conversational content to our SEO strategies, creating visibility in AI Search Engines. jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About LawLers Barbecue**
==========================

LawLers Barbecue has been part of North Alabama since 1979.

What started as one family-owned restaurant is now

15 restaurants across North Alabama and Southern Tennessee, and the recipe

hasn’t changed: fresh, never-frozen pork, smoked low and slow – the pulled

pork, the ribs, the stuffie taters that keep folks coming back week after week.

Our guests give us sterling reviews across the board for our “Tickled Pink”

service. Those numbers don’t come from marketing. They come from the food and

the people who serve it. A big part of what has made

LawLers successful is that we protect what works, invest in what can be better,

and never compromise on the food. This role is a big part of that.

**The Job**
===========

We’re hiring our first in-house Marketing Manager, based in Huntsville. Your primary responsibility is to grow

restaurant traffic and repeat visits across our 15 locations. Historically,

most of our marketing has run through outside partners. You’ll bring focus and

consistency to how LawLers shows up in our communities and online.

You’ll direct our outside marketing partners and lead local events and partnerships, social and email,

and the advertising behind them. You’ll also generate catering demand in

partnership with our Catering Sales Coordinator, who owns catering prospecting,

guest relationships, and the sales process. We’ll fund outside help for bigger

photo and video productions so you can focus on reaching guests and improving

results. This is a build-it role. You’ll be our first and, for now, our only marketing hire, working directly with our

President and VP FINANCE. We’ve set aside a budget for outside coaching and

conferences so you’re not building alone. There’s real room to make it your own.

**What You’ll Own**
===================

* **Local and community marketing.** Build a prioritized local marketing calendar across

our 15 restaurants, including events, sponsorships, school and church

partnerships, and charity tie-ins like “Potatoes with a Purpose.” Give each

activation a clear audience, budget, restaurant partner, and measurement plan.

Coordinate community outreach with the Catering Sales Coordinator to avoid

duplicate approaches to the same organization.

* **Content creation.** Own the content plan and shoot

the everyday material yourself – the phone-in-hand moments in our restaurants.

For bigger productions, you’ll direct a project-based photo and video partner

on a budget you control. Real food, real portions, real team members – the way

our guests actually experience LawLers.

* **Social media.** Own our social calendar and brand voice across Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok.

Focus effort on the channels that reach our guests and drive action, using

outside partners where appropriate.

* **Email and guest retention.** Write to our VIP list in LawLers’ warm, familiar voice. Use

email and available loyalty tools to encourage first visits, repeat visits, and

reactivation. Test offers and messages, and measure visits and orders where the

data supports it.

* **Digital advertising and budget.** Recommend the marketing plan and budget for

President approval, with VP FINANCE input on economics. Manage approved

spending across search, social, and local campaigns. Set up practical tracking

before launch and work with the VP FINANCE to assess returns after advertising

costs, discounts, and relevant fees.

* **Agency and vendor management.** Direct our outside

SEO, creative, and media partners. Agree on the results up front, review their

work against those results, and tell us plainly when a relationship should be

renewed, renegotiated, or ended.

* **Catering marketing support.** Create catering campaigns, website inquiry paths, and

sales materials that help guests choose LawLers when feeding a crowd. Route

inquiries promptly to the Catering Sales Coordinator and review lead quality

and campaign results toget

**Bring Our Marketing In-House and Make the Phone Ring**

McLaurin Law is a Houston plaintiff-side firm. We represent Texas policyholders in insurance coverage disputes, injured people in personal injury cases, and property owners and contractors in construction litigation.

* **Lead generation vendors.** Selection, negotiation, tracking, and the decision to cut what does not perform.

* **The referral partner program.** Outreach, touch cadence, events, and source tracking.

**Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)**

**The role**

Own the public feed and the paid layer. You plan and publish, you answer the comments, and you run Meta and Google Display so the brand is not only “active” — it is generating inquiries.

This is not a caption-only intern seat. You will be judged on consistent posting, response time, and whether paid campaigns produce leads at a cost we can live with.

**Responsibilities**

**Organic**

* Manage Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok
* Content calendar 2–4 weeks out: stills, Reels/Shorts, carousels, project photos
* Write on-brand copy (California custom / modular / prefab; no generic “dream home” sludge)
* Schedule and publish in Meta Business Suite / native tools
* Light design in Canva; pull from photographer and job-site photos
* Monthly content report: what ran, what held, what to kill

**Engagement**

* Reply to comments and DMs within one business day during coverage hours
* Route leads via zapier to pipedrive and calendly.

* No spend increases without a written reason
