* Portfolio: 3–5 live or recent accounts + one paid campaign story (objective, spend, result)

We are Preservica, a global leader in Active Digital Preservation, trusted by organizations to preserve their most important digital records for decades to come. jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Hexmodal**

Hexmodal builds smart devices and a simple software platform that help facilities teams automate routine compliance testing, monitoring, and documentation. Our technology helps teams spend less time on manual rounds and more time on the maintenance work that keeps buildings operating safely. Today, Hexmodal supports more than 180 health systems across 48 states.

**The Mission**
---------------

We are hiring a Content Marketing Manager to build and run everything Hexmodal publishes.

Our buyer is a facilities manager or director at a hospital. Many of them were electricians, plumbers, or HVAC technicians before they moved into management. They are accountable for emergency lighting, fire extinguishers, cold storage, and room pressure across dozens of buildings, and for proving to a Joint Commission surveyor that every one of those tests actually happened. They are practical, mobile (not at their desks), short on time, and immediately suspicious of vendor-speak.

You will write for that person across four areas. Demand content, meaning the blog and our SEO program against the compliance questions our buyers genuinely search. Proof content, meaning customer case studies you source, interview, write, and get approved. Field and sales material, meaning conference presentations, speaking submissions, webinars, and the one-pagers and enablement assets our sales and partnerships teams request through creative briefs. And product content, meaning launches and new capabilities.

This is a hands-on role. You can bring in contractors when a project calls for it, you will partner with a designer on visuals, and you will build final assets yourself from our templates rather than handing off a document. You are inheriting an early-stage foundation. There is a small case study library, a new website that needs its content simplified, an SEO program in its first months, and a set of email templates. There is no content calendar yet and no measurement baseline. Most of what exists you will rebuild.

You will be measured on influenced pipeline, meaning the pipeline our campaigns generate with your content behind them.

**Role Outcomes**
-----------------

### **First 90 days**

* A content calendar with published assets, with every planned piece tied to a named audience, a purpose, and where it will reach people.
* 4 new customer case studies interviewed, written, and approved, with the customer approval path documented so anyone can repeat it.
* An intake process agreed with sales and partnerships for creative briefs, covering how requests are prioritized and what turnaround people can expect.
* Website content simplified on the top 10 pages that matter most.
* Content measurement set up in HubSpot so influenced pipeline can be reported from month four onward.

### **First 180 days**

* Publishing on a steady cadence of 6 pieces per month without missing dates.
* 12 case studies in the library, spanning the health system types sales asks about most.
* Conference presentations and speaking submissions produced against the field marketing calendar rather than assembled the week before.
* A webinar program launched, with 4 sessions delivered.
* The SEO program showing measurable gains on 10 priority compliance topics.
* A sales and partnerships asset library organized, current, and actually being used.

### **First year**

* Success will be measured in influenced pipeline attributable to content.
* Case study production running at 2 per month.
* Hexmodal appearing as a top cited source in AI-generated answers for our priority compliance questions.
* A written voice and style guide that contractors and other teams can produce from without you rewriting it.

**Competencies**
----------------

* **Four or more years in B2B content marketing**, writing and shipping on a consistent calendar. We will consider fewer years from someone with direct healthcare or facilities experience.
* **You write well for practical, technical people

jobs.desc:
Rugiet was founded on the belief that men's health has been underserved by an industry too comfortable with mediocre results. We built Ready, a patented, clinician-prescribed combination therapy that set a new standard for erectile dysfunction treatment - and then we proved the model by scaling it to tens of thousands of patients without a single retail shelf.

That success wasn't luck. It came from combining rigorous clinical science with a direct-to-patient model that removes the friction, the stigma, and the middlemen that have kept effective care out of reach for too long. Patients get better outcomes. We learn faster. The flywheel keeps spinning.

Now we're applying that same formula to a broader vision of men's health - sleep, hair loss, weight management, testosterone, and a supplements line built to the same standard as everything else we make. Each new category is an opportunity to do what we did in sexual health: find where the market is settling, build something better, and get it directly to the people who need it.

We're an Inc5000 remote-first team of builders, clinicians, marketers, and operators who move fast and take the work seriously. If you want to work on problems that matter, with people who hold themselves accountable, and at a company that's already proven its model - this is the place.

**The Role**
------------

Rugiet disrupted men's sexual health with a patented, clinical solution that outperforms everything else on the market. Now we're scaling into sleep, hair loss, weight management, and beyond - and paid social is one of the primary engines driving that growth.

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager who owns Paid Social end to end. You'll manage multi-million dollar monthly budgets across Meta and TikTok, partner with creative to build a high-velocity testing machine, and obsess over the numbers that actually matter: CAC, incrementality, and revenue per dollar spent. You think like a creative strategist but operate like an analyst. You don't wait to be told performance is down - you're already fixing it.

### **What You'll Own**

**Paid Social Execution.** Day-to-day management and optimization of campaigns across Meta, TikTok, and emerging channels. Full-funnel ownership from prospecting through retargeting.

**Budget & Efficiency.** You'll manage 7-figure monthly budgets with strict CAC targets. Scaling spend and maintaining efficiency aren't at odds here - that's the job.

**Creative Strategy & Testing.** Partner with the Creative team to build a structured testing engine. You develop hypotheses, design the tests, read the results, and feed the loop. You know what stops a scroll for our patient personas and you know how to prove it.

**Attribution & Analytics.** Work with our Analytics team to sharpen attribution models and measure true incrementality. You should be comfortable building your own dashboards and not waiting on someone else to tell you what's happening.

**Landing Page Optimization.** Collaborate with Digital Product to make sure the post-click experience converts. The ad getting the click is half the job.

**Compliance.** All creative, targeting, and messaging must adhere to FDA, FTC, and HIPAA requirements. Healthcare experience matters here.

### **You're a Fit If...**

You treat CAC targets like a personal commitment, not a guideline. When platform changes hit, you're already engineering the workaround before leadership asks. You have opinions about creative - strong ones, backed by data. You've managed $50M+ in annual spend and you didn't just survive it, you found efficiency others missed. You move fast, test faster, and document what you learn.

### **This Isn't for You If...**

You need a lot of process to get started. You report problems without bringing solutions. You think "we're waiting on the creative team" is an acceptable status update. You've never managed more than a few hundred thousand a month.

* Conduct competitive analysis to identify opportunities for differentiation and growth.
* Propose new channels, platforms, or strategies for testing and potential scaling.

**Qualifications & Skills**  

* **Experience:**
* 3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid search campaigns on Google Ads and Bing Ads.

* **Technical Skills:**
* Proficient with Google Ads, Bing Ads, Google Analytics, and other analytics/reporting tools.

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

jobs.desc:
Make the digital experience better. Make the brand stronger. Make the numbers move.

The Digital Marketing Specialist owns the day-to-day digital experience—keeping our website fresh, our content relevant, and our online presence working as hard as we do. This role blends creativity, technology, marketing, and data. You’ll manage website content and updates, create and launch digital campaigns, dig into user behavior, build SEO strategies, and use data to figure out what’s working—and what needs to change.  
  
\*\*This position is in-person located in our Yankton, SD store.

Qualified applicants must be able to successfully complete a pre-employment drug test and background check. C & B Operations, LLC is a drug-free workplace.

* **Competitive pay based on your experience**
* **Excellent benefits including** – Medical, Dental, Vision, and Accident Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Life Insurance, 401K with generous match, and much more.

* Own the website. Manage updates, content, campaigns, and ongoing improvements to keep the site accurate, relevant, and engaging.

* Take on special projects and find new ways to improve our digital presence and marketing results.

**Experience:**

* 2–5 years of digital marketing experience, including website management, SEO, social media, and paid digital campaigns Hands-on experience managing websites and creating digital content
* Experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, and Tag Manager Strong understanding of SEO strategy and tools
* Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to create content for a public audience
* A data-driven mindset and the ability to turn numbers into action
* Strong problem-solving skills, especially when technology decides not to cooperate
* Creativity and curiosity—you’re always looking for a better way to engage an audience and improve results
* Experience using AI tools to work faster and smarter

If you know your way around websites, SEO, Google Analytics, content, and digital campaigns—and you enjoy figuring out why people click, search, scroll, and buy—we want to talk to you.

jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

As Senior Lifecycle Marketing Manager, you own how Aircall talks to prospects and customers by email and in-app message. You build nurture series that move prospects toward conversion, run the engagement programs that keep existing customers active, and manage the calendar and intake process that keep every team's sends coordinated. You report into Product Marketing and work closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Product Management.

  

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Plan and execute campaigns across email and in-app messaging for prospects and customers, including nurture series, activation programs, and retention campaigns.
* Own the campaign intake process and lifecycle marketing calendar, coordinating sends across teams so customers and prospects do not receive conflicting or duplicate messages.
* Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to align nurture and prospect campaigns with pipeline and retention goals.
* Develop campaign briefs, audience segmentation, targeting strategy, and testing plans for each send.
* Collaborate with Designers to build and maintain an approved email template library
* Design and run A/B tests on subject lines, content, and timing to improve engagement across the lifecycle program.
* Set governance for email and in-app messaging, including frequency caps, approval steps, and review checkpoints.
* Own the NPS program and Trustpilot review strategy end to end, and route customer feedback to Product and Customer Success.
* Set KPIs for each campaign, track performance against goals, and use results to guide improvements.

  

### **Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of experience in lifecycle, CRM, or email marketing, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot
* Experience building nurture series and prospect campaigns, not just post-sale lifecycle programs.
* Experience running A/B tests and turning results into recommendations.
* Strong project management skills, comfortable owning a shared calendar and intake process across teams.
* Clear, direct writing skills and comfort working cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Customer Success.
* Strong AI fluency, with practical experience using AI to improve lifecycle strategy, personalization, content creation, or execution.
* A test-and-learn mindset, with a habit of reviewing live campaigns regularly and iterating quickly based on results.
* Experience owning an NPS or customer review program.
* Familiarity with in-app messaging

jobs.desc:
**Social Media Manager — Empire Restaurant Group**  
**Location: Naperville and Lombard, Illinois**

Empire Restaurant Group is looking for a creative, organized, and consistent Social Media Manager to bring our restaurants to life online.

Our portfolio includes Empire Burgers & Brew in Naperville and Lombard, Hizemans, Fiamme, The Northcott, The George, and The Belmont. Each restaurant has its own personality, and we want someone who can capture what makes each one special—from a great burger and a busy game day to an exceptional steak dinner or cocktail.

This is a hands-on role. You’ll spend time in our restaurants, build relationships with our teams, and create content that makes people want to visit.

**What you’ll do**

* Manage Instagram, Facebook, and other relevant social channels across our restaurants.
* Shoot and edit engaging photos, short videos, Reels, and Stories.
* Build and maintain a content calendar with consistent posting for every location.
* Promote menu items, specials, events, private dining, and new offerings.
* Work with restaurant managers to identify timely content and promotional opportunities.
* Respond to comments and messages professionally and promptly.
* Coordinate local creator partnerships and paid social campaigns.
* Track results and provide a simple monthly report on audience growth, engagement, and actions that support restaurant visits and bookings.
* Maintain a distinct voice and visual style for each restaurant.

**Who we’re looking for**

* Experience managing social media for restaurants, hospitality, lifestyle, or consumer brands.
* Strong photography, video editing, and writing skills.
* Comfortable creating content with a phone and appearing on camera or directing others when needed.
* Organized enough to manage multiple brands and meet deadlines.
* Someone who follows through consistently and takes ownership without needing daily reminders.
* An eye for good food, atmosphere, and the details that make hospitality memorable.
* Ability to travel between Naperville and Lombard, with occasional evening and weekend availability to capture events and busy service periods.

**What success looks like**

A steady stream of quality content, recognizable personalities for each restaurant, timely promotion of what’s happening, and measurable progress in turning online attention into guests walking through our doors.

**To apply**

Send your résumé, links to accounts you’ve managed, and three examples of content you personally created. Tell us briefly how you would approach managing social media for several restaurants with different personalities. You will need to send examples of posts that you would create for our brands, either screen shots or shared files etc.

Pay: $60,000.00 - $70,000.00 per year

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount

You will be the person who decides what Doers posts, designs how it looks, and builds the following that turns a name into a movement.

Working with our Marketing Specialist, you’ll run our social media channels to create content and manage the comments to build Utah Doers’ social media strategy. jobs.title: Freelance Marketing Specialist
jobs.desc:
**Job title:** Freelance Creatives: Photo, Video, Design, Copy & Web (Cleveland, OH)  
**Job type:** Contract / project-based

**About Savori Media**  
Savori Media is a Cleveland-based growth marketing agency. We help local and regional businesses, from home services and wellness to restaurants and real estate, get found, get leads, and grow. We're a small, founder-led team, and we're building a bench of reliable freelancers to produce the work.

**Who we're looking for**  
Independent creatives and specialists for one-time and small projects. You don't need to do everything. Tell us what you're great at:

* Photographers (hourly, half-day, and full-day shoots)
* Videographers and video editors (promos, reels, short-form)
* Copywriters (ad copy, website copy, blog and SEO/GEO articles, email/SMS, social captions)
* Web designers and builders (landing pages, small websites)
* SEO/GEO specialists (audits, schema setup, Google Business Profile setup)
* Graphic and brand designers (flyers, social posts, logos, menus, signage)
* Billboard and out-of-home designers (static and digital)
* Merch and product designers (graphics and mockups)

**How the work works**

* Every job comes with a brief, a clear scope, a set turnaround, and a flat rate from our rate card. No bidding and no haggling.
* One round of revisions is included in every package.
* You're paid within 14 days of approved delivery.
* Work is project-based. Jobs come in as clients sign, and we can't guarantee a set amount of work.

**Pay**  
Flat per-project rates, roughly $15 to $750 depending on the service. A few examples: single flyer or post, $25. Short promo reel, $100. Blog or GEO article, $60. Landing page, $200. Mini photo shoot, $75. We send the full rate card for your services before your first job.

**What you'll need**

* A portfolio link that shows the work you want to do for us
* Your own equipment and software
* Reliability: you hit deadlines and reply quickly
* Comfort working from a brief and to a spec
* Willingness to sign our Freelancer Rate Card & Work Agreement before your first job

**Good to know**

* This is independent contractor work. You handle your own taxes, insurance, and equipment.
* Finished work belongs to Savori or our client once you're paid, and client information stays confidential. You can show the work in your portfolio with our written permission.
* Shoots are on-site in the Cleveland area. Digital work can be done remotely.

Pay: $100.00 - $1,000.00 per month

Work Location: On the road

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Analyst, Revenue Operations
jobs.desc:
**About Stream**
----------------

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

**The role**
------------

We're looking for a Marketing Operations Analyst to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the lead-management, outreach and marketing technology setup that Marketing, SDRs and Sales rely on every

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in our Boulder office, with 3 days a week in the office.

**What you'll work on**
-----------------------

You'll own Stream's marketing technology and lead-management setup end to end. In practice that means every inbound lead routes to the right person, SDRs follow up within SLA, marketing automation and outreach tooling run reliably, and funnel data is accurate enough that people trust the dashboards instead of arguing about them. You'll work with Marketing, Sales Development, Sales, Customer Success and Data Engineering, plus our automation, outreach, enrichment and deliverability vendors. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations. The bar is simple: when something breaks, you know before Marketing or the SDR team tells you.

**Job responsibilities:**

* Own lead routing: design and run the lead lifecycle end to end, with SLA tracking, so no inbound lead is lost, misrouted or left untouched.
* Run marketing automation and outreach: campaign operations, list management, data plumbing and email deliverability, plus helping SDRs get the most out of outbound tools like Nooks.
* Build monitoring: set up checks on routing, follow-up, outreach and marketing data flows, so failures and slowdowns show up here first.
* Keep the data trusted: maintain accurate marketing and funnel data, and core dashboards that work for both daily operations and analysis.
* Govern Salesforce: manage marketing objects, fields, permissions and integrations with good security hygiene.
* Automate the friction: simplify and automate lead-management and marketing operations workflows instead of absorbing recurring manual work.
* Bring solutions: flag risks, gaps and recommendations to Marketing and Revenue Operations early, with a proposed fix attached.

**About you**
-------------

You're the person who notices the routing rule that broke on Tuesday before anyone else does. You like owning a system end to end, you work independently, and you'd rather automate a recurring problem than fix it by hand every week. You're comfortable pushing back on Marketing, SDRs and Sales when a shortcut will cost data quality later. Stream is a scale-up, so things move quickly and not every process is documented yet. If you want a fully defined stack and a ticket queue, this probably isn't the role.

**You have:**

* 3+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations or platform management at a B2B SaaS company
* Hands-on Salesforce experience, including campaigns, leads, routing and basic admin
* Experience owning a marketing automation platform: workflows, campaigns, segmentation and lead scoring or grading
* Experience designing lead routing and the lead lifecycle, including SLA tracking
* Experience using AI tools to analyze data and turn it into clear actions
* Strong attention to detail, and a record of catching data and routing problems before stakeholders do
* Clear communication, and the confidence to set and enforce best practices across Marketing, SDR and Sales

**Bonus points:**

* Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and migrating between marketing automation platforms
* Outreach and sales engagement tooling, including deliverability and domain reputation
* BigQuery and Looker, or comparable warehouse and BI tools
* Building automated heal

**IN-PERSON POSITION**  
Summary

The Marketing Manager will drive the development and execution of strategic marketing initiatives to increase brand awareness, generate qualified leads, and support business growth. This role oversees marketing campaigns across digital, social, and traditional channels, manages the marketing team, and collaborates cross-functionally to align marketing efforts with company objectives. The ideal candidate combines creativity, data-driven decision-making, and strong leadership to deliver measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Growth

* Drive AVTECH’s growth by developing and executing a comprehensive marketing strategy and annual campaign calendar.
* Translate market insights and campaign analytics into actionable strategies that uncover new customers, markets, and revenue opportunities.
* Partner with Product and Sales teams to launch new products and features with strategic go-to-market plans that accelerate adoption and revenue.
* Deliver executive insights through dashboards, reports, and actionable recommendations that drive business decisions.

2. Digital Marketing & Campaign Execution

* Lead high-impact digital marketing initiatives, including paid search, SEO, social media, email automation, remarketing, and website optimization, to maximize reach and conversions.
* Manage social media and digital presence to increase engagement, drive traffic, and support lead generation.
* Leverage analytics platforms such as Google Analytics and Microsoft Clarity to measure performance, optimize campaigns, and deliver measurable results.
* Maximize ROI by managing budgets, agencies, and vendors with strategic oversight.

3. Content Development & Brand Management

* Craft compelling content across all channels, press releases, newsletters, case studies, videos, infographics, and product materials, that engages audiences and strengthens brand authority.
* Ensure brand consistency and maintain a strong, distinctive AVTECH voice across all communications and campaigns.

4. Events & Demand Generation

* Elevate visibility and generate qualified leads through industry events, tradeshows, and webinars.

5. Team Leadership & Development

* Build and mentor a high-performing marketing team, fostering growth, accountability, and excellence both internally and externally..
* Develop and conduct training programs to strengthen marketing capabilities and ensure team alignment with organizational goals.

6. Other Responsibilities

* Perform other duties as assigned.

KPI’s & Metrics

To ensure transparency, accountability, and performance focus, success in this role will be measured by the following core KPIs:

Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) Generated

* Target: 8 MQLs per day
* Metric: Track daily lead generation and pipeline contribution; monitor lead quality and conversion potential.

Advertising Return on Ad Spend (RoAS)

* Target: Minimum 3:1
* Metric: Evaluate paid campaigns by comparing revenue generated to advertising spend; adjust campaigns for maximum ROI.

Website Organic Traffic Growth

* Target: 10% Year-over-Year (YoY) increase
* Metric: Monitor organic traffic through SEO performance, content marketing effectiveness, and referral sources.

Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)

* Target: Optimize CAC while maintaining lead quality
* Metric: Track cost per acquired customer across campaigns; identify opportunities to improve efficiency and reduce spend.

Email Marketing Performance

* Targets: Open Rate ≥ 22%, Click-Through Rate (CTR) ≥ 4%
* Metric: Measure engagement through email campaigns; analyze subject lines, content, and send timing to improve results.

Social Media Engagement Growth

* Target: Positive YoY growth % (specific % can be defined per quarter)
* Metric: Track likes, shares, comments, and overall follower engagement; optimize social content strategy for maximum reach and interaction.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Public Relations, Communicati

- **Lifecycle Marketing Specialist**

  LASCANA USA | Reports to: Director of Growth | Hybrid – Jacksonville, FL

  **Position Summary**

  The Lifecycle Marketing Specialist executes LASCANA USA’s retention strategy across email, SMS and loyalty. This hands-on role manages campaigns and automated journeys across the customer lifecycle from converting non-buyers to increasing repeat purchases and reactivating lapsed customers. The specialist also manages promotional planning for these channels and uses customer data to improve targeting, personalization and performance.

  This role works closely with the Director of Growth. Given the breadth of the role, spanning campaign execution, promotional planning, loyalty and testing, we're looking for someone who thrives on variety and can move fluidly between hands-on execution and strategic analysis.

  **Key Responsibilities**

  **Lifecycle Marketing**

  * Execute programs for non-buyers, first-time buyers, repeat customers, high-value customers and lapsed customers.
  * Use purchase history, browsing behavior, engagement and customer value to improve segmentation and personalization.
  * Manage contact frequency and coordinate messaging across email, SMS and loyalty.

  **Campaign Execution**

  * Build, schedule, test, tag and deploy email and SMS campaigns.
  * Manage automated journeys, including welcome, cart abandonment, post-purchase and more.
  * Coordinate audience selection, content, product selection, send times, tracking and promotional codes.
  * Review campaign content and complete quality assurance before deployment.
  * Monitor campaign delivery, accuracy, deliverability and compliance.

  **Promotional Planning**

  * Maintain the promotional calendar for email, SMS and loyalty.
  * Translate product launches, seasonal events, merchandising priorities and inventory needs into channel plans.
  * Recommend the audience, timing, message, offer and channel for each promotion.
  * Coordinate offer details, codes, exclusions and campaign setup.
  * Analyze promotion performance and recommend improvements.
  * Balance revenue goals with margin, customer relevance and promotional frequency.

  **Loyalty and Reviews**

  * Integrate loyalty and review communications into campaigns and automated journeys.
  * Execute programs that increase loyalty enrollment, engagement, reward redemption and repeat purchases.
  * Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve platform or integration issues (e.g., data-sync errors, API/connector outages), escalating technical fixes to Technology as needed.

  **Testing and Analysis**

  * Maintain a test-and-learn calendar covering audiences, content, offers, calls to action, send times and frequency.
  * Analyze & document performance by campaign, customer segment and lifecycle stage.
  * Partner with the Director of Growth to identify customer trends and recommend actions.

  **Cross-Functional Coordination**

  * Work with Marketing, Creative, E-commerce, Merchandising and Technology to execute customer communications.
  * Prepare campaign briefs for the graphics artist.
  * Manage external platform and agency partners as needed.
  * Prioritize ad hoc requests alongside planned campaigns.

  **Qualifications**

  **Required**

  * 2+ years of experience in email, SMS, CRM, lifecycle or retention marketing.
  * 2+ years of e-commerce or direct-to-consumer experience.
  * Experience building high-volume campaigns in an ESP (Attentive or a comparable platform).
  * Proven ability to translate analytic data into strategic ideas.
  * Understanding of segmentation, personalization and automated journeys.
  * Experience with promotional calendars, campaign testing and performance reporting.
  * Strong analytical, organizational and project-management skills.
  * High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

jobs.desc:

This role is ideal for someone who lives and breathes social media, understands trends, and knows how to turn everyday moments into engaging content that builds trust, attracts new patients, and showcases our brand.

You should be comfortable creating content in a fast-paced medical office setting while maintaining professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail.

Responsibilities

* Manage all company social media platforms including **Instagram, Facebook, TikTok**, and future channels
* Create engaging photo, video, and written content that reflects the brand voice
* Capture behind-the-scenes footage, office culture, procedures (where appropriate), patient stories, and educational content
* Edit short-form videos/Reels for maximum engagement
* Develop creative campaigns, promotions, giveaways, and brand awareness strategies

* Stay current on trends, hashtags, algorithm changes, and viral content opportunities
* Build and maintain a consistent posting schedule
* Respond professionally to comments, messages, and online engagement when needed
* Monitor analytics, growth metrics, engagement, and traffic performance
* Suggest new ideas to increase followers, leads, and patient conversions
* Coordinate with staff and providers to gather content opportunities
* Protect patient privacy and ensure HIPAA compliance in all content

Qualifications

* Proven experience managing business social media accounts
* Strong experience with **Instagram, Facebook, TikTok**
* Excellent skills in photo/video capture and editing
* Creative eye for branding, aesthetics, and storytelling
* Strong writing, grammar, and proofreading skills
* Knowledge of Canva, CapCut, Adobe, or similar editing platforms preferred
* Organized, dependable, and able to multitask efficiently
* Self-starter who brings new ideas without needing constant direction
* Comfortable working in a professional medical environment
* Knowledge of SEO, hashtags, analytics, and growth strategy preferred

Preferred Traits

* Fun, upbeat personality
* Trend-aware and confident on camera/content creation
* Strong sense of urgency and time management
* Detail-oriented with pride in quality work
* Passion for beauty, wellness, aesthetics, or healthcare marketing

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, or related field preferred (experience may substitute).

jobs.title: Social Media Strategist
jobs.desc:
If you live and breathe social media, understand what makes content perform, and can teach others how to do it well, we need to talk.

We’re looking for a creative, strategic, and highly skilled Social Media Strategist to lead social media strategy and creative direction across multiple client accounts.

This is a skilled lead role. You won’t just oversee the work, you need to know how to do it at a high level and be able to teach others how to do it, too. You should bring strong experience in social media strategy, paid social, graphic design, video editing, and content creation.

You should understand not only what to create, but why it works for a specific platform, audience, and goal.

You are not just managing social media, you are setting the standard and helping your team become better marketers.

**What You’ll Do**

* Develop and lead social media strategies across multiple client accounts
* Build platform-specific strategies based on client goals, audiences, and brands
* Lead organic and paid social media strategy, including campaign setup, targeting, testing, optimization, and performance
* Develop creative content ideas and campaigns designed to drive engagement and growth
* Provide creative direction for graphics, video, Reels, and other social-first content
* Use your design and video editing skills to evaluate work and improve creative quality
* Analyze performance and use data to adjust strategy and improve results
* Oversee content calendars and ensure the team stays ahead of schedule
* Lead client conversations related to social media strategy, content, and performance
* Coach and develop Social Media Content Creators
* Provide hands-on training in strategy, paid social, design, video editing, and content creation
* Review work and provide clear, actionable feedback that helps the team improve
* Stay ahead of platform updates, trends, algorithms, and emerging content formats

  

**How You’ll Show Up in This Role**

* Lead from expertise, not just authority
* Be willing and able to jump into the work when needed
* Bring strong creative vision and strategic thinking
* Teach the why behind decisions, not just what needs to change
* Give constructive feedback and help others improve their skills
* Balance creativity with data and performance
* Take ownership and make decisions without waiting for direction
* Stay curious and continuously bring new ideas and knowledge to the team
* Communicate confidently with clients and internal teams
* Maintain high standards for quality, consistency, and follow-through

  

**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)**

* Consistent, high-quality social content across client accounts
* Improved engagement, reach, growth, and account-specific KPIs
* Social strategies aligned with each client’s goals and broader marketing strategy
* Content calendars consistently planned and executed ahead of schedule
* Strong organic and paid social performance with data-backed strategic adjustments
* Regular new content ideas, tests, and creative concepts
* Positive client feedback on social strategy, content, and communication
* Measurable growth and development of Social Media Content Creators
* Fewer recurring quality issues as the team’s skills improve

  

**What We’re Looking For**

* Proven experience developing and leading social media strategy
* Strong understanding of Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and how strategy differs across platforms
* Strong hands-on experience with paid social advertising, particularly Meta Ads
* Experience managing targeting, budgets, creative testing, optimization, and paid social performance
* Strong graphic design background and creative eye
* Video editing experience, particularly short-form social content
* Strong writing, content creation, and storytelling skills
* Ability to analyze social media performance and turn data into action
* Experience managing multiple accounts or campaigns
* Ability to coach, train, and develop other social media pro

jobs.title: Marketing Analyst
jobs.desc:
**Overview**
------------

mhp.si is a digital marketing agency in Little Rock, Arkansas, serving more than 150 clients across a variety of locations and industries. The Marketing Analyst role joins our Marketing Technology team and supports their full range of work: SEO, AI search visibility, content strategy, marketing automation, CRM management, email marketing, analytics setup and tracking, and automated client reporting.

This is an entry-level role for someone who is curious about how marketing technology and data work, and eager to grow with the team. You don't need to know our tools on day one. We'll teach you. What you do need is real, hands-on experience using AI tools to work faster and think better, an interest in finding the story inside the numbers, the drive to pick up new skills quickly, and the professionalism to represent our team well with clients.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Pull and organize data from GA4, Google Search Console, BigQuery, and SEO platforms to support client reporting and analysis.
* Help set up, audit, and maintain GA4 properties and Google Tag Manager containers so client tracking is accurate and conversions are measured correctly.
* Build and maintain automated reports and dashboards, and flag anything in the data that looks off or worth a closer look.
* Help build and maintain marketing automation workflows, such as lead nurture sequences, form follow-ups, and triggered campaigns, and test them to make sure they fire correctly.
* Support CRM management by keeping contact records, lists, and pipeline data clean, organized, and properly connected to website forms and tracking.
* Assist with email marketing, including building and QA-testing campaigns, managing audience segments, and reporting on opens, clicks, and conversions.
* Support local SEO work, including Google Business Profile management, citation cleanup, and location page optimization.
* Assist with content research and optimization, such as keyword and topic research, content briefs, and on-page recommendations.
* Help monitor how clients appear in AI search tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity, and document what's driving those results.
* Work with account managers and other specialists to turn findings into clear, practical next steps for clients.
* Join client meetings and calls to present findings, walk through reports, and explain recommendations in plain language, taking on more client-facing work as you grow in the role.
* Use AI tools to speed up research, analysis, documentation, and repetitive tasks, and share useful workflows with the team.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 0-2 years experience
* Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Internships, freelance work, and personal projects all count.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Demonstrated experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) for real work, not just casual use. Be ready to show us how you use them.
* Genuine interest in data analysis. Any experience with GA4, SQL or reporting dashboards is a bonus.
* A fast, willing learner who is comfortable being told "figure it out" and knows how to find answers.
* Strong attention to detail, especially when checking data and tracking.

We're hiring a Paid Media Specialist to turn Noteable's go-to-market strategy into well-run, measurable paid acquisition campaigns. You'll work closely with our Director of Sales and Marketing, who leads Noteable's GTM strategy, to execute across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Reddit, retargeting platforms, and other approved channels as our approach evolves.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes getting close to the work: building campaigns, writing and testing ad copy, managing audiences and retargeting, monitoring performance, and following the data until the story makes sense. jobs.desc:
**Social Media Strategist**

**Reports To:** Head of Results

**Location:** San Antonio, TX

**Type:** Full-Time

**About the Role**

If you're the kind of person who can't scroll through a brand's social feed without immediately thinking about what you'd do differently, you'll probably like this role. This person will own organic social strategy and execution across a diverse portfolio of brands: developing content concepts, writing copy, managing communities, analyzing performance, spotting opportunities, and continually deciding what we should do next.

This isn't a role for someone who wants to fill a content calendar and call it a day. We want someone curious about **why** content performs, pays attention when it doesn't, and has the autonomy and judgment to shift their time toward the work that will cultivate the strongest online communities (Tribes) for the brands we serve.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Own organic social strategy and day-to-day execution across a portfolio of partner brands, primarily across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and other relevant platforms.
* Source, coordinate, and manage influencer relationships on behalf of the social brands we serve.
* Develop content concepts that connect each brand's goals, audience, voice, platform, and larger marketing strategy.
* Write sharp, brand-aligned social copy and confidently adapt between very different brand voices.
* Analyze social performance regularly and translate the numbers into insights: what's working, what isn't, why, and what we should do differently.
* Take ownership of improving social performance rather than simply completing planned deliverables.
* Manage day-to-day community engagement across partner accounts, from responding to comments, messages, and reviews to proactively identifying opportunities to join relevant conversations.
* Keep a pulse on platform changes, emerging formats, cultural conversations, and trends, identifying which are genuinely worth pursuing for each brand.
* Concept social-first Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, and other content rather than simply adapting traditional marketing assets for social. Capture informal photo and video content when a social-first or timely opportunity calls for it.
* Collaborate with Digital Marketers and creatives to bring larger brand and campaign ideas to life on social.
* Present content concepts, strategies, and performance insights internally and to partners when needed.
* Manage multiple brands with different posting cadences, priorities, audiences, and levels of social investment without losing sight of where your time will have the greatest impact.

**What We're Looking For**

We're less interested in someone who checks every traditional social media box. We're looking for someone with the right combination of instinct, curiosity, analytical thinking, initiative, and the drive to keep learning as social media evolves.

You'll probably thrive here if you:

* Have a few years of hands-on social media experience and a strong working knowledge of major social platforms.
* Are an exceptional writer who can move comfortably between different voices, industries, audiences, and formats.
* Understand that good social media is equal parts creative instinct and performance analysis.
* Can look at a social report and tell us more than what went up or down. You want to understand **why**.
* Have strong creative instincts and can turn a business objective, audience insight, trend, or half-formed idea into a compelling social concept.
* Have enough design and editing ability to move quickly when needed. You don't need to be a professional designer or videographer, but Canva and light editing shouldn't scare you.
* Are comfortable capturing social-first content yourself when the moment calls for it.
* Understand internet culture and naturally pay attention to how brands, creators, and people are using social platforms.
* Are highly organized and comfortable managing multiple brands and

Support MERGE's practice in creating, optimizing, and executing top-tier client paid search campaigns. jobs.title: Social Media and Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about crafting compelling stories and building vibrant online communities? We’re seeking an energetic and detail-oriented Social Media and Marketing Manager to lead our digital marketing efforts! In this role, you will develop innovative social media strategies, create engaging content, and analyze campaign performance to elevate our brand presence across multiple platforms. Your creativity and analytical skills will drive impactful marketing campaigns that resonate with diverse audiences, boost engagement, and support our overall business objectives. Join us to make a dynamic impact in the digital space and help shape our brand’s story!

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute comprehensive social media marketing strategies across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok to increase brand awareness and engagement.
* Create, curate, and manage high-quality content including graphics, videos, photography, and written posts that align with brand voice and marketing goals.
* Monitor social media channels using tools like Hootsuite or Buffer to schedule posts, respond to comments, and engage with followers in a timely manner.
* Utilize social listening tools to gather insights on audience preferences, industry trends, and competitor activities to inform content planning.
* Analyze media performance metrics using analytics tools such as Google Analytics and social media analytics platforms to measure campaign effectiveness and optimize future initiatives.
* Manage paid advertising campaigns on Facebook Advertising and other social media ad platforms to maximize reach and ROI.
* Collaborate with public relations teams to enhance brand reputation through strategic communication efforts and media outreach.
* Conduct keyword research for content optimization to improve SEO rankings and organic visibility across digital channels.
* Oversee branding consistency across all digital assets while maintaining high standards of proofreading and media editing for professional presentation.
* Track digital marketing performance through detailed reporting on marketing analytics, social media metrics, website traffic, and campaign ROI.

**Requirements**

* Proven experience in social media management, content creation, digital marketing performance monitoring, and social media marketing strategies.
* Proficiency in graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Adobe Creative Suite, along with video editing skills for multimedia content creation.
* Strong knowledge of social media platforms’ algorithms, advertising options (including Facebook Advertising), and media editing tools.
* Familiarity with web analytics tools like Google Analytics and web analytics principles for measuring online campaign success.
* Excellent written communication skills with an eye for proofreading and content writing tailored for diverse audiences.
* Ability to perform keyword research and utilize SEO best practices to enhance online visibility.
* Experience with social listening tools such as Hootsuite or Buffer for audience insights and trend analysis.
* Strong relationship management skills for collaborating across teams including public relations, branding, graphic design, and digital marketing performance monitoring teams.
* Ability to analyze data from various sources including social media analytics platforms to inform strategic decisions.

Join us as a vital part of our team where your creativity fuels innovative campaigns! We are committed to providing paid opportunities that empower you to grow your skills while making a meaningful impact through dynamic digital storytelling.

Pay: From $40,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.desc:
**Overview**

**Gotham Studios**, an Emmy Award-winning creative production company, is expanding into integrated marketing and seeking an experienced digital marketing specialist to join our team on a part-time basis.

Our initial focus is performing arts organizations in the San Francisco Bay Area, with the opportunity to grow alongside Gotham's developing marketing practice.

We're looking for someone who knows how to take excellent creative material—videos, photography, graphics, and compelling copy—and turn it into effective digital marketing campaigns that build audiences, generate engagement, and sell tickets.

What you'll do

* **Social media:** Manage and schedule posts across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and potentially TikTok, adapting content for each platform.
* **Audience targeting:** Identify and reach potential new audiences, including younger arts and music enthusiasts, using organic and paid digital marketing.
* **Digital advertising:** Plan and manage modest Meta and Google advertising campaigns, monitor performance, and optimize results.
* **Email marketing:** Prepare and distribute promotional campaigns, manage mailing lists, and develop effective audience segmentation.
* **Website:** Maintain and update promotional content, optimize event pages, and coordinate basic search-engine optimization.
* **Analytics:** Track engagement, website traffic, email performance, advertising results, and ticket-sale conversions where data is available.
* **Campaign coordination:** Maintain a marketing calendar, manage deadlines, and help ensure that campaigns are executed consistently and on time.
* **Client communication:** Participate in occasional planning meetings and represent Gotham Studios professionally.

You'll work directly with Gotham's founder and creative director, who will lead campaign concepts, copywriting, graphic design, and video production.

What we're looking for

* At least 2–3 years of practical digital marketing experience, including hands-on campaign execution.
* Proficiency with Meta Business Suite, digital advertising tools, email marketing platforms, and basic analytics.
* Experience targeting audiences and evaluating campaign effectiveness.
* Familiarity with website content management and practical SEO.
* Strong organizational skills, responsiveness, and the ability to work independently.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence participating in client meetings.

Experience marketing performing arts, music, cultural organizations, or nonprofits is highly desirable.

Basic video production skills are welcome but **not required**. Gotham handles professional video production in-house.

The arrangement

* **Hours:** Approximately 4–6 hours weekly to start, with additional hours during active concert campaigns, by mutual agreement.
* **Location:** Remote, with a preference for San Francisco Bay Area candidates who know the local arts market.
* **Compensation:** Anticipated range of $40–$60 per hour, depending on qualifications and agreed responsibilities.
* **Start:** As soon as practicable following confirmation of our initial client engagement.
* **Status:** This is an anticipated opportunity, contingent upon finalization of a client contract. Employment classification and contractual terms will be confirmed before engagement.

The right person will have an opportunity to become a valued part of Gotham's expanding marketing practice, work directly with clients, and help shape how we bring exceptional creative work to new audiences.

How to apply

Please send the following to **jobs@gothamstudios.com**:

* A résumé or LinkedIn profile.
* A brief description of relevant campaigns you've managed.
* Examples of work, preferably with measurable results.
* Your hourly rate and approximate availability.

We're particularly interested in candidates who combine creative judgment with technical competence, independence, and a genuine enthusiasm for the performing arts.

Pay: $40.00 - $60.00 per h

jobs.desc:
**Acquisition Marketing Manager (Fine Jewelry)**

GOODSTONE creates engagement rings, wedding bands, and fine jewelry for clients who research, compare, and often book a showroom appointment before purchasing. We’re looking for a hands-on, analytical, and resourceful Acquisition Marketing Manager to own the flow of qualified clients to our website and showrooms.

This individual contributor role focuses on executing campaigns, managing agency partners, analyzing performance, and identifying opportunities to improve acquisition.

**Instructions:** Email **info@goodstoneinc.com** with your resume and a cover letter outlining your relevant experience and interest in GOODSTONE.

**Job responsibilities include:**

* **Acquisition Dashboard:** Track qualified traffic and leads by channel and showroom, identify performance changes, and manage active tests.
* **Paid Search:** Partner with our current agency, review campaign changes and reporting, and progressively take over campaigns directly as you demonstrate results.
* **SEO & AI Search:** Monitor buyer search behavior, including visibility across ChatGPT and Gemini. Manage our SEO partner, update website pages, and maintain accurate product and showroom information.
* **Affiliate Marketing:** Recruit editorial and creator partners, establish commissions, and ensure commissions are tied to genuinely new clients.
* **Booking Conversion:** Test product and showroom pages to increase appointment bookings.
* **Local Search:** Manage Google listings across all four showrooms.
* **Reddit:** Monitor conversations about GOODSTONE and the jewelry category, sharing relevant buyer insights.
* **Tracking & Attribution:** Maintain accurate UTMs and source tagging to track client acquisition.

Brand strategy, creative production, social posting, PR, email programs, and events are owned by other team members.

**Candidates must be/have:**

* 3–4 years of hands-on digital acquisition experience
* Direct Google Ads experience, including search terms, negative keywords, budgets, and bidding
* Working SEO knowledge, including Google Search Console, evaluating rankings, and updating pages independently
* Strong working knowledge of GA4
* Experience managing agencies and questioning their reporting
* A proactive, analytical mindset with the ability to investigate performance changes and act independently

**A plus:**

* Experience managing multiple channels at a growing business
* Experience marketing considered purchases involving consultations or appointments, such as bridal, jewelry, aesthetics, dermatology, elective medical, or premium home services
* Affiliate program experience

Jewelry knowledge is not required. We will teach you.

**How We Measure Success**

* **Qualified Acquisition:** Growth in qualified traffic, leads, and showroom appointments
* **Channel Performance:** Identifying what drives results and acting on changes
* **Conversion:** Improving appointment bookings and qualified inquiries
* **Attribution:** Maintaining reliable source tracking
* **Ownership:** Proactively identifying issues and implementing solutions
* **Partner Accountability:** Holding agencies to clear deliverables and measurable results

**How We Hire**

Expect a practical exercise using real account data. We will ask what you personally did in previous roles, not what your team or agency did.

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Work Location:** In person, Austin, TX

Pay: $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.desc:
**DIGITAL MARKETING MANAGER**

The Luminos Fund, an international nonprofit bringing education opportunities to the world's most vulnerable children, seeks a Digital Marketing Manager to help more people discover, engage with, and support our education mission. This is an opportunity for an ambitious, creative, data-informed marketer to grow Luminos' reach among prospective donors and influencers, and convert that interest into lasting, quantifiable engagement and support.

The Digital Marketing Manager will manage Luminos' social media channels, digital audience growth, and outreach for major fundraising and awareness campaigns. Working closely with colleagues in Development and Communications, the manager will expand Luminos' online reach by bringing Luminos stories and evidence to new audiences, engage and steward our existing online champions, and enhance the online experience for Luminos supporters. A central priority will be to expand Luminos' online individual giving program, with success measured against growth in online contributors. This role will own digital marketing planning, execution, and reporting across channels, working in tight alignment with Luminos' broader messaging and editorial priorities.

This new full-time role will report to the Senior Director of Communications within the Development & Communications team. We prefer candidates based in Boston or London, for overlap with the team, but will consider exceptional candidates based remotely within time zones from U.S. Eastern Time and GMT. Occasional travel may be required. We are looking to fill this position as soon as possible.

**About The Luminos Fund**

The Luminos Fund (www.luminosfund.org (http://www.luminosfund.org/)) provides transformative education programs to thousands of vulnerable children each year, helping them to catch up to grade level and prepare for lifelong learning. Working in partnership with community-based organizations in sub-Saharan Africa and the Middle East, Luminos is scaling up its accelerated learning program through the Luminos Method (www.luminosmethod.org) (http://www.luminosmethod.org/) — an evidence-based approach that helps children catch up fast and discover the joy of learning.

Luminos is supported by a range of funding partners, including Cartier Philanthropy for People and Nature, the Gates Foundation, UBS Optimus Foundation, and UNICEF. Luminos has been recognized for its achievements globally, receiving the Klaus J. Jacobs Best Practice Prize, the Library of Congress International Literacy Award, the Lipman Family Prize, the WISE Award, and the HundrED Global Innovation Award.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Online Individual Giving Strategy**

* Build Luminos' online individual giving strategy. Luminos does not currently have a dedicated online individual giving program; this role will design and launch one and grow this segment through new donor acquisition, conversion, stewardship, and retention, including recurring giving.

* Develop distinct messaging for individual donors, with differentiated content, calls to action, and communication frequency by segment, in partnership with Development & Communications colleagues.

* Create and implement a post-giving engagement plan, including gift acknowledgment, welcome and onboarding journeys, impact updates, and second-gift and recurring-giving invitations, to deepen relationships and retain donors.

* Manage Luminos' presence on third-party online giving platforms (e.g., giving marketplaces, workplace giving, and donor-advised fund platforms), including keeping profiles current and compelling, participating in platform campaigns and giving days, and ensuring gifts and donor data are tracked in Salesforce.

**Email Marketing & Donor Communications**

jobs.title: Marketing Analyst - Network Optimization
jobs.desc:
### **About Gen:**

Gen is a global company dedicated to powering Digital Freedom through its trusted consumer brands including Norton, Avast, LifeLock, MoneyLion and more. Our combined heritage is rooted in financial empowerment and cyber safety for the first digital generations, and today we deliver award-winning cybersecurity, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness solutions to nearly 500 million users in more than 150 countries.

Together, we share a collective passion and vision to protect consumers and help them grow, manage and secure their digital and financial lives. We’re always looking for smart, fearless and high-impact talent who see AI as a teammate – leveraging it to move faster and deliver meaningful results.

When you’re part of Gen, you’ll have the flexibility, tools and support to do your best work and grow your career – from flexible working options and time off to competitive pay, benefits and well-being programs.

At Gen, we are scrappy and relentlessly customer driven. We create room for healthy debate, experimentation and continuous learning, and we seek out people with different experiences, identities and ideas to join our team. You’ll work with people who back each other, respect each other and understand that our differences are a competitive advantage.

If this sounds like you, we’d love you to be part of Gen.

### **Role Overview**

The Marketing Analyst – Network Optimization will use data and experimentation to uncover what drives marketplace performance, turning analysis into clear, actionable recommendations that shape the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of tests. This role sits at the intersection of marketing analytics, data science, product, and commercial strategy.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, moving quickly from questions to analysis to action. At the core of the role: translating business questions into testable hypotheses, designing sound experiments, monitoring live tests, and delivering clear, data-driven readouts that inform optimization decisions — supported by day-to-day management of the test agenda.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketplace and Marketing Analytics**

* Conduct exploratory analysis to understand changes in customer behavior, traffic quality, offer engagement, and downstream outcomes.
* Monitor marketplace and funnel performance to identify optimization opportunities across customer experience, offer display, partner performance, and monetization.
* Support opportunity sizing and business-case development for proposed optimization initiatives.
* Partner with analytics and data science teams to improve measurement quality, data reliability, and experimentation velocity.
* Help develop repeatable processes for rapid testing, post-test analysis, and continuous optimization.

**Test Design and Execution**

* Support the development and maintenance of a prioritized test-and-learn agenda across network optimization, offer display, ranking, curation, pricing, eligibility, and related marketplace levers.
* Translate business opportunities and performance signals into clear hypotheses, test objectives, target populations, success metrics, and guardrail metrics.
* Help design A/B, holdout, multivariate, and other controlled experiments in partnership with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and business stakeholders.
* Coordinate test setup, launch readiness, audience splits, documentation, timelines, and stakeholder communication.
* Track execution from initial idea through implementation, launch, monitoring, analysis, and final recommendation.
* Work quickly and pragmatically while maintaining analytical rigor and attention to detail.

**Test Readouts and Reporting**

* Monitor live experiments and summarize performance across key funnel and marketplace metrics.
* Produce concise, decision-oriented test readouts covering methodology, results, limitations, learnings, and recommended next steps.

Client Services Manager, Performance Media

Director, Performance Media

Senior Analyst and Analyst

Alpha Inc. isn’t looking for someone to simply **manage the marketing calendar.**

This is a hands-on leadership role for a marketer who understands that great marketing is bigger than social posts, sponsorships, events, and communications. It’s about connecting **strategy + relationships + data + dollars + execution** to meaningful business results.

  

You’ll own Alpha’s overall marketing strategy and brand direction, lead the Marketing team, build stronger systems and measurement practices, and help determine where Alpha should show up, where we should invest, and where we should change course.

  

One day you may be reviewing KPIs and marketing spend with leadership. **If your idea of marketing leadership is equal parts strategist, relationship builder, operator, coach, and brand champion—we should talk.**

Founded and grown in Hawai?i, Alpha Inc. is a locally owned leader whose work spans construction, concrete, drilling, energy, infrastructure and vertical. Our story is told through the projects we build, the people behind them, the communities we serve, and the relationships we earn.

  

Marketing's job is to make that story matter—and make sure our investment in telling it has purpose.

  

We live by three core values:

  

**Leading with Heart** – Build relationships with humility and respect. Listen with intention, accept feedback with positive intent, and help people grow.

**Strength in Unity** – One team, many talents. Collaborate across departments, islands, projects, and communities because the best work happens together.

* **What worked? What didn't? Why? What did we learn? And where should we put the next dollar?**
* Use data, audience insights, feedback, and business priorities to continually improve Alpha’s marketing effectiveness.

  

**Build Relationships Across Hawai?i**

* Be a visible, credible, relationship-driven ambassador for Alpha across **Maui, O'ahu, Kaua'i, and Hawai'i Island.**
* Develop meaningful relationships with community organizations, clients, industry partners, vendors, and other stakeholders.

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist
jobs.desc:
Go Maverick Group has an agency client who has an immediate need for a Paid Media Specialist. They are looking for someone who enjoys getting into the details of digital campaigns, analyzing performance data, identifying opportunities for improvement, and continuously optimizing results. This role focuses heavily on paid social and paid search, helping some of our largest clients maximize the impact of their marketing investments.

You'll primarily support a focused portfolio of four established clients across consumer products, higher education, healthcare, and industrial manufacturing. While clients’ annual media budgets span a wide range, there are several multi-million-dollar plans that give you the opportunity to work on sophisticated campaigns with real impact.

This role is designed for someone who wants to stay close to campaign execution, optimization, and analytics. Client interaction may be part of the role, but formal presenting is not expected at the outset. As you grow, there may also be opportunities to gain planning experience on smaller accounts.

**If you love the combination of analytics, optimization, and hands-on digital advertising execution, we'd love to meet you.**

What You'll Do

* Manage, monitor, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn, and Google Ads.
* Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve results, efficiency, and return on ad spend.
* Use in-platform reporting and analytics tools to uncover insights and make data-driven recommendations.
* Monitor budgets, pacing, audience performance, bidding strategies, and overall campaign effectiveness.
* Build, maintain, and validate campaign tracking and measurement using GA4 and other reporting tools.
* Pull and analyze performance data, develop recurring reports, and communicate key findings to internal teams.
* Collaborate with account service, creative, and media team members to support client goals and campaign success.
* Traffic digital assets and ensure campaigns are launched accurately and on time.
* Stay current on platform updates, industry trends, and paid media best practices.

  
**Requirements**

What You'll Bring

* 3+ years of hands-on paid media experience.
* Strong working knowledge of Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, and GA4.
* Demonstrated experience with day-to-day campaign execution, optimization, and performance analysis.
* Experience managing and optimizing campaigns with meaningful budgets and defined performance goals.
* The ability to analyze data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.
* The ability to independently manage daily campaign operations while balancing multiple priorities.
* Curiosity, initiative, and a drive to continuously improve campaign results.

Bonus Points

* Agency experience.
* Google Campaign Manager experience.

This is not a traditional desk-based marketing role. You will work directly with Hago’s founding team and spend your time figuring out where Hago belongs, who should know about us, and what actually gets people to try it.

The right person is entrepreneurial, persuasive, organized, comfortable with ambiguity, and willing to do the hands-on work required to build something from the ground up. You should enjoy meeting people, opening doors, testing ideas, and being measured by real outcomes.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Role details**

The Marketing Manager partners closely with Division leadership, Sales, Operations, Land Acquisition, Finance, and Corporate Sales & Marketing teams to support community launches, drive qualified traffic, and contribute to the Division's growth and profitability.
  
  
This role is located in the San Antonio, TX division.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For:**  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Public Relations, or a related field preferred.
* 5-10 years of progressive marketing experience within the homebuilding, residential real estate, or related industry
* Proven track record of developing and executing successful marketing campaigns that drive traffic, lead generation, brand awareness, and business growth.
* Strong experience in digital marketing, advertising, social media management, content development, email marketing, and campaign analytics.
* Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred), marketing automation platforms, website management tools, and digital analytics.

Joining Empire isn’t just about finding a job; it’s about establishing a meaningful connection with the work you do. * Opportunity to collaborate with other skilled and visionary professionals.
* Receive exclusive discounts on Empire Homes through our Employee Home Ownership Program.
* Enjoy peace of mind with our employer paid benefits.
* Invest in your future with employer sponsored 401k plans.
* Keep growing your career with continuing education support and opportunities for learning & development.
* Join a company that believes your time outside of work is just as important as your time inside work.

What You’ll Be Doing Each Day
  

* Develop and execute divisional marketing strategies and campaigns to drive qualified traffic, support community sales goals, and enhance brand awareness.
* Manage all divisional advertising, digital marketing, social media, email marketing, public relations, signage, and promotional efforts.

* Manage relationships with advertising agencies, media partners, digital vendors, and other marketing service providers to ensure quality, performance, and budget compliance.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**Who We Are**  
Our story began in 2011 when a group of office workers at a major logistics company in Chicago had a lunch problem. Nearby options were limited and the team was spending too much time and money traveling to their favorite restaurants. They had an idea: bring Chicago’s local restaurant culture inside the office to sell food. It was an immediate hit. When they discovered people from other companies sneaking into their office, they knew they were on to something.

Fooda pioneered the concept of rotating popup restaurants inside offices. Today, we operate in 60 cities with over 100 million meals served and continue to grow rapidly.

Powered by technology and a network of 1500+ restaurants, we feed hungry people at work through a platform of unique food programs located within companies, office buildings, hospitals, schools, distribution centers, and more. At Fooda, we believe a workplace food program should be something employees love and look forward to every day.

**Position Overview**  
Fooda is hiring a Content Marketing Manager to lead our content program and, over time, the team that produces it.

Fooda runs workplace food programs for employers and buildings, from rotating restaurant popups and delivery to catering and fully managed dining. Our buyers include HR and people leaders, workplace experience and facilities teams, corporate real estate, office managers, procurement, and building owners.

You’ll report directly to the VP of Marketing and work closely together on content strategy. Your first few months are about building a deep understanding of Fooda: our products, customers, and market, and the people across Sales and the business who know them best. During this time you’ll write, shape strategy, and work alongside our internal writers and freelance contributors.

At around 30-60 days, you’ll take on direct management of the content team: three internal writers and a group of freelance writers. From there, you’ll own the editorial calendar and lead the team in producing content that generates demand, equips Sales, and builds Fooda’s authority in the market.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

Learn the business:

* Build a working knowledge of Fooda’s products, customers, prospects, and competitors.
* Spend regular time with Sales, account management, operations, and leadership to understand what our buyers care about and why they choose us.
* Learn what each of our audiences is trying to solve, from HR leaders to building owners, and what information helps them make a decision.
* Follow trends in the workplace, employee experience, and corporate food, and identify where Fooda has something worth saying.
* Find strong content ideas in sales calls, customer conversations, and internal discussions rather than waiting for them to be handed to you.

Shape and lead the content program:

* Work directly with the VP of Marketing on content strategy, and turn that strategy into a clear plan.
* Own Fooda’s editorial calendar.
* Lead demand generation and sales enablement content first: guides, research, webinars, customer stories, product content, and the materials Sales uses with prospects and customers.
* Develop thought leadership that builds Fooda’s authority with our buyers.
* Guide SEO and blog content as a focused part of the program, grounded in search intent and how buyers find answers, including AI search.
* Write important pieces yourself, especially in your first six months.
* Partner with our art director and design team to bring content to life.
* Turn ideas into clear concepts, briefs, and assignments.
* Hold a high standard for everything we publish, from the strength of the idea to the final edit.

Develop the team:

* Coach writers on writing, research, product knowledge, and editorial judgment.
* Give clear feedback that helps writers improve rather than rewriting their work.
* Manage freelance writers, including briefs, quality, and deadlines.
* Help the team become more independent and better ab
