jobs.desc:
Join a manufacturing leader with over 50 years of excellence, where every role contributes to building reliable transportation solutions that people depend on everyday across the United States and Canada. At ENC, we prioritize safety, quality, innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth – creating vehicles our teams can take pride in.
  
  
Founded in 1975, ENC (ElDorado National – California) is a leading U.S. transportation manufacturer specializing in design, engineering, and end-to-end production of heavy-duty buses, shuttles, and cargo vehicles through a custom-build, mixed-model assembly process. Each vehicle is produced in our purpose-built facility in Riverside, California supporting public agencies and private transportation providers nationwide. We offer one of the industry’s widest portfolios of power options, including 100% battery-electric, diesel-electric hybrid, CNG, and clean diesel.
  
  
ENC is committed to revitalizing American manufacturing through innovation, customer focus, and the delivery of high-quality vehicles that keep communities connected, supported, and moving forward.
  
  
**Marketing Manager**  
**Location:** **Riverside, CA**  
**Salary Range: $94,000 - 120,000**  
  
**Position Summary**

A NEW MEDIUM DUTY BRAND BY ENC, ZAVIR, backed by more than 50 years of El Dorado National – California heavy-duty experience, is bringing a ground-up, American-made Class 3 electric and hybrid vehicle platform to market. The Marketing Manager, is the first Marketing Manager on a team built around an AI-powered Marketing Portal, a Salesforce-driven demand-generation engine, and a completed brand system. The permanent focus of this role is demand generation: Marketing E-Blast campaigns, cold and warm outbound, lead generation, and sales enablement that keep the field sales team supplied with qualified, warm leads.  
In addition to Growth & Revenue, this role will carry the Brand, Communications & Launch responsibilities. This role is expected to document processes along the way and actively support that handoff. This position reports to the VP of Sales & Marketing and works closely with the Creative & Brand Director, who owns visual identity, creative direction, and final approval on all creative.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

**Growth & Revenue:**

* Own the CRM-driven demand-generation strategy, running a large portfolio of segmented nurture tracks (lifecycle journeys, state and federal incentive programs, and industry verticals) across public- and private-sector fleet markets.
* Build, deploy, and optimize campaigns in Marketing Software, including journeys, segmentation, dynamic content, A/B testing, and send-plan QA, with clean campaign attribution in Salesforce Sales Cloud.
* Stand up and manage cold outbound using Smartlead, Instantly, or a comparable platform: domain and inbox setup, warm-up, deliverability monitoring, sequence building, reply handling, and compliance with CAN-SPAM and company consent and opt-in policies.
* Operate and help improve the company’s AI-powered Marketing Portal and its agents (incentives, bid intelligence, campaigns, research, and outbound): use them in daily work, review their output for accuracy and brand fit, refine prompts and workflows, and partner with the Creative & Brand Director on enhancements.
* Partner with Inside Sales to build and qualify targeted prospect lists by region, vertical, and title; score leads; and ensure timely handoff of warm leads to the appropriate regional sales representative.
* Own the funnel from first touch through sales handoff, tracking conversion at each stage (open, click, reply, inquiry, demo, configurator engagement, opportunity) and recommending improvements.
* Manage paid and digital channel strategy (search, retargeting, LinkedIn, and trade media) within the approved advertising budget, optimizing cost per lead and return on ad spend.
* Serve as sales enablement liaison: triage campaign requests submitted through the Market

jobs.desc:
**About Doss**
==============

**DOSS is building an Operations Cloud for the real world.**
------------------------------------------------------------

A modern, AI-native platform for physical product businesses to manage the flow of goods, dollars, and data in real time, across:

* Procurement
* Inventory
* Orders
* Fulfillment
* Finance

**Built to replace spreadsheet chaos and rigid, consultant-heavy ERPs.** Fast time-to-value, adaptable as the business evolves.

Through our Adaptive Resource Platform (ARP) and unified operational data model, teams deploy quickly, automate workflows, and make changes without months of re-implementation.

**We recently raised a $55M Series B**, co-led by Madrona and Premji Invest. Participation from Intuit Ventures, Theory Ventures, General Catalyst, Contrary Capital, and Pathlight VC.

DOSS is trusted by fast-growing operators to run critical operations with speed, control, and confidence.

**About This Role**
-------------------

The Growth Manager will own paid acquisition end-to-end at Doss—from strategy to hands-on-keyboard execution. This is a hands-on role across our paid channels, primarily **Google, LinkedIn, and Meta**, that range from 0 1 builds to scaling programs that are already live. You'll be responsible for standing up new channels, scaling proven ones, and designing the experiments that unlock new pipeline volume for our GTM team.

You'll work directly with the **Director of Growth** and own this area end-to-end, collaborating closely with product marketing, sales, and design to turn paid spend into qualified pipeline. This is a rare opportunity to join early and scale a function that’ll drive significant revenue for DOSS.

You'll also be part of a broader testing engine at Doss—one built to move from market insight to live test to result as fast as possible. Your job is to keep that loop tight: design the test, ship it, read the result, and feed the learning back into the next round.

Above all else, this role is about creating leverage—through disciplined experimentation, scalable campaigns, and rigorous measurement that leads to better decisions about where every dollar goes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **#1: Achieve the pipeline goals.** Execute your plan to drive our incredible growth through new opportunities from digital channels.
* **Own paid advertising end-to-end.** Set strategy and execute it yourself across Google, LinkedIn, and Meta—campaign structure, audience targeting, bidding, budget pacing, creative briefs, ad copy, and landing pages.
* **Build 0 1 and scale what works.** Launch new paid channels from scratch and scale live channels efficiently, protecting CAC and efficiency as spend grows.
* **Run rigorous experiments.** Design and run rigorous A/B tests with a clear scientific method—form hypotheses, isolate variables, reach statistical significance, and turn results into repeatable plays. Test constantly across offers, messaging, creative, audiences, and formats.
* **Measure leading and lagging indicators.** Define the metrics that matter at each funnel stage, instrument tracking to measure them accurately, and use leading indicators to act before lagging outcomes confirm them.
* **Collaborate cross-functionally.** Partner with product marketing on positioning and messaging, with sales on lead quality and pipeline feedback loops, and with design on high-performing creative.
* **Report on performance.** Maintain clear dashboards and a tight feedback loop with the Director of Growth & VP of Marketing on spend, efficiency, and pipeline contribution.

**About You**
-------------

* **5+ years running paid ads across multiple channels.** You have a deep, current understanding of Google, LinkedIn, and Meta ad platforms and have managed real budgets across them.
* **Managed budgets in the $1M+ range.** You've owned and deployed seven-figure annual ad spend, and you know how to scale spend without losing efficiency.
* **Hands-on ope

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Today, we're looking for a **Paid Media Manager** to join our growing team. Our new Paid Media Manager will serve as a subject matter expert in all things related to Paid Media. You will play both the lead role & support on a portfolio of Paid Media client strategies, build & maintain great client relationships, manage timelines and deliverables, and directly grow clients’ marketing performance through your work.

  

The Paid Media Manager will independently lead account strategy for a select few of their own clients, while also working closely with Senior Paid Media Managers and Associate Directors to support on account strategy & tactical execution for larger clients as needed. This role is ideal for a Paid Media pro with 3+ years of experience who is driven and hungry to bring their media strategy & client ownership chops to the next level. You’ll work on a team of top-notch digital marketing SMEs, and will collaborate with counterparts on SEO, Measurement, and Creative teams to successfully execute client delivery.

  

Here’s what we expect from our Paid Media Manager.

### **—What You'll Do—**

* **Client Ownership:** Responsible for the strategy development, innovation, and tactical execution + performance of small-but-impactful portfolio Paid Media client accounts. (3-5 clients)

* **Testing & Innovation:** Support channel innovation efforts, ensuring clients' Paid Media strategies are following evolving best practices and using performance data to identify opportunities for new campaigns, optimizations, and testing
* **Reporting:** Regularly create, analyze, and present insightful and actionable Paid Media performance reports directly to clients
* **Project Management:** Accurately communicate project timelines to clients; manage client expectations and proactively update clients as things change
* **Creative Strategy:** Collaborate with Silverback's Creative Director and Design team on ad creation and testing plans; assist with creative strategy and briefs as needed
* **Know Your Client's Business:** Understand your clients’ industries, audience, and goals while staying on top of industry changes, trends, and best practices
* **Teamwork & Collaboration:** Join in creative brainstorming sessions with other members of the Paid Media team to promote a culture of collaboration and innovation
* **Professional Growth:** Accept feedback and coaching from the Associate Director of Media to ensure our clients are receiving a best-in-class experience & top-notch performance.

### **—What We’re Looking For—**

* **Years of Experience:** *A* *minimum* *of 3+ years of paid media agency experience - ideal candidate has 3-5 YOE.* Previous performance agency experience is a MUST-HAVE!
* **Paid Search** ***and*** **Social Expertise:** Must-have experience managing both Paid Search *and* Social campaigns. (Main platforms are Google & Meta; secondary platforms are LinkedIn and TikTok)

jobs.title: Retention & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**About Onnit:**

Onnit is an Austin, Texas based health and wellness company that sells dietary supplements direct to consumers and through retail distribution. As a trusted and serious supplement brand, we provide high-quality products with clinically studied ingredients designed to unlock a deeper mind-body connection and enhance both mental and physical performance. Unlike other supplement brands, Onnit enables strength from within, empowering individuals to operate at their peak every day. Backed by medical professionals, industry experts, and a loyal community, we are staying true to our mission of total human optimization.

We are part of the Wellbeing Collective, an exciting Global Business Unit within Unilever built with a start-up mindset. Our mission, with our science-backed and disruptive portfolio, is to improve the health and well-being of millions of consumers and continue leading in the Health and Wellness space.

If you are interested in joining a culture that strives for Curiosity, Discipline, Approachability, Commitment, and Ownership Mindset then we invite you to join our mission to optimize human potential!

**JOB SUMMARY**

We're looking for an analytical, hands-on lifecycle marketer to own email, SMS, and customer retention, with a particular focus on subscription growth and churn reduction. You'll execute the strategy and work in Klaviyo, from creating content blocks and building campaigns to launching flows, refining segments, and analyzing results. Use customer behavior, cohort performance, and lifetime value insights to decide what to send, to whom, and when.

This role combines strategic ownership with end-to-end execution. You're someone who enjoys being "in the weeds", turning ideas into live campaigns, managing day-to-day production, and using results to shape your next move. This is an opportunity to own the full lifecycle marketing process and see the impact of your work on customer relationships and business growth.

This role is designed for someone with roughly 5 years of relevant experience who wants meaningful ownership while staying close to the work.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Email and SMS strategy and execution

* Own the email and SMS calendar, balancing promotional campaigns with customer education, replenishment, subscription conversion, and retention messaging.
* Personally build, QA, schedule, and launch campaigns and automated flows in Klaviyo.
* Create, maintain, and manage reusable content blocks and templates; assemble and format messages for launch.
* Build and refine customer segments using purchase behavior, subscription status, engagement, lifecycle stage, and cohort insights.
* Develop and optimize journeys such as welcome, post-purchase, replenishment, subscription onboarding, cancellation prevention, and winback.
* Run practical tests across messaging, offers, creative, timing, frequency, and audience selection, then apply what you learn.
* Maintain strong execution standards across mobile rendering, links, personalization, deliverability, and consent practices.

Subscription Growth and Churn Reduction

* Execute lifecycle marketing initiatives that convert one-time purchasers into subscribers and help existing subscribers stay engaged.
* Identify which customers are most likely to benefit from subscription and develop relevant messages, offers, and conversion journeys.
* Analyze subscription churn, cancellation patterns, and customer behavior to identify opportunities to improve retention.
* Build and test onboarding, education, replenishment, save, and reactivation initiatives that address those opportunities.
* Bring customer insights to product, brand, and customer-experience partners to help strengthen the overall subscriber experience.

Lifecycle Strategy and Practical Analytics

* Develop lifecycle and cohort strategies that reflect how different customers discover, buy, return, subscribe, and lapse.
* Analyze cohort retention, repeat purchase, customer lifetime

The Digital Media Specialist supports the mission and strategic goals of the Virginia Education Association (VEA) by developing, implementing, and evaluating digital communications strategies that increase member engagement, strengthen the Association’s public presence, and advance organizing and advocacy initiatives at the local and state levels.

Reporting to the Director, Office of Communications and Public Affairs, the Digital Media Specialist develops and manages digital content, websites, social media platforms, targeted digital messaging, and multimedia products. The position works collaboratively with staff, member-leaders, local affiliates, and other stakeholders to create accessible, engaging, and impactful digital communications that connect members and the public with VEA’s priorities, programs, and campaigns.

The Digital Media Specialist also serves as a resource and trainer for staff and members, promoting the effective use of digital tools to support organizing, recruitment, retention, advocacy, and member mobilization. The position requires strong technical, creative, analytical, and communication skills, along with the ability to adapt to evolving digital platforms and emerging technologies.

This position is based at VEA Headquarters in Richmond, Virginia (23229) and is represented by the Virginia Professional Staff Association (VPSA), VEA’s internal staff union.

**Digital Strategy and Member Engagement**

* Develop and implement digital media strategies that increase measurable engagement among VEA members, prospective members, local affiliates, and the Virginia public.
* Align digital communications initiatives with VEA’s mission, strategic goals, communications priorities, and organizing objectives.
* Develop digital engagement strategies that reflect diverse member experiences and advance VEA’s racial and social justice priorities.

* Identify opportunities to use digital platforms and emerging technologies to strengthen member participation, promote Association initiatives, and expand VEA’s reach.
* Monitor digital engagement metrics and use data-driven insights to evaluate effectiveness and recommend improvements.

**Digital Organizing and Campaign Support**

* Design, deploy, and evaluate digital tools that support local and statewide organizing, advocacy, recruitment, retention, and mobilization campaigns.
* Develop and manage campaign websites, landing pages, petitions, event registration tools, targeted messaging, and other digital engagement resources.
* Support the use of platforms such as Action Network and other campaign management tools to facilitate member participation and advocacy.
* Develop and distribute targeted email and text messaging campaigns through Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) or successor platforms and services.

We're looking for someone who can take ownership of our marketing, identify opportunities, and personally execute the work—not just provide recommendations.

**Location:** Boise, Idaho

**Department:** Marketing

**Reports To:** Brand Manager

**Brands:** ECCO & Code 3

**About ECCO and Code 3**

**﻿**

ECCO and Code 3 are two well-known brands in safety and warning solutions. ECCO designs and manufactures vehicle safety products for commercial, construction, utility, and work-truck markets. Its lineup includes LED warning lights, back-up alarms, and other products that keep workers and the people around them safe. Code 3 is a trusted name in public safety, building emergency lighting, sirens, and controls for law enforcement, fire, and EMS. First responders count on these products when it matters most. Our products protect people on the road and on the job site. If you want your marketing work to support that mission, we’d like to hear from you.

**﻿The Role**

**﻿**

We’re looking for a hands-on Digital Marketing Specialist to own and grow our digital presence across both brands. You’ll shape strategy and also execute it: building emails, managing the website, optimizing content for search, supporting Amazon, and creating the graphics that bring our products to life. You’ll work closely with product, sales, and leadership teams to drive engagement, revenue, and brand awareness.

**﻿What You’ll Do**

**﻿**

* **Digital Strategy:** Build and execute integrated digital marketing plans aligned with business goals and product roadmaps.
* **CRM Strategy:** Manage our CRM, build segmentation and automation workflows, and improve customer engagement and retention.
* **Email Campaigns:** Design, build, and send email campaigns, from concept and copy through graphics, QA, and reporting.

* **Amazon:** Support and optimize our Amazon presence, including listings, content, and performance.
* **Graphic Design:** Create on-brand marketing assets for web, email, social, Amazon, and product launches.
* **Analytics and ROI:** Track, analyze, and report on campaign and channel performance, and turn the data into clear recommendations.
* **Product Launch Support:** Partner with cross-functional teams to plan and execute launch campaigns and materials.
* **Video Editing (as needed):** Assist with basic video editing to support campaigns and product content.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, digital media, graphic design, or a related field
* Minimum of two (2) years of experience in digital marketing or a similar role
* Strong graphic design skills (portfolio required)
* Hands-on CRM experience, including segmentation, automation, and reporting
* Experience building and deploying email campaigns
* Back-end website management experience (CMS, e-commerce platform, or similar)
* Working knowledge of SEO best practices
* Proven ability to develop and execute digital strategy
* Comfort with analytics tools and using data to guide decisions

**Strong Plus**

* Amazon management experience (Seller/Vendor Central, listing optimization, A+ content)
* 3D product rendering experience
* Content writing skills
* Video editing experience
* Experience in manufacturing, automotive, or B2B/B2C hybrid markets

jobs.title: Marketing Manager - REMOTE
jobs.desc:
**Marketing Manager**

**Remote**

Creative, strategic, and results-oriented? Consider this your opportunity to grow. Dayton T. Brown, Inc. (DTB) is seeking a remote **Marketing Manager** to support the company's continued growth initiatives and elevate its presence across the aerospace, defense, government, transportation, and commercial markets.

We're seeking a Marketing Manager to execute the day-to-day execution of DTB's external voice and internal alignment as we scale our growth and operations into a market-defining company. You'll work with our leadership team on technical, fast-moving projects. You'll translate customer requirements, programming milestones, and mission profiles into clear and innovative messaging for the outside world and across our own team.

You'll start with our existing point of view, expand on our technical content, and assimilate senior leadership vision. Successful candidates will apply autonomy, creativity, and scale to generate ideas packaged into compelling forward-facing content. Marketing messaging will engage, create thought provoking comments, and incite positive emotions in the marketplace with consistent execution. Refine the process and organize our messaging. You'll develop and manage content drafts, internal updates, press coordination, tradeshows, and event logistics. You have the vision and you make it happen. Grow the Future and help guide us into our next era of innovation.

The Marketing Manager will develop and execute integrated marketing initiatives that increase brand awareness, strengthen client and industry engagement, support business development, and communicate DTB's capabilities and expertise. A significant focus of this role will be **social media strategy, website content development, lead (SEO) optimization, video and image content development, digital marketing, tradeshow planning and execution, and brand enforcement communications**.

This position will play an important role in communicating DTB's position as a trusted partner in testing, engineering, technical publications, logistics, SCIFs mission systems, and in supporting the company's consistent brand message.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* Annual
  + Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies aligned with DTB's business objectives.
  + Identify market trends, growth opportunities, and emerging marketing opportunities through input from DTB management, industry activity, and personal observations.
  + Create annual marketing plans based on trends.
  + Provide input to marketing leadership regarding budgets and marketing spending.
* Monthly
  + Revisit annual plans and update based on emerging market trends.
  + Identify, develop, and create mini campaigns and supporting content to address long-term and immediate business requirements.
  + Collaborate with leadership, sales, business development, and technical experts to develop marketing initiatives that support annual business goals and market penetration.
* Manage ALL marketing activities in an agile environment with clear deadlines, keeping marketing tasks on time and within scope internally and externally.
* Communicate solutions when problems arise while mitigating risk.

**Leads, Marketing Analytics & Website Management/Updates**

* Drawing from executive and division objectives while working cross-functionally:
  + Update website using WordPress
  + Create paths for lead generation through DTB website
  + Develop lead generation opportunities.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
**Who We Are & Who We Serve**

Visit Corvallis is the destination marketing organization serving Corvallis and Benton County, Oregon. Our mission is to enhance Corvallis and Benton County’s prosperity by elevating its visitor economy. We do this by connecting people to experiences that show what’s great about Corvallis. When we do that well, visitors discover experiences that delight, restore, and surprise them; local businesses benefit; and tourism strengthens our community.

We’re a small and nimble team, where people and ideas matter. We all wear many different hats, and good work has a visible impact. This role offers meaningful ownership and direction in our marketing programming today, with room to grow into senior marketing strategic leadership.

**What We’re Trying To Do**

At its best, destination marketing is matchmaking. Not everyone is going to love Corvallis, and that’s okay. Our job is to find the people who will.

When we do that well, visitors discover experiences that delight, restore, and surprise them; local businesses benefit; and tourism strengthens our community.

Our goal is to make Visit Corvallis one of Oregon’s most engaging, distinctive, and inviting destination brands, and the Marketing Manager’s goal is to build a smarter marketing operation underneath it.

**What You’ll Lead**

This position will oversee Visit Corvallis’ marketing ecosystem, working with our team and contracted agencies to lead:

* Brand strategy and creative development
* Paid media and digital advertising
* Website strategy, AI, SEO/SEM, and conversion
* Google Analytics, campaign measurement, and KPI reporting
* Public relations and earned media
* Social media and content strategy
* Email marketing and consumer e-newsletters
* Photography, video, and creative asset development
* Influencer and visiting media programs
* Visitor guide and other visitor-facing content

You won’t need to personally execute every piece, but you will need to understand how the pieces work together, ask good questions, manage our partners, and turn strategy into action.

You’ll also help develop our annual marketing plan, manage the content calendar, identify creative needs, monitor performance, and build a stronger culture of experimentation and A/B testing.

Most importantly, we want data to change what we do. We aren’t interested in producing reports simply to produce them. We want someone who looks at the results and asks, **“What should we try next?”**

**You’ll Probably Love This Job If:**

* You’re curious and naturally ask why and how.
* You’re both creative and strategic. You can find an interesting insight in the data and then ask, **“What’s the story here?”**
* You have strong creative instincts, excellent visual taste, aren’t afraid to take risks, and have solid communications skills.
* You like testing your own ideas. Being proven wrong doesn’t bother you nearly as much as never finding out whether you were right.
* You’re organized and understand that structure creates freedom, but you don’t need every answer before moving forward.
* You’re willing to be bold, take thoughtful risks and challenge the expected.
* When something isn’t working, you look for the next solution rather than explaining why nothing can be done.

**What You Need To Bring**

* We’re less interested in someone who checks every traditional box than in the right combination of experience, judgment and potential.
* Experience marketing a consumer product, brand, commodity, place, food or beverage product, outdoor brand, or other competitive consumer offering would be especially interesting to us.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

Visit Corvallis is looking for a strategic, creative marketing leader who gets excited about building things, asking why, testing ideas and finding better ways to connect people with a place they’ll genuinely enjoy.

**About JM Test Systems**

JM Test Systems is a multi-division test, measurement, calibration, repair, and electrical safety company serving industrial, utility, and energy customers across the U.S. and Canada. Through equipment sales, rentals, calibration, onsite testing, and electrical safety lab services, we support the contractors, utilities, EPC firms, and OEMs that keep critical infrastructure running.

**The Opportunity**

Our customers rely on us for the equipment and services that keep their operations safe and running. We’re looking for a Marketing Growth Specialist to help more of them find us, and to give them reasons to keep coming back.

You’ll own the work that turns online interest into revenue: paid search, SEO, marketing analytics, and website and eCommerce conversion. You’ll dig into the data, find where the customer journey breaks down, test fixes, and scale what works. You’ll work from our Baton Rouge headquarters with the Marketing Manager, sales teams, and branch leaders. Together you’ll set performance goals and build the reporting leadership uses to make decisions.

This role suits someone who enjoys both the numbers and the creative side of marketing, and who’s curious enough to learn technical products and the industries that depend on them. In your first year, success means:

* Steadily improving lead-to-opportunity conversion
* Building repeatable playbooks for core campaigns, such as calibration renewals and rental promotions
* Delivering reporting that marketing and sales leaders trust and use

**Key Responsibilities & Outcomes**

* **Drive qualified demand.** Manage Google Ads and paid social budgets. Test targeting, bidding, and creative to improve lead quality, conversion rates, and return on spend.

* **Nurture and retain customers.** Optimize HubSpot (or comparable) automation, including nurture sequences, lead scoring, and segmentation, to drive repeat business and renewals.
* **Show marketing’s revenue impact.** Strengthen attribution so we know which channels drive pipeline and where to invest next.
* **Run a disciplined experimentation program.** Prioritize growth tests, define success measures, and turn what works into documented campaign playbooks.
* **Align with sales and branches.** Work with sales teams across our branch network and with content and design partners to launch campaigns and assets (landing pages, emails, ad copy, sales enablement) that match regional and industry priorities. Use competitor and market insight to shape them.

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* A bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 3+ years in digital or growth marketing with proven results in paid acquisition, analytics, or conversion optimization, including hands-on Google Ads and budget management
* Working knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console, SEO fundamentals, and A/B testing, plus strong Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting and dashboards
* Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Marketo, or a similar CRM or marketing automation platform
* Strong analytical and writing skills: you can turn data into clear recommendations and write copy that converts, while managing several campaigns and stakeholders at once

**Preferred**

* Experience in B2B, industrial, or technical services marketing, especially test and measurement, electrical products, or the Oil & Gas,

jobs.title: Email Marketing Specialist
jobs.desc:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers connect and simplify their operations, keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.

Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to empower product sellers to thrive by making selling as easy as buying. We are committed to this mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world.

Serving over 8,000 customers globally, processing more than 125 million orders per year, and supporting over $35B of Gross Merchandise Value, Cin7 has been rated best overall in inventory management software in 2024 by Forbes Advisor.

### **How you'll make an impact:**

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to own email creation in HubSpot. Reporting to the Marketing Operations Manager, you'll build, test, and schedule the emails that reach our prospects, customers, and partners, including newsletters, event invitations, product announcements, and nurture campaigns.

  

This role is hands-on. You'll take campaign briefs and copy from across the marketing team and turn them into polished, accurate, on-brand emails. You'll build the lists and segments behind each send, use test results and performance data to improve future emails, and keep the email calendar and approval process running smoothly. You'll also create simple graphics in Canva when our graphic designer is busy with larger projects.

  

You'll work with a small, collaborative team and with people in several time zones. Your work will be seen by our prospects, customers, and partners every week.

You will build emails across a variety of campaign types:

* **Workflow-based drip campaigns** (6+ weeks)
* **Automated nurtures** (demo, free trial, lifecycle stages)
* **One-off campaigns** (trade shows, announcements, etc.)
* **Webinar promotion series** (invites, reminders, follow-ups)
* **Monthly newsletter** (gather content from stakeholders, build, iterate, and send)

### **What you'll do:**

* **Own email creation in HubSpot**, building marketing emails from start to finish using templates, modules, and personalization tokens.
* **Build and segment lists**, creating targeted lists in HubSpot so each email reaches the right audience.
* **Run A/B tests**, testing subject lines, content, send times, and calls to action, and applying what you learn to future emails.
* **Analyze email metrics to guide decisions**, tracking open rates, click rates, and unsubscribes, and using the results to recommend changes to content, timing, and audiences.
* **Maintain the email calendar**, planning and scheduling sends across teams so campaigns are coordinated and audiences aren't over-emailed.
* **Manage the approval process for email sending**, getting emails to reviewers on time, tracking feedback and sign-off, and making sure nothing is sent before it's approved.
* **Maintain oversight of marketing team inbox**, organizing, deleting and responding to email responses as necessary.
* **Test every email before it goes out**, checking links, merge fields, recipient lists, and how each email looks on desktop and mobile.
* **Turn campaign briefs into finished emails**, working with marketing team members to get copy, images, and calls to action ready for review.
* **Create basic graphics in Canva**, including email banners, buttons, and simple images, using Cin7 brand guidelines and approved templates. Hand larger design projects to our graphic designer.
* **Keep email assets organized**, including templates, saved content, and image files, so the team can find and reuse them.
* **Follow email best practices and privacy rules**, including unsubscribe handling and consent requirements for the regions we send to.

### **What you'll bring:**

**What you'll bring:**

* 2-3 years of experience in email marketing, marketing operations, or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience

jobs.desc:
**About Clove Wellness**

Clove is a holistic healthcare membership platform launching in Dallas-Fort Worth on January 1, 2027. Members get one simple membership that opens the door to a vetted network of naturopathic doctors, chiropractors, acupuncturists, massage therapists, dietitians, somatic therapists, and recovery services. Healthcare is fragmented, hard to navigate, and unpredictable in cost. Clove makes it coordinated, accessible, and transparent.

We’re a founder-led team, and you’d work directly with our founder, a Registered Dietitian. You won’t get lost in a department. You’ll build the marketing function from the ground up.

**The role**

We’re looking for a curious, scrappy, creative person to be our first Head of Marketing. This is an entry-level role with a big title and real ownership. You’ll touch every part of our marketing as we move from pre-launch into our first year, and you’ll have room to try ideas, test them, and keep what works.

We care more about your ideas, energy, and follow-through than your résumé. If you’ve grown an account, built a brand, run a campaign for a club or side project, or just have a sharp eye for what makes people stop scrolling, we want to see it.

What you’ll own

* **Social media:** Plan, schedule, and post across Instagram and Facebook. Our rhythm is weekly batching, one video most days, supporting posts, and daily Stories.
* **Content creation:** Film, edit, and caption short-form video, including founder videos, trend ideas, behind-the-scenes content, and educational wellness content. Later you’ll feature our providers.
* **Brand voice:** Keep everything warm, personable, and recognizably Clove. We want a “Clove family” feel, not a corporate one.
* **Email marketing:** Write and send newsletters and nurture emails to our growing list.
* **Website and landing pages:** Keep copy fresh and help us improve how visitors become members.
* **Community and partnerships:** Find local DFW opportunities, such as groups, wellness events, gyms, studios, and employers, and help us show up where our members are.
* **Provider marketing:** Support our provider recruitment with content, outreach materials, and event presence.
* **Campaigns:** Build and run launch and promotional campaigns, with help from the founder.
* **Analytics:** Track what’s working, such as followers, engagement, email opens, and signups, and report on it simply each month.

What we’re looking for

* Strong written and visual communication
* Comfort filming and editing short-form video (CapCut, Canva, or similar)
* Familiarity with Instagram, trends, and what makes content spread
* Self-starter who can manage your own time in a part-time role
* Organized enough to plan content ahead and meet deadlines
* Genuine interest in health, wellness, and helping people feel better
* Coursework, internship, freelance, or personal projects in marketing, communications, or social media are all great

**Nice to have:** Email tools (MailerLite, Mailchimp) and a connection to the DFW wellness or parent community.

This role is for you if...

You have more ideas than time, you notice what’s working on other brands, and you want to try things instead of waiting for permission. We want you to be creative. Pitch the weird idea, test the new format, tell us what we’re missing. You’ll have real room to experiment and a founder who wants to hear it.

* [Membership perk or discount, if you want to offer one]

jobs.title: Demand and Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
Role Overview:

Picture a chiropractor looking for a better way to run their practice. You help them find us, understand what we offer, and choose us. Then you help them get what they need to see value fast and stay with us for years. That journey, from first click to loyal customer, is yours to shape across all our products.

Demand and lifecycle matter equally here, because winning a customer and keeping one both drive revenue. You'll own our paid channels, with a paid media freelancer to support you, and you'll build alongside a team where every role fits together: a Content Manager who owns organic, a partner manager who owns our partner channels, and a Product Marketing Manager who shapes our story and our launches. Each of us leads a domain, but all of us move in one direction. No random acts of marketing here.

Expect high standards and real support. You'll get clear priorities, honest feedback, and the tools to do your best work, including AI. We like to win, and we win together. Our plan and our people keep us grounded while we grow, and if you're here to do great work, you'll thrive.

What You'll Do:

* **Follow the revenue**. Track what turns into closed deals, not just leads. Analyze conversion from first touch to closed deal, find where the most people get stuck, and run experiments to fix it. Build funnel dashboards and attribution in HubSpot and with AI.
* **Go beyond the MQL**. Nurture leads until they're ready to buy, guided by signals and intent, so we reach the right people at the right moment. Work with the BDR team to turn those signals into action within integrated campaigns.
* **Build campaigns in HubSpot**. Run campaigns from start to finish: forms, workflows, emails, tracking, and landing pages. Handle routine HubSpot admin and data hygiene inside the standards set by marketing and RevOps.
* **Guide the lifecycle**. Build sophisticated lifecycle and education paths with our Content Manager that help prospects move down the funnel and make decision. Similarly build customer lifecycle paths for onboarding, adoption, retention, and cross-sell across all our products.
* **Partner with sales**. Align with the BDR and sales leaders on targeting, handoffs, and feedback. Turn every campaign into a clear brief for sales, BDRs, CS, and leadership and facilitate the flow of feedback and information around campaigns.
* **Run events, webinars, and email**. Promote events and webinars, own registration and follow-up, and handle email segmentation and sends.
* **Use AI well.** Use AI and agentic tools in your core work: content production, lead scoring and routing, outbound sequencing with the BDR team, and reporting. Build alerts for conversion drops and stalled leads. Check the math and the output every time.
* **Own execution**. Keep the plan and the deadlines moving. Know who to tap, ask early, and say what's at risk and what you need before anyone has to chase you.

Who You Are:

* **B2B SaaS builder**. You've built demand generation and lifecycle programs in B2B SaaS, and you're deeply skilled in HubSpot.
* **Revenue-first**. You care most about revenue. You know other metrics are indicators and metrics to influence, not the goal, and you know how to use those signals and intent to cultivate buyers.
* **Numbers person**. You deeply believe math is for marketers. You love funnel math and experiments, get curious when a conversion rate moves, and dig in until you know why. You turn numbers into decisions and explain them in plain language so the whole team can act on them.
* **Customer-minded**. You think like a customer. You know lifecycle frameworks, like Reforge's retention and engagement, and you know that retaining the customers we have is just as mission critical as bringing new customers through the door.
* **AI-fluent**. You use AI every day, you can show us what you've built, and you check its work. You know it can't replace good thinking and strong foundations.
* **Paid media savvy**. You know paid medi

jobs.title: Product Content Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
Description:

**Remote Worker in the following US states:** AZ, CO, FL, IL, IN, MI, MO, NC, OH, OK, TX, WI

**About Pragmatic Institute**

Pragmatic Institute provides product, marketing, and data training for professionals and organizations around the world. We help teams build better products and bring them to market more effectively through education, certifications, and practical resources.

**About the Role**

Your job is to get what Pragmatic Institute knows in front of the people who need it. You'll start with a strong base: instructors who have done product management and product marketing for a living, original research, and frameworks that product teams have used for decades. You'll turn that expertise into content product people trust and can find, in search results and in AI answers.

This role is a blend of content marketing and product marketing. You'll plan, write and edit content, and you'll help shape how we describe our courses, certifications and programs. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and you won't manage anyone. You'll do well here if:

* **You've done the job our customers do.** You've worked as a product manager or product marketer. You can sit in on an instructor conversation, follow it, and spot what a practitioner would want to read next. You love to chat with customers and practice the principles that Pragmatic trains.
* **You run the AI. It doesn't run you.** You use AI tools throughout your work to research, draft and repurpose faster. You're also the person who approves and polishes every piece, and you make sure Pragmatic's positioning comes through in everything we publish. You never put AI output in front of an instructor that you can't stand behind.
* **You know how content gets found now.** You understand SEO and GEO and how large language models choose and cite sources, and you write for both.
* **You work well across teams.** You're comfortable working with instructors, the product team that builds our courses, sales and the rest of marketing, and you keep work moving without needing authority over anyone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work with instructors and senior leaders to turn webinars, panel discussions and recorded sessions into articles, guides, email content and other derived assets.
* Draft LinkedIn posts for instructors to publish in their own voice, and hand them to our social media lead, who manages the LinkedIn channels.
* Champion thought leadership for Pragmatic Institute, its leaders and its instructors, including bylined articles and the campaigns built around them.
* Use research, including our own surveys and outside market data, to ground content in evidence, and turn findings into content product teams can use.
* Build market intelligence for the company. Talk with customers and prospects, including NIHITO interviews, track competitors and market trends, and share what you learn with marketing, product, sales and senior leaders.
* Partner with the product team and sales enablement to turn our courses, certifications and programs into commercially compelling go-to-market plans, including launch messaging, sales materials and the product copy on our course, certification and program pages.
* Contribute to positioning, messaging and product architecture. The Head of Marketing owns positioning and messaging. You'll bring practitioner insight, write copy that applies it, and flag where it isn't landing.
* Use our buyer personas and competitive research to make sure content speaks to the people who buy and take our courses.
* Plan and optimize content for search engines and AI answer engines, including topic research, on-page optimization, and the structure that makes content easy to cite.
* Run content audits and gap analyses, decide which topics are worth making based on search demand, instructor expertise and business goals, and keep the content calendar current.
* Identify the content sales needs and help build it, so the sales team can speak to our full range

Marketing Specialist – Make Your Work Mean More

**Turn creativity into impact!** Goodwill of Northeast Ohio and Northwest Pennsylvania is looking for a creative, digitally savvy Marketing Specialist to help bring our mission to life. From engaging social media content and digital campaigns to store signage, and promotional materials, you’ll help tell the Goodwill story and strengthen our brand across the region.
  
If you’re a strong communicator with an eye for design and a passion for meaningful work, we want to hear from you!

✨ What We Offer

* Part-time opportunity to grow your marketing career
* Creative freedom to develop fresh ideas and campaigns
* Opportunities to support community outreach and mission services
* A mission-driven team where your work makes a difference

  

What You’ll Do

* **Tell the Goodwill story** by creating engaging content that highlights our mission, programs, services, employees, and the people we serve.
* **Manage digital marketing** across social media, online platforms, and other digital channels, ensuring content is visually appealing, on-brand, and optimized for search and engagement.
* **Create marketing materials** including store signage, promotional displays, branded uniforms, vehicle wraps, and other organization-wide materials.
* **Coordinate marketing requests** from internal teams, managing signage and messaging orders from creation through delivery and tracking.

* Experience using graphic design or creative software.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and project coordination.
* Creativity and the ability to develop fresh ideas that support brand awareness and engagement.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.
* A collaborative approach and commitment to Goodwill’s mission, culture, and continuous improvement.

  

Education & Experience

* Four-year degree in Marketing, Business Management, Communications, or a related field preferred.
* Experience in nonprofit marketing or community outreach preferred.
* Experience creating digital content, marketing materials, or promotional campaigns is a plus.

jobs.title: Marketing Operations Manager
jobs.desc:
Company Conformance Statements / Essential Personal Characteristics

In the performance of their respective tasks and duties, all employees are expected to conform to the following:

  

* Perform quality work within deadlines with or without direct supervision.
* Interact professionally with other employees, customers, and clients.
* Work effectively as a team member.
* Work independently while understanding the necessity for communicating and coordinating work efforts with other employees and organizations.
* Exhibit exceptional integrity in all matters.
* Lead by example.

General Statement of Responsibility

The Marketing Operations Manager serves as the operational owner of the organization’s outreach and marketing system. This role is responsible for executing campaigns, maintaining CRM infrastructure, managing routine website content, developing messaging and materials, and enabling staff to engage referral and placement partners consistently and effectively. The position translates defined targeting and strategic direction into coordinated, repeatable execution across Business Divisions.

The Marketing Operations Manager contributes to the organization’s goal of increasing referral and placement volume by 15% year over year. The Marketing Operations Manager supports that goal through consistent outreach execution, improved visibility into activity, reduced manual overhead, and ongoing optimization of the marketing system. The role partners closely with the Data Team and external vendors for advanced targeting, analytics, and technical support while owning day-to-day campaign execution, system operation, and performance refinement.

Major Responsibilities / Activities

Marketing System & CRM Operations

* Configure, maintain, and optimize the CRM and marketing automation platform.
* Execute and monitor campaigns within the CRM, including outreach workflows and communications.
* Ensure all outreach activity is captured, tracked, and visible for reporting and accountability.
* Maintain standardized templates, workflows, and campaign structures to support repeatable execution.
* Train users on CRM usage, workflows, and campaign execution best practices.

Campaign Execution, Content, and Brand

* Develop and execute outreach campaigns aligned to Business Division priorities and targeting inputs.
* Create and maintain on-brand messaging, copy, and campaign materials.
* Ensure consistency in creative and messaging across Business Divisions and campaigns.
* Manage routine website content upkeep, including updates to service information, program positioning, campaign-related content, outcomes, and other public-facing materials.
* Monitor website content for outdated information, inconsistent messaging, and needed revisions to keep the site accurate and aligned with organizational priorities.
* Coordinate with outside vendors for advanced design, copy, or production needs as required.

Field Enablement & Adoption

* Provide field staff with practical tools, templates, and messaging to support relationship outreach.
* Develop marketing toolkits that enable consistent, professional engagement without adding administrative burden.
* Support training and adoption of marketing practices and workflows across Business Divisions.
* Improve consistency of outreach activity across regions by standardizing processes and materials.
* Partner with leadership to ensure marketing tools align with staff capacity and operational realities.

Campaign Effectiveness & Analytics

* Track and evaluate campaign performance, including outreach activity, engagement, and referral outcomes.
* Identify patterns in performance to determine what messaging, audiences, and approaches are most effective.
* Use CRM and campaign data to inform ongoing optimization of outreach strategies.
* Partner with the Data Team to incorporate targeting inputs and reporting into campaign execution.

jobs.title: Social Media Marketing Specialist
jobs.desc:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about creating engaging digital experiences and driving brand growth through innovative social media strategies? We are seeking a dynamic and energetic Social Media Marketing Specialist to lead our social media content creation, management, and analytics efforts. In this role, you will craft compelling narratives across multiple platforms, monitor digital marketing performance, and foster meaningful relationships with our online community. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and have a knack for blending creativity with data-driven insights, this is your chance to make a significant impact! This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to shape our brand presence and elevate our digital marketing initiatives.

**Duties**

* Develop and implement comprehensive social media marketing strategies tailored to various platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, and TikTok.
* Create high-quality, engaging content including graphics, videos, photography, and written posts using tools like Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and Adobe Creative Suite.
* Manage social media accounts using scheduling tools like Hootsuite and Buffer to ensure consistent posting schedules and timely responses.
* Conduct social listening to monitor brand mentions, industry trends, and competitor activities; utilize insights for content optimization.
* Analyze social media analytics and marketing online analytics to assess campaign performance; prepare detailed reports on media performance metrics.
* Coordinate with public relations teams to align messaging strategies and enhance brand reputation through media outreach.
* Execute paid advertising campaigns on platforms such as Facebook Advertising; optimize ad performance based on data insights.
* Engage with followers by responding promptly to comments, messages, and inquiries to foster community growth and relationship management.
* Perform keyword research for content optimization; leverage SEO best practices to increase visibility across digital channels.
* Monitor digital marketing performance metrics regularly; adjust strategies accordingly to maximize engagement and ROI.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in social media management with a strong portfolio demonstrating successful campaigns across multiple platforms.
* Proficiency in media editing tools including Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, video editing software, and photography techniques.
* Hands-on experience with social listening tools like Hootsuite or Buffer; familiarity with social media analytics platforms such as Google Analytics.
* Knowledge of digital marketing performance monitoring techniques; ability to analyze data for actionable insights.
* Strong content creation skills including writing compelling copy and designing eye-catching graphics aligned with branding guidelines.
* Experience executing Facebook Advertising campaigns and managing paid social media promotions effectively.
* Background in public relations or relationship management within a digital context is a plus.
* Familiarity with e-commerce platforms and web analytics tools is advantageous for integrated marketing efforts.
* Excellent proofreading skills combined with attention to detail in all forms of content production.

Join us as a Social Media Marketing Specialist where your creativity meets strategic insight! Bring your passion for digital marketing analytics, graphic design, content writing, and innovative social media communication to help elevate our brand’s online presence—making every interaction count!

Pay: $50.00 - $100.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Retirement plan

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Brunch Marketing Coordinator
jobs.desc:
Job Summary

High on Brunch is seeking a **Brunch Marketing Coordinator** to support marketing campaigns, brand promotion, social media activities, and customer engagement initiatives. This role helps promote breakfast and brunch offerings, coordinate promotional events, create marketing content, and strengthen the restaurant’s visibility through digital and local marketing efforts.

Common Job Roles

* Brunch Marketing Coordinator
* Restaurant Marketing Coordinator
* Food Service Marketing Specialist
* Restaurant Promotions Coordinator
* Hospitality Marketing Coordinator

Key Responsibilities

* Coordinate marketing campaigns promoting brunch menus, seasonal specials, and restaurant events.
* Create and schedule engaging content for social media platforms.
* Assist with developing promotional materials, advertisements, menus, and digital announcements.
* Maintain a consistent brand voice across marketing channels.
* Coordinate photography and content creation featuring food, beverages, and restaurant experiences.
* Support promotional events, themed brunches, and special dining experiences.
* Monitor customer feedback, online engagement, and campaign performance.
* Assist with updating website content, online menus, and business listings.
* Coordinate with restaurant management regarding promotions, pricing information, and featured menu items.
* Support email marketing, customer outreach, and loyalty program communications.
* Research local marketing opportunities and relevant food service trends.
* Maintain a marketing calendar and organize campaign materials.
* Track marketing expenses, promotional results, and campaign documentation.
* Follow company branding standards and applicable advertising guidelines.

Requirements

* High school diploma or equivalent required; a degree in marketing, communications, business, or a related field is preferred.
* Previous marketing, social media, hospitality, restaurant, or customer service experience is an asset.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Good organizational and project coordination abilities.
* Familiarity with social media platforms and digital marketing tools.
* Basic knowledge of content creation, campaign planning, and marketing analytics.
* Strong attention to detail and creative problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Professional, dependable, and team-oriented.

Preferred Skills

* Experience marketing restaurants, cafés, brunch concepts, or food brands.
* Familiarity with Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and other relevant social platforms.
* Basic photography, video editing, and graphic design skills.
* Experience using content scheduling or email marketing platforms.
* Understanding of local promotions and customer engagement strategies.
* Ability to evaluate campaign performance and identify improvement opportunities.
* Strong collaboration skills when working with restaurant and creative teams.

About the Company

High on Brunch is identified as the company associated with this position. The role description is tailored to a brunch-focused food service business, emphasizing restaurant promotion, menu marketing, digital engagement, and customer outreach. LO Media Group is a full-service marketing and video production agency in Tappan, NY. We run social, paid ads, video, branding, and web for restaurants, healthcare practices, nonprofits, professional services, and local businesses across New York and New Jersey. We’re a small team with an in-house video crew, so the content you plan actually gets shot.

**The role**  
You’ll own a book of 5 client accounts from strategy to results, working with our Social Media Lead, Senior Social Media Manager, and video team. You’ll be the main point of contact for your clients and the person who knows their brand best.

**What you’ll do**

* Create, write, and schedule posts across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn
* Run client check-ins, present content, and manage approvals
* Plan shoots with our video team and turn footage into platform-ready content
* Manage community engagement and respond to comments and messages

* 3+ years of social media experience, agency experience strongly preferred
* Comfortable leading client calls and handling feedback with confidence
* Able to manage multiple brand voices without losing quality
* Strong writer with a good eye for visual content
* Organized, reliable with deadlines, and calm when priorities shift
* Experience working with AI tools in your workflow

**Nice to have**

**About us**

Nail It! is a nail salon in Ridgewood, Queens, offering manicures, pedicures, spa services, and specialized nail art. We’re looking for a creative Social Media Manager to help share our story and bring more clients through our doors by filming and creating content for our Instagram and TikTok.

**What you’ll do**

* Film our nail techs’ work, finished sets, and moments around the salon
* Edit short videos and photos for both Instagram and TikTok, making each fit the style of its platform
* Create carousels, story graphics, and captions
* Plan and schedule posts in advance using a content calendar
* Reply to DMs and comments during your shifts and help direct people to book
* Track post performance in Instagram and TikTok analytics and share what’s working
* Stay on top of beauty and nail trends
* Bring creative new content ideas

* Strong understanding of Instagram and TikTok trends or content strategy

* Personable and professional with clients

* A hands-on role where you can build your content portfolio
* A friendly, supportive team

Apply through Indeed or email hello@nailitnyc.com with your 3 best videos and a link to your Instagram/TikTok profile or portfolio.

Partnering closely with the Community Manager, you'll lead by example, resolve resident concerns, and ensure both the team and community feel supported and empowered to thrive!

Through leadership in destination development, marketing and venue management expertise, the CRVA leads efforts to maximize the region’s economic potential through visitor spending, creating jobs and opportunities for the community. Brands supported by the CRVA include the Charlotte Convention Center, Spectrum Center, Bojangles Entertainment Complex, NASCAR Hall of Fame, Charlotte Regional Film Commission, Visit Charlotte and Visitor Info Centers.

**Job Summary**

The Digital Marketing Specialist, Venues is responsible for supporting the success of the CRVA’s digital properties and marketing strategy. This individual builds and maintains content for CRVA-managed websites, leads email/SMS marketing and communication efforts, and turns performance data into actionable improvements. This individual must be a detail-oriented multitasker with an ability to merge knowledge of digital experience with business priorities, and should readily adopt new technology, including AI-assisted workflows. This role supports all CRVA brands, with an emphasis on the Bojangles Entertainment Complex and NASCAR Hall of Fame.

**Job Responsibilities**

* **Essential Job Duties**

* Build, update and publish content for CRVA-managed websites and digital platforms, including page builds via WordPress platform (Bricks Builder, Advanced Custom Fields) and Craft CMS.
* Support the migration of CRVA venue websites from a legacy platform (Craft CMS) to an in-house WordPress environment, including content migration, URL redirect mapping, pre-launch QA and post-launch cleanup.
* Support optimization and enhancements for user experiences, website performance and accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA).
* Collaborate with teammates to audit website content and create new content.
* Maintain event listings, ticketing links and on-sale information across venue websites and monitor event data feeds (e.g. Ticketmaster) for accuracy.
* Utilize email/SMS marketing platforms (e.g. Hive, Prospect2) to create effective and engaging campaigns that support awareness of digital content, drive online ticket revenue, and deliver pre-event “Know Before You Go” communication to ticket buyers.
* Coordinate with internal teams on timing and approvals and maintain quality control over email/SMS content, design and layout.
* Build and execute email and SMS automation tactics to support communication and behavioral marketing strategies.
* Manage email and SMS audience segmentation, including tags, lists and segments, to deliver targeted, relevant communications.
* Monitor and analyze performance of digital platforms and marketing efforts using Google Analytics (GA4) and related tools.
* Generate reports and analyze the effectiveness of digital marketing tactics and identify opportunities to improve efforts.
* Work at the direction of the Digital Experience Manager to fulfill campaign and website reporting needs.
* Leverage SEO software and insights to optimize website content and metadata, improve organic search value of websites, capture relevant organic traffic and increase visibility in AI-powered search experiences.

jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist
jobs.desc:
Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors.

We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Paid Media Strategist / Account Strategist who can own client accounts from strategy through execution.

The Opportunity

This is a hands-on strategist role with responsibility for both client relationships and campaign performance. You'll own a portfolio of accounts, lead bi-weekly client calls, manage Meta campaigns, monitor results, contribute to ad messaging, and serve as the primary point of contact for your clients.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client results, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical clients
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Solve account issues proactively to support stability and growth

*Meta Campaign Management*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audience targeting, bid strategies, creative testing, and campaign variables
* Monitor performance daily and make adjustments based on cost-per-appointment and other key metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and develop strategies to improve results
* Test audiences, messaging, and creative to identify opportunities for stronger performance
* Contribute to ad copy and campaign messaging

*Tracking & Technical Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Proactively monitor tracking and lead flow to prevent issues from affecting client results

  
**Requirements**  

* 4+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with a strong focus on Meta advertising
* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing
* High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
* Direct-response advertising

How You Work

You take ownership. When something isn't working, you investigate the issue, determine what needs to change, and act. You're comfortable being accountable for results and explaining performance clearly to clients who may not speak marketing.

You're organized, detail-oriented, and able to move quickly across multiple accounts without losing sight of the outcome. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people sharing responsibility for it.

 **Benefits**  

* Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
* Training & Development
* Work From Home
* Flexible Schedule
* Pe

**Required Qualifications**

* A personal or professional connection to the neurodivergent community, such as lived experience, family, coursework, or work with children, and familiarity with neuroaffirming practices

jobs.title: Demand Generation Manager
jobs.desc:
CyberSheath Services International LLC is a rapidly growing Managed Services Provider primarily focused on providing Cybersecurity services to the Defense Industrial Base (DIB). We are excited to be expanding our staff due to our growth and are looking to add a Marketing Generalist to our team!

CyberSheath integrates compliance and threat mitigation efforts and eliminates redundant security practices that don't improve and, in fact, may weaken an organization's security posture. Our professionals tell clients where to stop spending, where to invest, and how to take what they are already doing and integrate it in a way that delivers improved security.

Successful candidates for CyberSheath are self-motivated, think out of the box, work, and solve issues independently. Additionally, our most successful people are self-starters and willing to put on many hats in order to succeed. CyberSheath is fast-growing and seeks candidates who want to be part of our upward trajectory.

Position Overview

The Demand Generation Manager will own the strategy, execution, measurement, and optimization of multichannel demand-generation programs. This role will be responsible for converting CyberSheath's market expertise into awareness, engagement, qualified demand, sales opportunities, and measurable pipeline contribution.

The ideal candidate combines B2B demand-generation expertise with strong campaign operations, content instincts, analytical rigor, and the ability to collaborate closely with Sales, subject-matter experts, external partners, and marketing leadership. They are equally comfortable developing a quarterly campaign plan, writing campaign briefs, launching a webinar nurture sequence, analyzing funnel performance, and recommending changes based on data.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Generation Strategy

* Develop and execute a scalable, full-funnel demand-generation strategy aligned to CyberSheath's revenue objectives, ideal customer profile, priority verticals, buyer personas, and sales motions.
* Build integrated campaign plans that create awareness, capture demand, nurture prospects, accelerate opportunities, and support expansion or cross-sell opportunities.
* Define targeted campaigns for key audiences, including DIB owners and executives, CISOs, CIOs, IT directors, compliance leaders, security practitioners, contracts leaders, and operations stakeholders.
* Translate complex compliance and security topics into clear, buyer-centered messaging that emphasizes business outcomes, risk reduction, contract readiness, operational continuity, and long-term compliance readiness.
* Establish campaign themes and content pillars around CMMC 2.0, NIST SP 800-171, DFARS, CUI protection, compliance gaps, assessments, remediation, managed services, and secure federal enclave offerings.
* Partner with executive leadership and subject-matter experts to identify timely market opportunities, regulatory developments, customer pain points, and thought-leadership angles.

Campaign Development and Execution

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimize integrated campaigns across email, paid media, organic social, webinars, virtual events, field events, partner marketing, landing pages, content syndication, retargeting, and other relevant channels.
* Build campaign journeys for prospects at different stages of maturity, from early awareness of CMMC requirements through active evaluation of compliance solutions.
* Develop campaign briefs that define target audience, objective, message, offer, channels, assets, timeline, budget, success metrics, and follow-up requirements.

Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. This is a hands-on strategist role with responsibility for both client relationships and campaign performance. You'll own a portfolio of accounts, lead bi-weekly client calls, manage Meta campaigns, monitor results, contribute to ad messaging, and serve as the primary point of contact for your clients.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client results, relationships, and retention.

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals

*Meta Campaign Management*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audience targeting, bid strategies, creative testing, and campaign variables

* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and develop strategies to improve results
* Test audiences, messaging, and creative to identify opportunities for stronger performance
* Contribute to ad copy and campaign messaging

*Tracking & Technical Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Proactively monitor tracking and lead flow to prevent issues from affecting client results

  
**Requirements**  

* 4+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with a strong focus on Meta advertising
* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
* Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
* Video sales letter marketing

You take ownership. When something isn't working, you investigate the issue, determine what needs to change, and act. You're comfortable being accountable for results and explaining performance clearly to clients who may not speak marketing.

As a Media Planner & Buyer at SPARK you'll build and execute media plans for clients. You'll work alongside our Client Experience lead, translating strategy into tactical media recommendations, running the RFP process with publishers and vendors, and getting campaigns into market on tight timelines. You are a creative thinker who doesn't default to the same three tactics on every plan, and you're comfortable doing the blocking and tackling yourself. If this sounds like you, read on.

*The Role*:

**Media Planning:**

* Translate campaign strategy and client objectives into tactical media recommendations across digital and traditional channels.
* Build media plans that reach layered audiences, including older demographics through traditional and local channels and younger demographics through digital and social.
* Bring out-of-the-box thinking to every plan. Out-of-home activations, experiential opportunities, and non-standard publisher partnerships, not just the standard buy.
* Develop flowcharts, budget allocations, and rationale documents that a client can understand and approve.

**RFP & Vendor Management:**

* Write and issue media briefs and RFPs to publishers and vendors with clear specs, timelines, and objectives.
* Push publishers to bring creative, non-templated ideas rather than accepting rate cards as submitted.
* Collect, normalize, and compare vendor proposals against budget and objectives.
* Negotiate rates, added value, and placement to stretch a modest budget as far as it will go.

**Buying & Execution:**

* Execute buys across paid search, paid social, programmatic, and traditional channels.
* Build and manage campaigns in Google Ads and Meta, including setup, targeting, and QA.
* Manage insertion orders, trafficking, creative specs, and launch checklists so campaigns go live on time and correctly.
* Coordinate with internal creative and account teams on asset specs and deadlines.

**Reporting & Optimization:**

* Monitor in-flight performance and recommend optimizations.
* Build clear, client-ready performance reports that tie back to campaign objectives.
* Maintain organized documentation of plans, buys, IOs, and vendor communication for handoff to the internal team.

**Experience Required:**

* 3+ years planning and buying media, including hands-on buying (not planning only)
* Hands-on platform experience: Google Ads, Ad Server, Meta Ads Manager, programmatic DSPs, Google Analytics
* Traditional media experience (out-of-home, TV, radio, print, local partnerships) strongly preferred
* Experience running RFP processes with publishers and vendors
* Previous agency experience preferred
