jobs.desc:
Social Media Marketing Manager

  

DrHouse is a growing U.S. telehealth company seeking a hands-on, highly organized Social Media Marketing Manager to build and own social campaigns that drive awareness, website traffic, new patients, and use of our services.

You'll learn our business and audiences, bring campaign ideas, create content, manage engagement, and use performance data to improve results.

**Your performance will be measured on three outcomes: growth, meaningful engagement, and conversion.**

**What You'll Own**

* Channels: Manage Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube. Create B2B content for LinkedIn and consumer content for the other channels.
* Campaigns & calendar: Develop social campaigns tied to business priorities, seasonal moments, audience needs, and trends. Build and maintain a rolling 30-day content and campaign calendar.
* Content creation: Generate ideas and write hooks, captions, and post copy. Create everyday posts in Canva using templates, existing assets, carousels, user-generated content (UGC), and simple short-form video.
* UGC & creators: Help build our UGC and creator strategy, especially for TikTok and Instagram.
* Community engagement: Engage actively with relevant accounts, creators, communities, partners, and B2B audiences.
* Testing & reporting: Test ideas to increase reach, website traffic, and conversion. Track performance weekly, recommend what to scale, change, or stop, and flag top content for paid promotion.

  

**Creative Support**  
**You'll help set our social look and feel, including templates and content formats, and should be able to produce most everyday posts yourself in Canva. For advanced design, animation, or video editing, we may bring in additional creative support. You own the idea, direction, and day-to-day execution.**  
**Healthcare Context**

  

**You should understand, or be willing to quickly learn, healthcare marketing rules, including patient privacy (HIPAA), appropriate health claims, and when to escalate content or comments. Some content will need compliance review before publishing.**  
**What We're Looking For**  

* Proven experience growing social accounts with results beyond follower counts, and running campaigns from idea to results.
* Excellent written English and strong social copywriting skills.
* Strong Canva skills, good visual judgment, and short-form video experience.
* Highly organized and comfortable reading performance data.
* Creative, proactive, and able to work independently and with marketing and creative partners.
* Comfortable using AI tools to work faster, with the judgment to avoid generic, AI-generated content.
* Healthcare or regulated-industry experience is required.

  

**Schedule**  
Regular overlap with U.S. Central Time (CT) business hours.

  

**To Apply**  
Please share a brief introduction and 2 to 3 examples of social content or campaigns you personally helped create.  
Before your interview, please review DrHouse's website and social channels. Come prepared for a high-level conversation about our current social presence and how you would help us meet our growth and conversion goals. No formal presentation is required.

**About the role**  
You will support the lead on SEO and GEO strategy for a portfolio of agency clients, supporting delivery from first audit to reporting. This is a hands-on role for a strategist who can move between keyword research, technical fixes, AI search visibility and one that would grow into more client-facing involvement as your skillset advances. You will be the supporting strategist on retainer accounts, while being mentored by your lead strategist. Delivery and cross collaboration with PR, paid, social and creative teams is crucial, so search is considered as a part of the larger strategy in place. Clients span B2B and B2C, national and local, and regulated and consumer industries, so curiosity and adaptability matter as much as any single tool.  
  
**What you'll do**  
**On-page SEO and content strategy**

* Build content strategies that earn qualified organic traffic and turn it into leads, sales or bookings, not just clicks.
* Map keywords to the right content type and intent, and plan multiple pieces across different areas of a site so each one has a clear job in the buyer journey.
* Recommend on-page changes and page-template updates that give important pages room for richer, more useful content.
* Use internal linking, topical depth and site context to strengthen the pages that matter most.
* Plan content for national, regional or local footprints based on each client's industry and service area, including location pages and Google Business Profile optimization.
* Spot content decay and cannibalization, and decide when to refresh, consolidate or retire a page.

  
**Technical SEO**

* Support technical SEO audits and provide findings and data to be turned into a prioritized roadmap based on impact, effort and business value.
* Familiar with the value of Core Web Vitals, structured data, and clean URL and folder architecture in terms clients and developers both understand.
* Own the fundamentals with precision: title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, canonicals, redirects, XML sitemaps and robots.txt.

* Connect GEO work to the SEO fundamentals it depends on, including crawlability for AI crawlers, structured data, and content that is easy to extract and cite.
* Analyze which sources AI platforms cite in a client's category (owned pages, earned media, reviews, forums, directories) and build strategy around that mix.
* Research the prompts and questions real buyers ask across ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and AI Mode, Perplexity, Gemini, Copilot and Claude.
* Stay current on how AI search changes and translate what's new into practical recommendations, without chasing hype.

**Measurement and reporting**

* Report organic and AI search results in business terms: pipeline, revenue, leads, bookings or enrollments, depending on the client.
* Use keyword intent and the buyer journey to explain complex targeting strategies in plain language.
* Able to present reporting outcomes to internal teams, and willing to attend client reporting sessions as a means for rapport building.

* Spot growth opportunities within existing accounts and support new-business audits.

* 3+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with at least 1 in an agency or multi-client environment.
* A track record of organic growth you can explain with real numbers and the business impact behind them.
* Working fluency in Semrush (or Ahrefs), Screaming Frog, Google Search Console and GA4.
* A clear, curious point of view on how AI is changing search.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience with Profound or another GEO/AI visibi

**2.** Please send your **CV in ENGLISH** to be considered for the position.

**3.** This is a **remote,** part-time (**20-25 hrs/week**) position with a pay rate between **8-12 USD/hr.**

  

**Who We Are**

We are Braven, a digital marketing agency whose purpose is to leverage digital marketing tools to deliver results. Our focus is singular, to scale companies, organizations, or brands by driving customers, company awareness, and brand recognition. Our digital marketing formula has been tried and tested, elegant in its execution and creative in its delivery of results.

**Who You Are**

As an SEO Specialist at Braven Agency, you will be responsible for developing and executing effective SEO strategies for a diverse portfolio of clients. You will work closely with other team members, including content writers, designers, and project managers, to ensure cohesive and impactful campaigns. This role requires a strong understanding of SEO best practices, a passion for staying up-to-date with industry trends, and the ability to analyze data to drive informed decisions.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct comprehensive keyword research and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities.
* Develop and implement on-page and off-page optimization strategies, including technical SEO audits and improvements.
* Optimize website content, meta descriptions, and title tags to improve search engine rankings.
* Build high-quality backlinks through outreach and content marketing efforts.
* Monitor and analyze website traffic, keyword rankings, and other key SEO metrics using tools like Google Analytics and Search Console.
* Create and present regular reports on SEO performance and provide actionable insights.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest SEO trends, algorithm updates, and best practices.
* Collaborate with content writers to develop SEO-friendly content.
* Work closely with the development team to ensure website technical SEO is optimized.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of overall digital marketing strategies.
Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality work.  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in SEO, preferably in an agency setting.
* Proven track record of successfully improving organic search rankings and traffic.
* Strong understanding of on-page and off-page optimization techniques.
* Proficiency in using SEO tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Moz, etc.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Detail-oriented and organized.
* Passion for digital marketing and SEO.
* Experience with local SEO is a plus.
Familiarity with other digital marketing channels (PPC, social media) is a plus.

jobs.title: Technical SEO Specialist
jobs.desc:
**DynamiX** is seeking an in-office **Technical SEO Specialist** to improve organic visibility,

technical website performance, and AI-search readiness across a portfolio of client websites.

  

This role is ideal for someone who understands how websites are built, how search engines evaluate them, and how to turn technical findings into practical improvements. You will work closely with our web, content, marketing, and client teams to identify opportunities, resolve issues, and help clients become more visible in traditional and AI-driven search.

**Responsibilities:**

* Conduct technical SEO audits, identify issues, and prioritize clear recommendations.
* Improve site crawlability, indexing, page speed, mobile usability, internal linking, redirects, and site architecture.
* Implement and validate on-page SEO elements, including metadata, headers, image optimization, canonical tags, XML sitemaps, robots.txt, and structured data.
* Help optimize websites and content for AI-driven search experiences, including generative search results and answer-focused discovery.
* Use tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Screaming Frog, and SEO platforms to monitor performance and uncover opportunities.
* Partner with designers, developers, content creators, and project teams to ensure SEO is incorporated into website builds, redesigns, and ongoing improvements.
* Review website content and page structure for keyword alignment, user intent, clarity, and conversion opportunities.
* Create concise client-facing reports and explain recommendations in straightforward, actionable terms.
* Stay current on search-engine updates, AI-search trends, and evolving best practices.

**Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of technical SEO, website optimization, or closely related digital marketing experience.
* Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, CMS platforms, website architecture, and how these affect search performance.
* Hands-on experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, Screaming Frog, and SEO research or monitoring tools.
* Experience implementing or guiding schema markup and structured data.
* Familiarity with AI tools and AI-search optimization practices.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Comfortable managing multiple client priorities and collaborating across teams.
Agency or multi-client experience is a plus.  

  

**Details:**

This is a **full-time, in-office** role based in the Cobb County metro area/Kennesaw. Compensation will be based on experience, technical depth, and overall role fit, and will be discussed during the interview process.

**About DynamiX**

Interested in joining an amazing team of elite web professionals? **DynamiX** is a custom web house headquartered in Kennesaw, Georgia (northwest of Atlanta). We are an *Inc 5000 Fastest Growing Company*, a *Top 25 Small Business* in Cobb County for 7 years running, and have received over 1,300 awards for our sites. We're obsessed with helping our clients win, and we love doing it! We value our team and want them to grow and thrive both personally and professionally. We do this by cultivating a sense of community and family as well as having a generous benefits package, including 401k, and great health benefits. If you are interested in working at a fast-paced, exciting and growing company, we are excited to meet and connect with you.

Our mantra is "Do it right, or don't do it". If you're eager to build great things, never settle for "just okay" and learn a lot more than you expected, then you may be just who we are looking for as we grow our team!

**About Basic Research**

Basic Research is a Salt Lake City-based health and beauty company behind brands including SeroVital and Novex Biotech. Our products are sold direct to consumer, on Amazon, and at major retailers nationwide. We’re building a lean, in-house performance team that moves fast, tests constantly, and lets the data decide.

You’ll partner closely with our Amazon Ads Manager, who runs Amazon paid media day to day. jobs.title: Lead Media Buyer
jobs.desc:
About Clients Blackbox

Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors. We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.

We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Senior Paid Media Strategist / Paid Media Lead who can own client performance across media buying, strategy, messaging, creative testing, and client communication.

The Opportunity

This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced performance marketer who can operate beyond Ads Manager.

You'll own a portfolio of client accounts end to end - leading client conversations, managing Meta performance, writing direct-response copy and video sales letter scripts, developing testing strategies, and diagnosing where performance can improve across the funnel.

You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client performance, relationships, and retention.

What You'll Own

*Client Strategy & Relationships*

* Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary strategic point of contact
* Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, testing priorities, and next steps
* Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
* Translate performance data into clear recommendations and strategic decisions
* Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
* Proactively identify and address account risks and opportunities

*Paid Media Performance*

* Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
* Manage budgets, audiences, bid strategies, account structure, and creative testing
* Monitor daily performance against cost-per-appointment and other key acquisition metrics
* Diagnose underperforming campaigns and determine where changes are most likely to improve results
* Develop structured testing strategies across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, and campaign variables

*Copy & Creative Strategy*

* Write direct-response ad copy and video sales letter scripts for financial services audiences
* Develop hooks, angles, offers, and messaging variations for testing
* Use performance data to generate new creative and messaging hypotheses
* Collaborate with video editors and provide clear creative direction
* Use AI tools to accelerate research and copy development while maintaining quality and strategic judgment

*Tracking & Funnel Execution*

* Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
* Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
* Identify and resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
* Evaluate performance across media, messaging, tracking, and lead flow to identify the source of funnel problems

  
**Requirements**  

* 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with substantial Meta advertising responsibility

* Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing strategy conversations
* Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
* Strong direct-response copywriting skills, including ad copy and scripts
* Experience developing and testing creative concepts, hooks, angles, and messaging
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
* Strong communication, organization, analytical, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Financial services marketing
*

jobs.desc:
**SCOPE OF POSITION**

The Marketing Manager is responsible for planning, development and implementation of all of HSNEGA’s marketing strategies, marketing communications and public relations activities, both external and internal; overseeing development and implementation of support materials in the area of marketing, communications and public relations; directing the efforts of the marketing, communications and public relations team; and coordinating at the strategic and tactical levels with the other departments of HSNEGA.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

***Core Responsibilities***

  

* Working with the Senior Director, Major Gifts as well as other management in upholding the shelter’s image and mission.
* Create, implement and measure the success of a comprehensive marketing and communications program that will enhance HSNEGA’s position within the community.
* Oversee internal and external communications and all marketing activities including design publications, digital marketing, website coordination, social media management and other areas as determined by the Senior Director, Major Gifts and/or the Executive Director
* Develop short- and long-term plans and budgets for the marketing and communications program, as well as integrated communications plans for the organization’s services, events, programs and other outreach.
* Develop strategies to increase engagement with donors, clients, volunteers, influencers and other key audiences.
* Design strategies that improve online viewership metrics and Google analytics.
* Oversee editorial direction, design, production and distribution of all publications and print materials.
* Manage website content and design revisions.
* Manage and optimize HSNEGA’s presence on all social channels and search engines including Meta and Google Business.
* Support the marketing and development team in the areas of photography, videography, video editing, copywriting, event support and other areas as needed.
* Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks and participating in professional societies.
* Ensure consistent branding and messaging across all platforms.

  

***Knowledge and Skills***

  

* A minimum of three years in a graphic design, marketing or communications leadership role.
* Degree in marketing/communications (or related field) or equivalent work experience preferred.
* Nonprofit experience preferred.
* Experience in providing marketing support to fundraising or sales teams
* Proven experience in graphic design with a strong portfolio showcasing your design skills.
* Proficiency in graphic design software and tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, etc.).
* Keen eye for quality and design aesthetics.
* Excellent writing and editing skills with the ability to create engaging, creative and persuasive messages.
* Careful attention to detail, specifically spelling, grammar and punctuation with knowledge of AP style.
* Proficient in social media advertising, Goole Ads and Adwords, SEO optimization; certification preferred.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to work independently while tracking and managing multiple projects and tasks in a timely fashion.
* Ability to effectively and professionally communicate with a wide variety of stakeholders.
* Strong, proactive work ethic and ability to take ownership of assigned duties.
* Must be a self-starter and driven to meet or exceed expectations.

  

***Certificates, Licenses, Registrations***

  

* Must possess a valid and unrestricted driver’s license.

  

***Competency Requirements***

  

* Must be passionate about the humane treatment and care of animals
* Must be committed to our mission
* Exceptional interpersonal skills

**About Eleanor Health**

Eleanor Health is rethinking addiction by treating it as a chronic condition and building an integrated care model that expands access to effective, whole-person treatment to drive sustained recovery. Our goal is to improve upon earlier generations of opioid and substance use disorder treatment to create more accessible clinic- and community-based care.

Eleanor Health and its associated health care providers deliver best-in-class substance use disorder care utilizing Medication-Assisted Therapy (MAT), behavioral health therapy, care management, and social support and wrap services. As a multi-site, outpatient treatment organization, Eleanor delivers accessible, evidence-based, and excellent clinical care, supported by innovative technology.

If you are passionate about growing your career in a business that makes a difference, we seek highly skilled, motivated, and compassionate individuals who take responsibility and adapt quickly to change to join our deeply committed and collaborative team.

**About the Role**

Every month, thousands of people decide they are ready to do something about their substance use. They search, they scroll, they stream, they click, they call, they fill out a form. This role exists to make sure that as many of them as possible find us in more places than a search results page, and that it costs less to reach them each quarter.

This is a paid media role, and it is not a paid search role. Google Ads and Microsoft Ads are our largest channels today, and a dedicated specialist runs them day to day. This role exists to build and scale everything around that foundation: affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit. We are hiring for depth in those channels, along with the website experimentation that turns more traffic into more members.

**Where we are**
----------------

We have built a real foundation over the past two years. Paid cost per new member has been reduced by more than half. Conversion tracking is clean and includes offline conversion data, so campaigns optimize toward people who actually enter care rather than toward form fills. Campaign structure has been rebuilt, landing page experience has improved substantially, and bid strategy and targeting have moved from manual management to value-based approaches.

This is a performance marketing function with good bones, clear measurement, and meaningful results already behind it.

**Where we are going**
----------------------

Three priorities define the next phase of the work.

* **First —** Paid channel diversification. Paid search carries too much of the load today. We need to build and prove affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, Meta, and Reddit, and to test others worth testing, so growth does not depend on a single auction that gets more expensive as we scale. Each new channel earns its budget by proving member-level economics, not lead volume.
* **Second —** Testing rigor. Our experimentation program is young, and there is substantial gain available from running it properly: structured A/B testing on landing pages and creative, and disciplined testing of newer bid strategies and campaign types, including AI Max.
* **Third —** Website conversion. The website is the front door for every channel. Landing pages, forms, and the online self-scheduling experience decide how much of the traffic we buy turns into a lead, and every point of lift improves every channel at once.

**The channels**

The channels in scope are Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, affiliate, programmatic and streaming audio, and Meta and Reddit. A paid search specialist runs the day-to-day on Google and Microsoft. This role leads the rest, builds the strategy across all five, and decides where each dollar goes.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.desc:
We're looking for an **SEO Specialist** to own off-page SEO and link acquisition for a fast-growing AI mental health and wellness platform. You will build a high-quality backlink profile through targeted outreach, digital PR, content partnerships, and relationship-building with publishers, journalists, bloggers, and site owners in the health, wellness, tech, and mental health spaces.

This is a link building-first role. Strong technical SEO knowledge is a plus, but the primary requirement is a proven track record of acquiring high-authority backlinks through outreach and relationship-building rather than automated tools or paid placements. You also need to be a confident communicator; link building at scale requires writing outreach that gets opened and replied to, and occasionally getting on a call to close a placement. If you have an excellent link building background, strong written English, and the communication confidence to represent a growing brand with authority and warmth, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

* You will be paid in **USD** (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
* **Paid Time Off** in accordance with company policy
* Observance of **Holidays** per company guidelines
* **100% remote setup** so you can work wherever you're most productive
* This role requires availability during **US business hours**
* Work inside a fast-growing AI wellness platform with a strong mission and a large and engaged user base
* High-ownership SEO role with direct impact on domain authority, organic visibility, and brand credibility

What You'll Work On

**Link Building and Outreach**

* Identify and prospect high-authority link opportunities across health, wellness, mental health, technology, and consumer app publications and websites
* Write and send personalized outreach emails to site owners, editors, journalists, and bloggers to secure editorial backlinks, guest posts, and content placements
* Build and maintain relationships with publishers and content partners for ongoing link acquisition
* Track outreach campaigns, response rates, and link placement outcomes with clear reporting
* Identify and pursue digital PR opportunities including expert quotes, data-driven content pitches, and resource page placements

**Link Profile Management**

* Audit the existing backlink profile and identify toxic or low-quality links for disavowal
* Monitor new and lost links and proactively recover high-value lost placements
* Maintain an organized link building pipeline and prospect database
* Report on link acquisition progress, domain authority growth, and key off-page SEO metrics

**Content and On-Page SEO Support**

* Collaborate with content and marketing teams to develop linkable assets including data reports, guides, and expert content designed to attract natural links
* Support on-page and technical SEO work as needed including keyword research, internal linking, and metadata optimization
* Stay current on algorithm updates, link building best practices, and changes in how Google evaluates backlink quality

What You Bring

* Proven track record of acquiring high-authority backlinks through manual outreach and relationship-building in a professional capacity
* Excellent link building background with experience across multiple industries or verticals
* Strong written English with the ability to write outreach that gets opened, read, and replied to
* Confident communicator who is comfortable representing the brand directly with publishers, editors, and site owners via email and occasionally on calls
* Experience with SEO tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz, or similar for prospecting, auditing, and tracking link performance
* Organized and systematic with the ability to manage a high-volume outreach pipeline without losing quality or follow-through
* Self-directed and results-oriented with a clear focus on link quality over link volume

Nice to Have

* Experience in health, wellness, mental health, or consumer app link build

* Location: Los Angeles, CA
* Work setting: In person
* Job type: Part-time
* Pay: $25–$30/hour

About Me & The Role

I am a Los Angeles real estate agent with 15 years of experience and currently rank among the top 1.5% of real estate agents in the United States. My business focuses on selling unique, design-forward and luxury homes throughout Los Angeles, with a strong presence in Northeast LA.

I have built a successful real estate business through experience, relationships, referrals, and strong results. Now, I am looking for the right creative person to help me take my personal brand, Instagram, and overall social media presence to the next level.

I regularly have access to beautiful, architecturally interesting and design-focused homes that provide an incredible opportunity to create high-quality content. I want to take better advantage of these listings—not only to market each property, but to showcase how I sell and market homes, build a recognizable personal brand, and ultimately attract more homeowners, buyers, and future clients.

I am looking for someone who understands social media and has a strong eye for luxury, architecture, interior design, lifestyle, and storytelling. I want someone who can bring fresh ideas and help guide the creative process—not simply wait for me to tell them what to post.

You would help me create engaging Instagram Reels and short-form videos, develop content ideas, film at my listings and events, edit content, improve the overall look and consistency of my Instagram, and develop a social media strategy designed to grow my audience and generate new business.

I want my social media to feel polished, authentic, modern, and elevated—not like traditional real estate advertising.

The right person will have the opportunity to work closely with me, have access to some beautiful Los Angeles properties, and help build a luxury real estate brand with significant room for growth.

My goal is simple: when someone sees one of my listings or videos online, I want them to think, “That’s how I want my home marketed.”

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: On the road

jobs.desc:
**About ARTECHOUSE**
====================

ARTECHOUSE is the nation's first innovative art space dedicated to experiential and technology-driven art. Working at the intersection of art, science, and technology, we create immersive exhibitions in New York, Washington DC, and Houston that redefine how audiences experience art.

**About the role**
------------------

You will own how ARTECHOUSE shows up online and turn that presence into audience and ticket sales growth. You'll set strategy and lead execution across our website, social channels, email, influencer and creator partnerships, and paid media.

Beyond traditional channel management, this role is explicitly focused on architecting, deploying, and managing customized AI agents and automated workflows. Much of your execution capacity will come from a team of AI agents that you design, deploy, and manage, covering content ideation, ad optimization, customer journey automation, and reporting. You'll decide what agents do, connect them to our tools, and review their work so quality stays high and our voice stays human.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Core digital marketing strategy and execution**

* 360° digital campaigns: Lead and execute high-performing digital marketing across email, social media, content production, website, paid digital media, and search to grow audiences, ticket sales, and brand awareness.
* Set the strategy for each social platform (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and new channels as they emerge).
* Plan content around exhibitions, events, and seasonal moments in each city, and grow engaged local audiences through community management.
* Build and run the influencer and creator program: sourcing, outreach, hosted visits, contracts, FTC disclosure, and performance tracking.

### **Paid media:**

* Plan, build, and run all paid campaigns in house on Meta, Google and AI searches, including budget by location, audiences, creative testing, retargeting, and attribution to ticket sales.
* Set benchmarks, structure campaigns, manage bids and budget pacing, and audit spend efficiency.
* Report on spend, return on ad spend, and cost per ticket.

### **Website, ticketing, and email**

* Own the website and location pages: content, exhibition launches, SEO, UX, and conversion rate optimization with internal and external technical partners.
* Monitor ticketing platform performance, conversion, and promotions so the purchase path stays smooth.
* Direct email and newsletter strategy, keeping brand, visuals, and storytelling consistent across all channels.

### **Planning, collaboration, and leadership**

* Own the master digital marketing calendar for exhibitions, private events, press, and company priorities.
* Partner with marketing and location teams on launches, collateral, and revenue initiatives.
* Supervise and mentor AI agents, junior marketing staff/interns, and freelancers.

### **AI agents and automation**

* Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and automated workflows for content drafting, scheduling, audience segmentation, asset tagging, lead nurturing, and admin tasks.
* Run agents that pull cross-channel data into regular performance and ROI reports, with forecasts where the data supports them.
* Keep a human in the loop: review agent output before it goes public, and own accuracy, brand voice, and data privacy.
* Document each agent's purpose, inputs, tools, and owner so the system can scale and be handed off.
* Research and pilot new AI tools, and recommend which ones to adopt, scale, or retire.

**Qualifications & Requirements**
---------------------------------

* 4+ years in digital marketing, running multi-channel campaigns across paid, social, email, and SEO/SEM.
* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads, with results tied to sales or bookings, building and optimizing campaigns yourself rather than through an agency.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered advertising, such as Meta Advantage+ and Googl

Rupp Arena in Lexington, Kentucky, is fast becoming THE must-play venue. The 20,000-seat arena, affectionately referred to by some as “the Cathedral of College Basketball," is home to the National Champion University of Kentucky men’s basketball program and has played host to some of the most talented and award-winning musicians/artists in the world, including U2, Paul McCartney, Elton John, Justin Timberlake, Kenny Chesney, Taylor Swift, and many others.

As an integral member of Phillips’ Digital Marketing team, the Performance Media Manager is an owner-operator accountable for performance media strategy, execution and results across Phillips’ fine Art, Design and Luxury businesses. Success requires strong platform execution, portfolio understanding and the ability to connect media performance with client progression from discovery and profile creation through registration, bidding, buying, consigning and repeat participation.  
Phillips values a workforce with a wide variety of experiences, backgrounds and skills, so we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the qualifications.

  and performance expectations.
* Monitor campaign delivery and commercial outcomes using platform reporting and GA4, including budget pacing, search-term and audience quality, frequency, learning status, and key media metrics (CPA, CR, ROAS); make timely optimizations and apply post-campaign learnings to future plans, budgets, creative, audiences and category benchmarks.
* Partner with Product and Technology to support conversion-event mapping, site tagging, pixel and Conversion API quality assurance, and the accurate measurement of profile creation, registration, bidding, buying, consigning and app activity.
* Work with Creative, Content, Social Media, regional Marketing and Specialist Departments to develop channel-appropriate briefs and ensure that assets, copy, specifications, destinations, usage rights and deadlines are confirmed before launch.
* Partner with CRM to support coordinated audience engagement across the client journey.

**Position Summary**

Nationwide Transport Services is seeking a data-driven and detail-oriented SEO Analyst to strengthen our organic search presence, increase qualified website traffic, and generate more leads for our vehicle transportation and logistics services.

The SEO Analyst will support the development and execution of search engine optimization strategies designed to improve visibility across search engines and AI-powered search platforms. This role will focus on keyword research, technical SEO, website content optimization, competitor analysis, performance reporting, and identifying opportunities to increase quote requests and customer acquisition.

The ideal candidate understands how customers search for auto transport and logistics services, including vehicle shipping, enclosed auto transport, open car shipping, motorcycle transport, dealer and auction vehicle transportation, and long-distance vehicle relocation.

This individual will work closely with marketing, content, web development, and operations teams to improve website performance and ensure SEO initiatives support measurable business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Keyword Research and Search Strategy**

* Conduct keyword research focused on vehicle shipping, auto transport, car hauling, vehicle relocation, and related transportation services.
* Identify high-intent keywords that attract customers actively seeking vehicle transportation quotes.
* Analyze search volume, keyword difficulty, search intent, competition, and conversion potential.
* Develop keyword maps for service pages, location pages, route-specific pages, and supporting blog content.
* Identify content gaps and opportunities to improve rankings for commercially valuable search terms.
* Monitor changes in customer search behavior, seasonal demand, and industry-related search trends.

**2. On-Page SEO and Website Optimization**

* Optimize title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, internal links, image alt text, and other on-page SEO elements.
* Improve service pages covering open transport, enclosed transport, classic and luxury vehicle shipping, motorcycle shipping, and specialty transportation.
* Optimize origin-and-destination pages targeting vehicle shipping routes and geographic search demand.
* Evaluate existing content for relevance, accuracy, search intent, and opportunities to improve organic performance.
* Reduce keyword cannibalization and improve website architecture through effective keyword mapping and internal linking.
* Collaborate with content writers to create SEO-focused landing pages, educational resources, FAQs, and blog articles.

**3. Technical SEO**

* Conduct regular technical SEO audits to identify crawlability, indexation, duplicate content, broken links, redirect, canonicalization, and metadata issues.
* Monitor XML sitemaps, robots.txt, structured data, and search engine indexing.

jobs.title: Content Marketing Manager
jobs.desc:
Stratus, deriving from the Latin term meaning 'layer', offers an advanced set of MEP specific solutions that seamlessly layer across a contractor's entire workflow from design to fabrication to installation. Our team of seasoned industry experts, skilled technology leaders, innovators, and entrepreneurs understands that fabrication does not occur in isolation, and increasingly, it may not happen within your own fabrication shop. Through close relationships with our customers—who include some of the most innovative and largest MEP contractors—we have developed a suite of Stratus tools to digitize, automate, and optimize piping, plumbing, sheet metal, and electrical contracting. Stratus provides the software layer an MEP Contractor needs to optimize profits with true "Data Driven Contracting."

The **Content Marketing Manager** owns how our brand shows up and sounds across social, video, and written content. You will help shape our rebrand positioning, produce customer video stories, and give Product Marketing and sales the one-pagers and presentation decks they need to tell a consistent story.

This is a remote role with some travel.

**What you'll do**

* **Social media:** Manage our social channels, including planning, writing, scheduling, and engaging with the community, and report on performance.
* **Rebrand positioning:** Help define and roll out new brand positioning, and make sure it carries through website, social, video, and sales content.
* **Brand tone and voice:** Work with Product Marketing to document and maintain our tone of voice, and keep content consistent with it.
* **Video production:** Travel on-site for customer video shoots; write scripts, interview customers on camera, and direct and manage the videographer from planning through final edit.
* **One-pagers and collateral:** Create one-pagers and other sales and marketing materials with Product Marketing.
* **Speaking sessions:** Help build and polish presentation decks for conferences and speaking sessions.
* **Content planning:** Maintain a content calendar and look for ways to reuse each piece across channels.

**What we're looking for**

* 4–6 years in content marketing, brand, or social media, ideally in B2B.
* Excellent writer and editor with a strong sense of brand voice.
* Experience planning and running video shoots, including scripting, interviewing, and managing freelance or agency videographers.
* Skilled at presentation storytelling and clear, well-designed decks.
* Comfortable collaborating with Product Marketing, Customer Marketing, design, and sales, and managing several projects at once.
* Willing to travel for shoots; social scheduling and analytics tools experience is a plus.

**Success in the first year looks like**

* A consistent social presence with a steady posting cadence and growing engagement.
* Documented brand voice and positioning applied across core content.
* A library of customer videos produced on schedule and on budget.
* A current set of one-pagers and speaking decks that sales and executives use.

**Manager, Digital Marketing and HubSpot**

**Department:** Marketing

**Reports To:** Director of Digital and AI Marketing

**Location:** Lincoln, NE or remote considered for the right candidate

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

**About TELCOR**

Founded in 1995 and headquartered in Lincoln, Nebraska with an office in San Francisco, California, TELCOR is a proven leader in healthcare software, delivering Point of Care (POC) middleware, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) software, RCM managed billing services, and AI-driven solutions to hospitals, health systems, and independent laboratories nationwide. TELCOR is Great Place to Work Certified®, and our core values — integrity, innovation, dedication, acceptance, passion, and collaboration — guide how we build products and work with one another. As TELCOR enters an accelerated growth phase, our Marketing organization plays a central role in building the brand, sharpening our market position, and fueling the systems that scale the business.

**Summary**

The Marketing Manager, Digital Marketing and HubSpot is the hands-on owner of TELCOR’s HubSpot platform and the day-to-day engine behind its email, nurture, and digital campaigns. This role works with Marketing leadership, Product Marketing, Content, Sales, Sales Operations, and IT to build, launch, and measure campaigns for the POC, RCM/RCS, and AI Systems business units. The role reports to the Director of Digital and AI Marketing and does not have supervisory authority. The person in this role must be a recognized HubSpot expert who keeps data clean, automation reliable, and reporting trusted. All TELCOR marketing team members must handle customer and company data with care and follow TELCOR security and compliance standards.

**Responsibilities**

* HubSpot administration and optimization (about 35%): Administer TELCOR’s HubSpot portal, including properties, lists and segments, forms, workflows, lead scoring, lifecycle stages, user permissions, and data hygiene. Keep the portal documented, organized, and ready to scale.

Run A/B tests, manage send schedules, protect email deliverability, and load and track leads from third-party sources such as content syndication and outsourced BDR programs.
* CRM integration and lead flow (about 15%): Maintain the HubSpot and CRM integration, field mapping, lead routing, and lifecycle handoffs to Sales. Partner with Sales Operations and IT to troubleshoot sync issues and keep the lead journey accurate.
* Reporting and analytics (about 10%): Build and maintain HubSpot dashboards and reports for campaign performance, funnel conversion, and attribution. Keep UTM and tracking standards consistent and turn results into clear recommendations for the marketing team.
* Website and digital support (about 10%): Support telcor.com and related digital properties under the direction of the Director of Digital and AI Marketing, including page builds, on-page SEO, form and tracking setup, and accessibility and consent requirements.
* AI and marketing technology support (about 5%): Put approved AI tools and HubSpot AI features to work in marketing workflows and follow TELCOR governance for responsible AI use. Flag new tools or integrations worth evaluating.
* Additional duties as required or assigned

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, marketing operations, or marketing automation, including at least 3 years as the hands-on administrator of HubSpot.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Current HubSpot Marketing Software certification

19:21 is hiring its first in-house marketing person: someone who will own our brand, social presence, website and client-facing design, and build the marketing department from the ground up.

**The role at a glance**
------------------------

Title

Marketing Specialist

  

Location

Light hybrid: New Braunfels, TX office, with one or two work-from-home days a week

  

Schedule

Full-time

  

Licensing

Texas Life, Accident, Health & HMO license within 60–90 days of hire, sponsored by 19:21

**About 19:21 and why this role exists**
----------------------------------------

19:21 Consultants Co. is a locally owned employee benefits brokerage and consulting firm based in New Braunfels, Texas. We serve employers across Texas, most with 50 to 500 employees, and benefits is the only thing we do. Our name comes from Proverbs 19:21: “Many are the plans in a man’s heart, but it is the Lord’s purpose that prevails.”

What sets us apart is how we show up for clients: real relationships, a hard fight against renewal increases, proactive compliance, plain-language employee education, and open enrollments we run start to finish. Clients reach a real person on a local number, not a ticket system.

Until now, an outside marketing firm handled our core marketing: building the brand, managing LinkedIn and the website, and producing graphic design work. That firm has closed its doors, and 19:21 is ready for its next step: bringing marketing in-house.

You would be our first marketing hire. There is no department, playbook or blueprint waiting for you. There is a strong brand, a growing firm, a team that values good work, and a lot of room to build something that is yours.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

The large majority of your time will be marketing, across four pillars. A smaller share will be helping our clients and their employees directly.

### **1. Social media**

* Own 19:21’s LinkedIn presence: content calendar, posting, engagement, and growing our audience among employers and HR leaders.
* Support our team’s personal LinkedIn presence so producers and leaders show up consistently.
* Explore and recommend other platforms where we can better engage clients and the employees on their plans, then launch the ones that make sense.
* Track what is working and report on it.

### **2. Website management**

* Own our website day to day: content updates, team pages, news, and making sure it reflects who we are.
* Lead the website revamp planned for 2027, from planning and content through launch, working with leadership and any outside vendors.
* Keep the site connected to our sales process so visitors turn into conversations.

### **3. Graphic design**

* Design custom pieces for clients, which we produce often: benefit guides, open enrollment materials, employee flyers and handouts.
* Create sales and presentation materials for our producers.
* Protect and apply the 19:21 brand across everything we put out, and build a library of templates the team can use.

### **4. Sales and marketing enablement**

* Build and run email drip campaigns in HubSpot for prospects, clients and referral partners.
* Find ways to connect HubSpot with the other tools we use so marketing and sales work from the same information.
* Partner with our producers and business development team on campaigns, collateral and follow-up.

### **Client and open enrollment support**

We believe everyone at 19:21 should know insurance well. From time to time, we will ask you to step in at open enrollments and talk with clients and their employees about their benefits. This role needs some flexibility for those moments, and your license (below) prepares you for them.

**Junior Media Planner**
========================

Dallas, TX

**About the role**
==================

This role supports the development and execution of media plans by preparing and maintaining essential planning materials, campaign documentation, flowcharts, budget trackers, and reporting tools that keep work organized and accurate. The position gathers audience, market, and competitive data, updates planning systems, and monitors campaign pacing, delivery, and budget utilization to help ensure media activity aligns with approved strategies and client objectives. This role also coordinates with planners, buyers, vendors, and internal teams to confirm campaign readiness, resolve discrepancies, and support billing, reconciliation, and proof-of-performance requirements. Through strong attention to detail, adherence to process standards, and continued learning of media planning fundamentals, the job contributes to reliable campaign execution, operational efficiency, and high-quality client deliverables.

**What you'll do**
==================

* **Develop media planning support materials** — Assist in the preparation and maintenance of media plans, flowcharts, authorization documents, budget tracking tools, and campaign records. Ensure planning materials are accurate, current, and organized so planners, buyers, and account teams can execute campaigns efficiently.
* **Compile audience, market, and competitive data** — Gather audience insights, market information, media consumption data, and competitive intelligence from approved sources to support planning analyses and help identify opportunities relevant to client objectives and local market conditions.
* **Maintain planning and reporting systems** — Enter, update, validate, and organize information within planning tools, spreadsheets, flowcharts, pacing reports, and media systems. Help ensure campaign data remains accurate, accessible, and aligned with approved plans and documentation standards.
* **Support campaign execution and readiness** — Partner with planners, buyers, vendors, and internal teams to confirm campaign requirements, creative assets, approvals, specifications, and launch timelines are complete and ready for execution. Escalate risks, delays, or missing information promptly.
* **Monitor campaign pacing and delivery** — Track campaign delivery, timing, budget utilization, and key milestones against approved plans. Identify underdelivery, overdelivery, scheduling concerns, or reporting discrepancies and communicate findings to planners and partner teams for resolution.
* **Support media budget stewardship** — Assist with invoice verification, billing documentation, reconciliation support, and budget tracking activities. Compare vendor charges and supporting records against approved plans and escalate discrepancies to help maintain financial accuracy and accountability.
* **Assist with reporting and client deliverables** — Prepare campaign summaries, delivery reports, proof-of-performance documentation, presentation materials, and other supporting resources used in client communications, stewardship meetings, and post-campaign reporting.
* **Develop media planning expertise and industry awareness** — Develop foundational knowledge of media planning principles, audience strategy, channel capabilities, campaign measurement, and integrated communications through training, observation, and participation in planning activities. Apply new knowledge and industry trends to assigned responsibilities while preparing for increased planning ownership.
* **Follow media process and quality standards** — Apply established agency procedures, documentation standards, workflow requirements, and quality-control practices to reduce errors, improve consistency, and support reliable campaign execution. Contribute ideas that improve team effectiveness and operational efficiency.

jobs.title: Junior Digital Marketing Analyst
jobs.desc:
**Junior Digital Analyst**  
EOS Healthcare Marketing, Parker, Colorado

EOS Healthcare Marketing is a search and digital marketing agency based in Parker, Colorado. We’ve been helping dental, veterinary, and other healthcare practices grow for over two decades. We’re a tight-knit team of marketers and designers, and we’re looking for our next Junior Digital Analyst to join the Digital department.

This is a great fit for someone with curiosity, brains, and energy who wants to be on the front edge of what’s happening in SEO and Google Ads. You should have at least a basic understanding of digital marketing, but more than anything, we’re looking for the right person to train. A bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related field is required for this role. Recent college graduates are welcome and encouraged to apply.

**How we work, and why it matters for this role**

Digital marketing changes fast, and the last couple of years have changed it more than the ten before that. AI tools are now part of how we research keywords, write and edit content, build reports, and audit websites. Google keeps changing how search results look, and more people are getting answers from AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google’s AI Overviews instead of clicking a list of links. We think that’s exciting, and we’ve built a lot of our day-to-day workflow around it.

That means this role isn’t about learning one set of tools and running them the same way for five years. The tools we use today will look different a year from now, and some of them haven’t been built yet. We want someone who enjoys that. You’ll be expected to try new tools, figure out what they’re good at and where they fall short, and help us decide what’s worth keeping.

We’re also thinking a lot about the bigger picture. AI is going to keep changing what marketing jobs look like, including this one. Some tasks that take hours today will take minutes, and new kinds of work will show up that nobody is doing yet. When something new comes out, your first instinct is to dig in and figure out if it could help our clients.

* Comfortable with new and changing tools: You can show a history of picking up new software quickly, including AI tools. You don’t get frustrated when a tool you just learned gets updated or replaced, and you’re comfortable learning as you go.

* Humble: You’re eager to learn and aren’t afraid to ask senior team members questions. Nobody expects you to know everything on day one.
* Organized: You can juggle multiple tasks and projects, you have a reputation for meeting deadlines, and you rarely drop the ball.

**Company:** 35 Creative Agency Plus Studio  
**Location:** FULL REMOTE  
**Schedule:** 20hrs/wk

3:5 Creative[s] Agency +Studio is seeking an organized, creative, and social media–savvy intern to support the personal social media presence of one of our team members.

While the internship hire is through the agency, your primary focus will be our team member’s personal platform. You’ll work directly with them to turn ideas into thoughtful content, maintain an organized posting schedule, and help grow an engaged community.

**FYI:**

**This platform is rooted in Christian faith.** Content may explore faith, personal experiences, men's fashion, cooking, and everyday life through a Christian perspective. **What You’ll Do**

* Build and maintain a content calendar, keeping ideas, drafts, approvals, and publishing dates organized.

* Write captions, on-screen text, carousel copy, and short-form video outlines or scripts.
* Coordinate content reviews and follow up on outstanding assets or feedback to keep posts on schedule.
* Schedule and publish approved content across the creator’s social media platforms.
* Research relevant trends, emerging content formats, editing techniques, and storytelling styles.
* Recommend creative ways to adapt trends while staying true to the platform’s message.
* Help organize photos, videos, and other content assets for easy access and use.
* Review basic performance metrics and audience engagement to help inform future content ideas.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage deadlines and details.
* Familiarity with social media platforms, publishing tools, and content planning.
* Strong writing skills and the ability to adapt to someone else’s voice.
* A creative eye for visuals, storytelling, and engaging content formats.
* Awareness of current social media trends and an understanding of when they fit a creator’s audience.
* Clear communication, initiative, and a willingness to ask questions and receive feedback.
* Comfort working with Christian faith-based themes and messaging.
* Professionalism and discretion when working with personal stories and unpublished content.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience using Canva, CapCut, or similar design and video-editing tools.
* Familiarity with social media scheduling tools.
* Basic short-form video-editing skills.
* Experience managing a personal, student organization, community, or business social media account.

**\*\*\*\*\*\* YOU MUST SUBMIT A PORTFOLIO \*\*\*\*\*\*\***

* Practice using performance insights to improve future content.
